recipes.title: Almond Braid
recipes.instructions:
1. Place butter and 3/4 c. sugar in 4 qt. bowl; pour heated milk over butter.
   Uses: 1 cup butter
   Uses: 3/4 cup sugar
   Uses: 2 cups warm milk

2. Mix yeast with 1/2 c lukewarm water and 1 T. sugar; stir; let stand for 5 min.
   Uses: 2 tbsp yeast
   Uses: 1/2 cup lukewarm water (for yeast)
   Uses: 1 tbsp sugar (for yeast)

3. Add eggs and yeast to other mixture; add salt and sifted flour; beat together with spoon-- no kneading.
   Uses: 2 eggs
   Uses: 1 tsp salt
   Uses: 6 cups flour

4. Cover with cloth; let rise for 1 1/2 hours in warm place.

5. Separate dough into 6 equal pieces.

6. Mix filling of butter, sugar, oats, and almond extract..
   Uses: 1/2 cup butter
   Uses: 3/4 cup sugar
   Uses: 1/3 cup rolled oats
   Uses: 2 tsp almond extract

7. Roll out dough into an 8 X 10 rectangle; spread small amount of filling in center of dough.

8. On each side of rectangle make cuts 2" apart and 2"long , lace strips by alternately crossing them over; tuck ends underneath;  let rise for 30 min.

9. Bake at 375°F for 15-20 minutes.  Makes 6 pastries.

recipes.title: Angel Biscuits
recipes.instructions: Dissolve yeast in 3 T. water.Mix together and refrigerate overnight.  Pinch off and bake 10 minutes in a 400°F oven.  Keeps two weeks in air tight container.

recipes.title: Apple Bread

ingredients.name: plain milk
ingredients.prep_notes: enough to make 2 tbsp soured milk
ingredients.display_text: plain milk (enough to make 2 tbsp soured milk)

recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 325°F.

2. Prepare either 1 large or 2 small bread pans by greasing and flouring them.

3. Cream sugar and butter.
   Uses: 1 cup sugar
   Uses: 1/2 cup butter

4. To sour the milk, put the vinegar in a small measuring cup and add plain milk to make 2 tablespoons total. Let stand for 10 to 15 minutes.
   Uses: 3/8 tsp white vinegar
   Uses: plain milk (enough to make 2 tbsp soured milk)

5. Stir the baking soda into the soured milk. Immediately add it to the creamed butter and sugar with the vanilla, salt, and eggs.
   Uses: 1 tsp baking soda
   Uses: 1 tsp vanilla
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt
   Uses: 2 eggs

6. Stir in apples and flour. Mix well and pour into pans.
   Uses: 2 cups apples
   Uses: 2 cups sifted flour

7. Create topping by mixing 2 tablespoons softened butter, 2 tablespoons flour, 2 tablespoons sugar, 1 teaspoon cinnamon.
   Uses: 2 tbsp butter (softened)
   Uses: 2 tbsp flour
   Uses: 2 tbsp sugar
   Uses: 1 tsp cinnamon

8. Sprinkle topping over top before baking.

9. Bake at 325°F for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Apple Pie
recipes.instructions:
If apples lack tartness sprinkle with about 1 tablespoon lemon juice.  Combine sugar, flour, cinnamon, and dash salt; mix with apples.  Line 9 inch  pie pan with pastry.  Fill with apple mixture; dot with butter.  Adjust top crust, cutting slits for escape of steam; seal.  Sprinkle with sugar.  Bake at 400 for 50 minutes or until done.

I prefer granny smith apples.

recipes.title: Apple Pie Cake
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix the oil, sugar, and eggs until smooth.
   Uses: 1 cup oil
   Uses: 2 cups sugar
   Uses: 2 eggs

2. Stir in the flour, baking soda, cinnamon, vanilla, and salt.
   Uses: 2 cups flour
   Uses: 1/2 tsp baking soda
   Uses: 2 tsp cinnamon
   Uses: 2 tsp vanilla
   Uses: 1 tsp salt

3. Fold in the apples and the nuts, if using.
   Uses: 4 cups apple
   Uses: 1 cup nuts (optional)

4. Bake in a 9 × 13 inch pan at 350°F for 1 hour.

5. Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

recipes.title: Apple Pork Tenderloin
recipes.instructions:
1. Heat 1 tablespoon butter in a skillet. Add the onion and cook until tender.
   Uses: 1 tbsp butter
   Uses: 1 red onion

2. Add the apples and cook for 1 to 2 minutes. Add 1 tablespoon cider and cook for 30 seconds.
   Uses: 3 golden delicious apples
   Uses: 1 tbsp apple cider

3. Heat the remaining butter in the skillet. Rub the pork with 1/4 teaspoon thyme, then add it to the skillet and sear on all sides.
   Uses: 1 tbsp butter (remaining)
   Uses: 1 1/2 lb pork tenderloin
   Uses: 1/4 tsp dried thyme

4. Remove the pork. Add the remaining cider and cook over high heat until reduced by half.
   Uses: Remaining apple cider (3/4 cup total, including the tablespoon already used)

5. Over medium-low heat, add the broth, pork, and apple mixture. Simmer, turning the pork occasionally, until an instant-read thermometer reads 160°, about 20 minutes.
   Uses: 1 cup chicken broth

6. Transfer the pork to a cutting board and cover with foil.

7. Mix the half and half, mustard, cornstarch, salt, pepper, and remaining thyme. Stir into the apple mixture in the skillet and simmer until thickened.
   Uses: 3/4 cup half and half
   Uses: 2 tbsp dijon mustard
   Uses: 2 tsp cornstarch
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt
   Uses: 1/4 tsp pepper
   Uses: 1/2 tsp dried thyme

8. Slice the pork 1/4 inch thick and arrange the slices around the edge of a platter. Spoon the apple sauce into the center and serve.

recipes.title: Apple Slice
recipes.instructions:
1. Sift together the flour, salt, and sugar. Cut in the shortening with a pastry blender or two knives.
   Uses: 2 1/2 cups sifted flour
   Uses: 1 tsp salt
   Uses: 1 tbsp sugar
   Uses: 1 cup shortening

2. Put the egg yolk in a measuring cup and add enough milk to bring the total to 2/3 cup. Add to the shortening mixture and mix just until the dough forms a ball.
   Uses: 1 egg yolk
   Uses: Milk to make 2/3 cup with the egg yolk

3. Roll out half of the dough into a 15-by-11-inch rectangle and transfer it to a baking sheet.

4. Mix the cinnamon and 1 cup sugar in a bag or large bowl. Add the sliced apples and toss to coat them evenly.
   Uses: 1 tsp cinnamon
   Uses: 1 cup sugar
   Uses: 8 cups sliced apples

5. Cover the dough with the cornflakes, then spread the coated apples over them.
   Uses: 2/3 cup crushed cornflakes

6. Roll out the other half of the dough for the top crust. Lay it over the apples and pinch the edges together.

7. Beat the egg white until stiff and spread it over the crust. Bake at 400°F for 40 minutes.
   Uses: 1 egg white

8. Mix the powdered sugar, lemon juice, and milk for the glaze. Drizzle over the top while hot.
   Uses: 2 cups powdered sugar
   Uses: 1 tsp lemon juice
   Uses: 2 tbsp milk

9. Cut into 16 squares.

recipes.title: Artichoke Pizza
recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 425°F.

2. Mix together the artichokes, olives, 1/4 cup Parmesan, lemon zest, mayonnaise, and garlic.
   Uses: 1 can - 14 oz artichoke heart (chopped)
   Uses: 1/2 cup olive (sliced)
   Uses: 1/4 cup grated fresh Parmesan cheese
   Uses: 1 tsp lemon zest
   Uses: 1/3 cup mayonnaise
   Uses: 1 clove garlic (pressed)

3. Unroll the pizza dough onto a baking stone. Spread the artichoke mixture over the crust, leaving 1/2 inch around the edge.
   Uses: 1 package refrigerated pizza crust dough

4. Cut the tomato slices in half and arrange them over the pizza. Sprinkle with the Italian seasoning and remaining Parmesan.
   Uses: 2 plum tomato (sliced thin)
   Uses: 1 tsp italian seasoning
   Uses: 1/4 cup grated fresh Parmesan cheese (remaining)

5. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until the cheese is melted and the crust is golden brown.

6. Remove from the oven and let stand for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Aunt Amy's Granola

ingredients.name: organic rolled oats
ingredients.prep_notes: (not quick, that means they've been processed more)
ingredients.display_text: 8 cups organic rolled oats ((not quick, that means they've been processed more))

ingredients.name: organic raw shredded coconut
ingredients.display_text: 1 cup organic raw shredded coconut ((this has NO sweeteners))

ingredients.name: organic hemp seed
ingredients.prep_notes: (doesn't have to be ground like flax seed for the body to use)
ingredients.display_text: 1/2 cup organic hemp seed ((doesn't have to be ground like flax seed for the body to use))

ingredients.name: raw mixed nuts
ingredients.display_text: 2 cups raw mixed nuts ((no roasting or salting))

ingredients.name: raw pumpkin seeds
ingredients.display_text: 1/4 cup raw pumpkin seeds ((no roasting or salting))

ingredients.name: Amaranth
ingredients.display_text: 1/8 cup Amaranth ((this is a whole grain))

recipes.instructions:
Put all these ingredients in a small pot on the stove and warm them until the oil melts and they're all combined. It takes less than 5 minutes.

While your liquids are combining in a VERY large bowl combine:

Stir all your dry ingredients together in the bowl until well combined. If you have little kids like me, it's a good idea to "pulse" your mixed nuts in a food processor to make the pieces smaller and easier for them to chew.

Take the wet and pour small amounts over your granola mix and stir until well combined and moistened. Spread the granola equally on 2 jelly roll size pans (they are bigger than a 9x13 cookie sheet) and bake at 250 degrees for 45 minutes, stirring the granola around half way through the cooking time.

When your granola is cooked and cooled, I add dried UNSWEETENED fruits like raisins, cranberries, apples, bananas, dates, figs, cherries, papaya, pineapple, etc. Serve with milk, preferably Almond Milk!!

recipes.title: Aunt Barbara's Popcorn
recipes.instructions:
1. Bring the sugar, butter, corn syrup, and salt to a boil.
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups sugar
   Uses: 1/2 cup butter
   Uses: 1/2 cup light corn syrup
   Uses: dash salt

2. Turn off the heat, add the vanilla, and stir.
   Uses: 1 tsp vanilla

3. Pour over the popped popcorn and stir until evenly coated.
   Uses: 12–16 cups popped popcorn

recipes.title: Aunt Liz's Sweet and Sour Chicken
aliases: Aunt Liz's Sweet And Sour Chicken
recipes.instructions:
1. Season the chicken with garlic salt and pepper. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
   Uses: 3 lb chicken breast
   Uses: 1 tsp garlic salt
   Uses: 1/2 tsp black pepper

2. Preheat the oven to 325°F. Dip the chicken in the beaten egg, then in the flour. Brown it in hot oil and transfer it to a baking dish.
   Uses: 1 egg (beaten)
   Uses: 4 tbsp flour

3. Mix the sugar, vinegar, chicken stock, catsup, and soy sauce in a saucepan and heat through.
   Uses: 3/4 cup sugar
   Uses: 1/2 cup white vinegar
   Uses: 1/2 cup chicken stock
   Uses: 3 1/2 tbsp catsup
   Uses: 1 tbsp soy sauce

4. Pour the sauce over the chicken. Bake uncovered for 1 hour, turning the chicken once or twice during baking. Check that the thickest pieces reach 165°F.

recipes.title: Authentic Louisiana Red Beans and Rice
recipes.description: "Authentic Cajun flavor! I grew up in Louisiana and love red beans and rice, these are just like I remember. Serve with Tabasco sauce for a little kick. My family loved to splash a little cider vinegar in each bowl."
recipes.instructions:
1. Rinse the beans and soak them overnight in a large pot of water.
   Uses: 1 lb dry kidney beans

2. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook the onion, bell pepper, garlic, and celery in the oil for 3 to 4 minutes.
   Uses: 1/4 cup olive oil
   Uses: 1 large onion (chopped)
   Uses: 1 large green bell pepper
   Uses: 2 tbsp garlic (minced)
   Uses: 2 stalks celery (chopped)

3. Rinse the soaked beans and transfer them to a large pot with 6 cups water. Stir in the cooked vegetables.
   Uses: 6 cups water

4. Season the beans with bay leaves, cayenne pepper, thyme, sage, parsley, and Cajun seasoning.
   Uses: 2 bay leaves
   Uses: 1/8 tsp cayenne pepper
   Uses: 1 tsp thyme (dried)
   Uses: 1/4 tsp sage (dried)
   Uses: 1 tbsp parsley (dried)
   Uses: 1 tsp Cajun seasoning

5. Bring the soaked, drained beans to a brisk boil in the fresh water for at least 30 minutes. Then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer until tender. Allow about 2½ hours total for this step.

6. Stir in the sausage and continue to simmer for 30 minutes.
   Uses: 1 lb Andouille Sausage (sliced)

7. Meanwhile, bring the rice and 4 cups water to a boil in a saucepan. Reduce the heat, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
   Uses: 4 cups water
   Uses: 2 cups long grain white rice

8. Serve the beans over the rice.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Bacon Alfredo

ingredients.name: recipe Guiltless Alfredo Sauce
ingredients.prep_notes: (1 16-oz. jar would work in a pinch)
ingredients.display_text: 1 recipe Guiltless Alfredo Sauce ((1 16-oz. jar would work in a pinch))

ingredients.name: chicken breasts
ingredients.prep_notes: grilled and chopped (about 2 c. chopped chicken)
ingredients.display_text: 2 chicken breasts (grilled and chopped (about 2 c. chopped chicken))

ingredients.name: 14-oz. jar marinated artichoke hearts
ingredients.display_text: 1 14-oz. jar marinated artichoke hearts (drained and chopped)

ingredients.name: chopped green onions
ingredients.display_text: 1/2 cup chopped green onions ((about 1 decent-sized bunch))

recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 350.

2. Prepare the pasta according to the package directions.
   Uses: 8 oz penne or bowtie pasta

3. While the pasta cooks, prepare the Alfredo sauce.
   Uses: 1 recipe Guiltless Alfredo Sauce ((1 16-oz. jar would work in a pinch))

4. Drain the pasta and add it to the sauce. Toss with the chicken, bacon, artichoke hearts, green onions, and 1/2 cup mozzarella. Season to taste.
   Uses: 2 chicken breasts (grilled and chopped (about 2 c. chopped chicken))
   Uses: 6 oz Bacon (cooked & chopped)
   Uses: 1 14-oz. jar marinated artichoke hearts (drained and chopped)
   Uses: 1/2 cup chopped green onions ((about 1 decent-sized bunch))
   Uses: 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella
   Uses: Salt and pepper to taste

5. Transfer the mixture to an 8-by-8-inch baking dish and sprinkle with the remaining 1/2 cup mozzarella.
   Uses: 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella (remaining)

6. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 350 for 20 minutes or until heated through and the cheese is bubbly.

recipes.title: Balsamic Brussels Sprouts

ingredients.name: Kosher salt
ingredients.prep_notes: plus more for sprinkling before serving
ingredients.display_text: 1/2 tsp Kosher salt (plus more for sprinkling before serving)

recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 425. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and set aside.

2. Rinse sprouts in cool water and then chop off the tough ends. Pull any straggly leaves off the sprouts and then chop each sprout in half. Place in a medium bowl.
   Uses: 1 lb fresh Brussels sprouts

3. In a small bowl, whisk together oil, 1 1/2 Tbsp. balsamic vinegar, minced garlic, 1/2 tsp. salt, and the freshly ground black pepper.
   Uses: 1 1/2 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil
   Uses: 1 1/2 tbsp balsamic vinegar
   Uses: 4 cloves Garlic (minced)
   Uses: 1/2 tsp kosher salt
   Uses: 1/4 tsp freshly ground black pepper

4. Drizzle it over the chopped sprouts and then toss to combine.

5. Spread the sprouts out evenly over the baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes or until the sprouts are tender-crisp.

6. Remove from oven, transfer to a serving dish, drizzle with the reserved tablespoon of vinegar, and sprinkle with kosher salt to taste. Serve immediately. Makes 4 servings.
   Uses: 1 tbsp reserved balsamic vinegar
   Uses: Kosher salt to taste

recipes.title: Banana Bread
recipes.instructions:
1. Cream the butter and sugar.
   Uses: 1/4 cup butter (softened)
   Uses: 1 cup sugar

2. Beat in the egg, then add the mashed bananas and mix.
   Uses: 1 egg
   Uses: 3 banana (mashed)

3. Add the flour and baking soda. Mix well.
   Uses: 1 1/3 cups flour
   Uses: 1 tsp baking soda

4. Fold in the nuts, if using.
   Uses: 1 cup nuts (optional  chopped)

5. Bake in a greased and floured loaf pan at 350' for 1 hour.

Makes one loaf.

recipes.title: Banana Cake
recipes.instructions:
1. Cream the sugar and butter.
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups sugar
   Uses: 1/2 cup butter

2. Add the eggs, sour milk, and bananas.
   Uses: 2 large egg
   Uses: 1 cup sour milk
   Uses: 1 cup mashed banana

3. Mix in the flour, baking soda, baking powder, and salt, then fold in the walnuts.
   Uses: 2 cups flour
   Uses: 1 tsp baking soda
   Uses: 2 tsp baking powder
   Uses: 1/4 tsp salt
   Uses: 1 cup walnuts

4. Bake in a 9-by-13-inch pan at 350°F for 25 minutes or until done. For a flatter, bar-style cake, use a cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Barbecue Beef
recipes.instructions:
1. Brown the ground beef and onion.
   Uses: 1 1/2 lb ground beef
   Uses: 1/2 onion (chopped)

2. Stir in the remaining ingredients and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt
   Uses: 1 1/2 tbsp flour
   Uses: 1/2 tbsp chili powder
   Uses: 1 1/2 tbsp catsup
   Uses: 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce
   Uses: 1 can tomato soup
   Uses: 1 tbsp brown sugar

3. Serve hot on hamburger buns.

recipes.title: Barbecue Sauce
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix all the ingredients together and simmer for 15 minutes.
   Uses: 2 cups catsup
   Uses: 1/2 tbsp dijon mustard
   Uses: 1/2 cup brown sugar
   Uses: 1/2 tsp celery seed
   Uses: 2 1/2 tsp chili powder
   Uses: 1/2 tbsp garlic salt
   Uses: 1/2 tsp tabasco sauce
   Uses: 1/4 cup plus 1 tablespoon soy sauce
   Uses: 1/4 cup plus 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
   Uses: 1/4 cup liquid smoke flavoring

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
recipes.instructions:
1. Melt the butter and cook the sliced mushrooms for about 3 minutes. Remove the mushrooms, then cook the onion for 3 minutes.
   Uses: 4 tbsp butter
   Uses: 1/2 lb mushroom-sliced
   Uses: 1 onion

2. Cut the steak into strips about 1½ by 2½ inches. It’s easier to slice when partially frozen. Mix the flour with salt and pepper and toss the steak in it. Reserve any flour left over.
   Uses: 1 1/2 lb round steak
   Uses: 6 tbsp flour
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt
   Uses: 1/2 tsp pepper

3. Heat the shortening in a frying pan. Brown the beef in batches, giving the strips enough room to brown without drying out.
   Uses: 6 tbsp shortening

4. Once the beef is browned, stir any flour left from dredging into the pan drippings. Add the stock, gravy flavoring, onions, and mushrooms. The original makes the stock with 2 bouillon cubes and 2 cups water.
   Uses: 2 cups beef stock
   Uses: 1 tbsp brown gravy flavoring

5. Bake at 350°F for 1 hour. Add the sour cream a few minutes before serving, and serve over boiled rice.
   Uses: 1 cup sour cream

recipes.title: Beef Tenderloin

ingredients.name: Spade L Ranch Beef Marinade and seasoning
ingredients.display_text: 1/4 cup Spade L Ranch Beef Marinade and seasoning

recipes.instructions:
1. Rub the beef with the seasoning. Wrap in foil and refrigerate overnight.
   Uses: 5 lb beef tenderloin
   Uses: 1/4 cup Spade L Ranch Beef Marinade and seasoning

2. Preheat the oven to 500°F. Bake the tenderloin at 400°F for 30 minutes, as given in the source.

3. Mix the juices with a little horseradish and sour cream to serve with the meat.

recipes.title: Beet Bread
recipes.instructions:
1. Puree beets with juice and transfer to large bowl.

2. Stir in the sugar, oil, eggs and vanilla. In separable bowl, combine flour, cocoa, soda and salt.
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups sugar
   Uses: 1/2 cup oil
   Uses: 3 eggs
   Uses: 1 tsp vanilla
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups flour
   Uses: 3/4 cup unsweetened cocoa
   Uses: 1 1/2 tsp baking soda
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt

3. Add to beet batter and mix well.

4. Stir in chips and nuts.
   Uses: 1/2 cup semisweet chocolate chips

5. Pour into 2 oiled 8x8x2 bread pans. They should be 3/4 full.

6. Bake 350 for 30-40 min.

7. Light version- omit oil,eggs- 2 whole and 1 white1/4 t. salt1/4 c. chips1/4 toasted nuts

recipes.title: Berry Pie
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix together sugar, cornstarch and salt.
   Uses: 1/3 cup cornstarch
   Uses: dash salt

2. Add mixture to frozen blackberries or raspberries.
   Uses: 2 lb frozen blackberries or raspberries

3. Let sit for 15 minutes.

4. Pour mixture into unbaked crust, dot with butter, and cover with top crust.
   Uses: butter

5. Cut air vents. Seal and flute edges. Bake at 450 F. for 10 minutes.

6. Reduce heat to 350 F. and bake for 30-40 minutes or until juice looks thickened. Be sure bottom of crust is done.

7. Blueberry PieUse berry pie recipe except decrease sugar to 3/4 cup and use blueberries.

recipes.title: Biscuits
recipes.instructions:
1. Sift together the flour, salt, baking powder, cream of tartar, and sugar.
   Uses: 2 cups flour
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt
   Uses: 4 tsp baking powder
   Uses: 1/2 tsp cream of tartar
   Uses: 2 tsp sugar

2. Cut in the shortening until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add all the milk at once and stir just until the dough follows the fork around the bowl.
   Uses: 1/2 cup shortening
   Uses: 2/3 cup milk

3. Pat or roll the dough ¾ inch thick and cut it with a biscuit cutter.

4. Bake at 450°F for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Black Bean Salsa

ingredients.name: Black beans
ingredients.display_text: 1 can (15 oz) Black beans (rinsed and drained)

ingredients.name: fresh lime juice
ingredients.display_text: 1/4 cup fresh lime juice ((about 2 limes, squeezed))

recipes.instructions:
1. Mix all the ingredients together.
   Uses: 1 can (15 oz) Black beans (rinsed and drained)
   Uses: 1 can (11 oz.) Corn (drained)
   Uses: 2 Jalapeno peppers (minced)
   Uses: 1 avocado (chopped)
   Uses: 1 medium tomato (chopped)
   Uses: 1 medium red bell pepper (chopped)
   Uses: 1/2 cup diced red onion
   Uses: 1/4 cup fresh lime juice ((about 2 limes, squeezed))
   Uses: 1 tsp salt

2. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Black Bean Soup

ingredients.name: Cooked Black Beans
ingredients.prep_notes: drained (or 4 15 oz. cans, drained and rinsed)
ingredients.display_text: 6 cups Cooked Black Beans (drained (or 4 15 oz. cans, drained and rinsed))

recipes.instructions:
1. Heat the oil in a large, deep saucepan. Sauté the bell pepper, garlic, and onion if using fresh, until tender.
   Uses: 1 tbsp Olive Oil
   Uses: 1 cup Red bell pepper (chopped)
   Uses: 4 cloves Garlic (minced)
   Uses: 1½ cups chopped fresh onion, if using

2. Add the tomatoes, green chiles, carrots, cumin, broth, beans, and vinegar. If using dehydrated onion, add it now. Simmer for 10 minutes.
   Uses: 1 can (14.5 oz) diced tomatoes (undrained)
   Uses: 1 4oz. can Diced Green Chiles
   Uses: 3/4 cup Dehydrated Carrots
   Uses: 1 1/2 tsp Ground cumin
   Uses: 3 cups Chicken Broth
   Uses: 6 cups Cooked Black Beans (drained (or 4 15 oz. cans, drained and rinsed))
   Uses: 1/4 cup Red Wine Vinegar
   Uses: 1/3 cup dehydrated onion, if using

3. Serve with sour cream and tortilla chips or corn chips.

recipes.title: Blondies
recipes.instructions:
1. Set a rack to the middle position and preheat the oven to 350°F. Coat a 13-by-9-inch pan with nonstick spray.

2. Fold two 16-inch pieces of foil or parchment lengthwise to widths of 13 inches and 9 inches. Fit them into the pan perpendicular to one another, pushing them into the corners and leaving overhang to lift out the bars. Spray the lining.

3. Whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt. Set aside.
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups unbleached flour
   Uses: 1 tsp baking powder
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt

4. In another bowl, whisk together the melted butter and brown sugar. Add the eggs and vanilla and mix well.
   Uses: 12 tbsp unsalted butter
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups packed light brown sugar
   Uses: 2 large eggs
   Uses: 1 1/2 tsp vanilla

5. Fold in the dry ingredients just until combined. Fold in both kinds of chocolate chips and the pecans, then spread the batter evenly in the pan.
   Uses: 1/2 cup white chocolate chip
   Uses: 1/2 cup semisweet chocolate chip
   Uses: 1 cup pecans

6. Bake for 22 to 25 minutes, until the top is shiny, cracked, and firm to the touch.

7. Cool completely on a wire rack. Lift the bars out using the lining and cut into 1½-by-2-inch bars.

recipes.title: Blueberry Bars
recipes.instructions:
1. Cream the sugar and butter. Add the eggs and vanilla, then stir in the flour, baking powder, and salt.
   Uses: 1 3/4 cups sugar
   Uses: 1 cup butter
   Uses: 4 eggs
   Uses: 1 tsp vanilla
   Uses: 3 cups flour
   Uses: 1 1/2 tsp baking powder
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt

2. Spread half the dough in a 10-by-15-inch pan. Gently spread the pie filling over it and sprinkle with nutmeg. Dot the remaining dough over the filling and spread it as far as it will go.
   Uses: 1 can 21 oz blueberry pie filling

3. Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.

4. Mix the powdered sugar, melted butter, and lemon juice and glaze the bars while warm. For cherry bars, use cherry pie filling and substitute almond extract for the lemon juice.
   Uses: 1¼ cups powdered sugar
   Uses: 1 tbsp melted butter
   Uses: 2 tbsp lemon juice

recipes.title: Bow Ties, Zucchini, Carrots and Chicken
aliases: Bow Ties, Zucchini, Carrots And Chicken
recipes.instructions: Heat oil in skillet over medium heat, and cook 2 cloves garlic 1 minute, until golden brown.  Place zucchini in the skillet, season with salt and pepper, cook until tender.  Set aside.  Place chicken in the skillet and cook 10 minutes, or until juices run clear.Place the carrots in a pot with enough water to cover, and bring to a boil.  Cook until tender, drain, and set aside.Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente; drain.Melt butter in skillet over medium heat, cook the remaining garlic until golden brown.  Pour in the chciken broth and water, stir in bouillon until dissolved.  Gradually stir in parmesan cheese.  Mix through.  Gently toss with pasta to serve.

recipes.title: Bread
recipes.instructions:
1. Original method: Warm the milk, add the butter, and let cool. Mix in 3 cups white flour, the salt, and the sugar.
   Uses: 5 cups milk
   Uses: 1 stick butter
   Uses: 2 tbsp salt
   Uses: 1/2 cup sugar
   Uses: 3 cups white flour

2. Add 6 more cups flour and the eggs. Dissolve the yeast in the water and add it to the dough.
   Uses: 3 egg
   Uses: 2 tbsp yeast
   Uses: 1/2 cup water
   Uses: 6 more cups flour

3. Add more flour until the dough is the right consistency. Knead for 10 minutes and let rest.

4. Place the dough in an oiled bowl, cover, and let rise until doubled. Punch down, turn over, and let rise another 30 minutes. Punch down again, turn over, and rest uncovered for 10 minutes.

5. Divide the dough into 6 loaves and let rest for 10 minutes. Roll them out and put them into pans. Let rise until doubled.

6. Preheat the oven to 450°F. Put the loaves in, lower the oven to 325°F, and bake for 35 minutes.

7. Personal method: Use powdered milk and hot water for the milk. Microwave the oatmeal and water until thick. Add the butter to the hot oatmeal to melt it.
   Uses: 1 cup oatmeal
   Uses: 2 cups water
   Uses: 1 stick butter

8. Put the oatmeal, milk, and butter in the mixer. Add the sugar, salt, and some flour. Add the eggs and instant yeast directly to the dough without dissolving the yeast.
   Uses: 5 cups milk
   Uses: 1/2 cup sugar
   Uses: 2 tbsp salt
   Uses: 3 egg
   Uses: 2 tbsp yeast

9. Add more flour until the dough starts to pull away from the sides of the mixer bowl. You can use part whole wheat. Let rest for 5 to 6 minutes.

10. Restart the mixer and knead for 10 minutes, adding flour as needed until the dough reaches the right consistency.

11. Put the dough into an oiled bowl, cover, and let rise until doubled. Punch down and let it rest 30 more minutes.

12. Punch down and divide into 6 loaves. Depending on how much dough you have, you may get 6 large loaves and 1 small loaf. Let rest for 10 minutes, then roll up and put in pans.

13. Let rise to about 1 inch above the pan rims. Preheat the oven to 450°F. Put the pans in, reduce the temperature to 325°F, and bake for 35 minutes.

14. Remove the loaves from the pans and brush the tops with butter.

recipes.title: Bread Stix
recipes.instructions:
1. Melt the butter in the hot water. Add the cool water, yeast, salt, and sugar.
   Uses: 2 tbsp butter
   Uses: 1 cup hot water
   Uses: 1 cup cool water
   Uses: 1 tbsp yeast
   Uses: 1 tsp salt
   Uses: 3 tbsp sugar

2. Add 3 cups flour, then add more in ½-cup increments until the dough is ready to handle. The original uses about 4 to 6 cups in all.
   Uses: 3 cups flour to start, then more as needed

3. Knead for 5 minutes and let rise until doubled. Roll the dough ½ inch thick.

4. Spread with butter, sprinkle with seasoned salt, and cut into strips. Let rise for 1 minute.

5. Bake at 375°F for about 10 to 15 minutes, until golden.

recipes.title: Breakfast Apple Granola Crisp

ingredients.name: shredded coconut
ingredients.prep_notes: (sweetened or unsweetened, as you wish; I used unsweetened)
ingredients.display_text: 1/2 cup shredded coconut ((sweetened or unsweetened, as you wish; I used unsweetened))

ingredients.name: stick
ingredients.display_text: 1 stick ((8 tablespoons or 4 ounces) unsalted butter)

ingredients.name: pounds* of whatever apples
ingredients.prep_notes: or mix of apples, you like to bake with, peeled, cored and cut
ingredients.display_text: 3 pounds* of whatever apples (or mix of apples, you like to bake with, peeled, cored and cut)

recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 400°F. In a 9-by-13-inch baking dish, toss the apples with the lemon juice, sugar, cornstarch, cinnamon, and a pinch of salt.
   Uses: 3 pounds* of whatever apples (or mix of apples, you like to bake with, peeled, cored and cut)
   Uses: 2 tbsp lemon juice
   Uses: 3 tbsp sugar
   Uses: 2 tbsp cornstarch
   Uses: 1 tsp cinnamon
   Uses: Pinch of salt

2. Melt the butter with the honey in a saucepan. Stir in the flour, oats, almonds, coconut, and another pinch of salt until clumps form.
   Uses: 1 stick ((8 tablespoons or 4 ounces) unsalted butter)
   Uses: 1/4 cup honey
   Uses: 1/2 cup flour
   Uses: 2 cups oats
   Uses: 1/2 cup sliced almonds
   Uses: 1/2 cup shredded coconut ((sweetened or unsweetened, as you wish; I used unsweetened))
   Uses: Another pinch of salt

3. Sprinkle the topping evenly over the apples. Bake for 45 to 55 minutes, until the apples are soft and bubbly. If the topping browns too quickly, cover with foil until the last few minutes so it can crisp again.

4. Cool to room temperature and refrigerate. Serve with yogurt if desired.

recipes.title: Breakfast Pizza

ingredients.name: frozen loose pack hash brown potatoes
ingredients.display_text: 1 cup frozen loose pack hash brown potatoes (thawed)

recipes.instructions:
1. Brown the sausage in a skillet, then drain and set aside.
   Uses: 1 lb pork sausage

2. Separate the dough into 8 triangles. Arrange them with the long points toward the center of a greased 12-inch pizza pan. Press the dough into the bottom and sides and seal the seams.
   Uses: 1 8 oz package refrigerated crescent rolls

3. Spoon the sausage over the dough. Sprinkle with the hash browns and cheeses.
   Uses: 1 cup frozen loose pack hash brown potatoes (thawed)
   Uses: 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese (grated)
   Uses: 2 tbsp grated Parmesan cheese

4. Beat the eggs with the milk, salt, and pepper, then pour over the sausage mixture.
   Uses: 5 eggs
   Uses: 1/4 cup milk
   Uses: 1/2 tsp pepper

5. Bake at 375°F for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Brenda's Blueberry-Peach Muffins
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix the flour, granulated sugar, brown sugar, baking powder, and salt.
   Uses: 3 cups flour
   Uses: 1/2 cup sugar
   Uses: 1/2 cup brown sugar
   Uses: 1 tbsp baking powder
   Uses: 1 tsp salt

2. Add the melted butter, beaten eggs, and milk. Stir just until blended, then gently fold in the blueberries and peaches.
   Uses: 1/2 cup melted butter
   Uses: 3 eggs (beaten)
   Uses: 1 cup milk
   Uses: 1/2 cup blueberries
   Uses: 1/2 cup peaches (peeled and diced)

3. Fill greased muffin tins and bake at 400°F for 18 to 20 minutes.

4. Brush the tops with the remaining melted butter. Mix the topping sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle it over the muffins.
   Uses: 4 tbsp butter (melted)
   Uses: 2 tbsp sugar
   Uses: 2 tsp cinnamon

recipes.title: Broccoli Cheese Soup

ingredients.name: Grated Cheese
ingredients.display_text: 3 cups Grated Cheese ((mild Cheddar, Sharp Cheddar, Jack, Etc.))

recipes.instructions:
1. Melt the butter over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 3 to 4 minutes.
   Uses: 1/2 cup Butter
   Uses: 1 whole Onion (Diced)

2. Sprinkle in the flour and stir for about 1 minute. Pour in the milk and half-and-half.
   Uses: 1/3 cup Flour
   Uses: 4 cups Whole Milk
   Uses: 2 cups Half-and-half

3. Add the nutmeg, broccoli, salt, and black pepper. Cover, turn the heat to low, and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes, until the broccoli is tender.
   Uses: 1 pinch Nutmeg
   Uses: 4 heads Broccoli (cut into florets)
   Uses: 1 dash Salt
   Uses: Black pepper (ground)

4. Stir in the cheese until melted. Taste and adjust the seasonings.
   Uses: 3 cups Grated Cheese ((mild Cheddar, Sharp Cheddar, Jack, Etc.))

5. Serve as is, mash it lightly, or purée it completely. If you purée it in batches, return it to the pot to reheat. Add chicken broth if needed to thin it.
   Uses: Chicken Broth (If needed for thinning)

recipes.title: Broiled Tilapia Parmesan
recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat the broiler. Grease a broiling pan or line it with foil.

2. Mix the Parmesan, butter, mayonnaise, lemon juice, basil, pepper, onion powder, and celery salt. Set aside.
   Uses: 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese
   Uses: 1/4 cup butter (softened)
   Uses: 2 tbsp mayonnaise
   Uses: 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice
   Uses: 1/4 tsp dried basil
   Uses: 1/4 tsp ground black pepper
   Uses: 1/8 tsp onion powder
   Uses: 1/8 tsp celery salt

3. Arrange the fish in a single layer. Broil a few inches from the heat for 2 to 3 minutes. Flip and broil for a couple more minutes.
   Uses: 3 tilapia fillets

4. Spread the Parmesan mixture over the top of the fillets. Broil for about 2 more minutes, until the topping browns and the fish flakes easily.

recipes.title: Brown Sugar Muffins
recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 355°F.

2. Mix the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a large bowl.
   Uses: 3 1/2 cups flour
   Uses: 2 1/2 tsp baking powder
   Uses: 1/2 tsp baking soda
   Uses: 3/4 tsp salt

3. In another bowl, cream the butter and brown sugar. Mix in the eggs and vanilla.
   Uses: 10 tbsp butter
   Uses: 1 cup brown sugar
   Uses: 2 large eggs
   Uses: 2 tsp vanilla

4. Alternate adding one-third of the dry mixture and one-third of the buttermilk until both are used up.
   Uses: 1 1/4 cups buttermilk

5. Fold in the berries, fill greased muffin tins, and bake for about 15 to 20 minutes, until done.
   Uses: 3 cups berries

recipes.title: Bulgur Salad
recipes.instructions:
1. Stir together the bulgur and hot water. Let stand for 1 hour, then drain and press dry.
   Uses: 1 cup bulgur
   Uses: 4 cups very hot water

2. Stir in the onion, parsley, walnuts, and raisins or cherries.
   Uses: 1/4 cup thinly sliced red onion
   Uses: 1/4 cup fresh parsley (chopped)
   Uses: 1 cup walnuts (toasted and finely chopped)
   Uses: 1/2 cup golden raisins or cherries

3. Whisk together the lemon juice, vinegar, coriander, salt, pepper, and oil. Toss with the bulgur mixture and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
   Uses: 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice
   Uses: 2 tbsp red wine vinegar
   Uses: 1 tsp ground coriander
   Uses: 1/2 tsp sea salt
   Uses: 1/4 tsp pepper
   Uses: 2 tbsp olive oil

4. Serve with extra lemon juice or red wine vinegar if desired, or serve in pita bread. Makes 4 to 6 main-dish servings.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Bread

ingredients.name: Wheat flour
ingredients.prep_notes: finely milled hard white wheat flour
ingredients.display_text: 5 1/2 cups Wheat flour (finely milled hard white wheat flour)

recipes.instructions:
1. Fit a stand mixer with dough hooks. Add the flour and instant yeast to the mixer bowl.
   Uses: 5 1/2 cups Wheat flour (finely milled hard white wheat flour)
   Uses: 2 tsp instant yeast

2. In a separate bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, hot water, honey, and salt until the honey and salt dissolve.
   Uses: 1 1/4 cups buttermilk
   Uses: 3/4 cup hot water
   Uses: 1/4 cup honey
   Uses: 2 tsp salt

3. With the mixer on its lowest setting, slowly pour in the liquid. Knead for 10 to 12 minutes, adding the butter in small pieces halfway through. The dough will be sticky. Extra flour makes the loaf tough and dense.
   Uses: 3 tbsp butter

4. Transfer to an ungreased bowl and let rise for 1½ hours, or until doubled.

5. Gently turn the dough onto the table and slowly press out the air. Divide in half. Dust the table with just a few tablespoons of flour, gently knead each piece, and shape each into a cylinder.

6. Place in two greased 8-by-4-inch loaf pans. Let rise in the oven with the heat off, until the dough just crests the top of each pan.

7. Take the pans out and preheat the oven to 350°F. Return them to the oven and bake for about 30 minutes, or until done. Turn the loaves out onto a rack to cool completely.

8. For rolls, this recipe makes 2 dozen. Bake them at 400°F for 20 minutes.

This whole-grain loaf is from The Laurel’s Kitchen Bread Book. It has the taste and texture of white bread and can also be made in a breadmaker or by hand.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pancakes
recipes.instructions:
1. Adjust an oven rack to the middle position and heat the oven to 200 degrees. Set a wire cooling rack over a baking sheet and set aside.

2. Whisk together the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a large bowl.
   Uses: 2 cups flour
   Uses: 2 tbsp Sugar
   Uses: 2 tsp Baking powder
   Uses: 1/2 tsp Baking soda
   Uses: 1/2 tsp Salt

3. In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg, melted butter, and then the buttermilk.
   Uses: 1 large Egg
   Uses: 3 tbsp Butter (unsalted, melted)
   Uses: 2 cups Buttermilk

4. Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients, pour the buttermilk mixture into the well, and whisk very gently until the buttermilk mixture is just incorporated (a few lumps should remain). Be careful not to overmix the batter.

5. Heat a 12-inch nonstick skillet over medium heat for 3 to 5 minutes. Brush the pan bottom with 1 teaspoon oil.
   Uses: 1 tsp Vegetable oil

6. Use 1/4 cup batter per pancake, cooking 2 or 3 at a time. Cook until large bubbles appear, about 2 minutes. Flip and cook until golden brown on the second side, about 1½ minutes longer.

7. Keep the pancakes on the wire rack in the warm oven in a single layer. Repeat with the remaining batter, brushing the skillet with oil as needed between batches.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Sauce
recipes.instructions:
1. Bring brown sugar and corn syrup to boil.
   Uses: 2/3 cup brown sugar
   Uses: 2/3 cup corn syrup

2. Add cream and bring to boil again.
   Uses: 2/3 cup cream

recipes.title: Cafe Rio Style Creamy Tomatillo Salad Dressing

ingredients.name: prepared Ranch Dressing
ingredients.prep_notes: (I usually use a packet of Hidden Valley Ranch buttermilk mix, b
ingredients.display_text: 2 cups prepared Ranch Dressing ((I usually use a packet of Hidden Valley Ranch buttermilk mix, b)

ingredients.name: bunch cilantro
ingredients.prep_notes: large stems removed (about 1/2 cup chopped cilantro)
ingredients.display_text: 1 small bunch cilantro (large stems removed (about 1/2 cup chopped cilantro))

ingredients.name: Green Tabasco sauce or 1 diced jalapeno pepper
ingredients.display_text: 1 tsp Green Tabasco sauce or 1 diced jalapeno pepper

recipes.instructions:
1. Prepare Ranch dressing according to directions on the package or recipe you're following and set aside.

2. Remove large cilantro stems, then wash leaves and spin dry or dry with paper towels.

3. Add cilantro to food processor fitted with the steel blade and pulse until finely chopped. (If you don't have a food processor, I'd chop all ingredients well by hand and then blend dressing in a blender.)

4. Add tomatillos, garlic, lime juice, and Green Tabasco or chopped jalapeno to the food processor and pulse until ingredients are finely pureed.
   Uses: 2 tsp fresh lime juice

5. Add the 2 cups of prepared dressing and pulse just a few times, until ingredients are well combined.

6. Chill dressing for an hour or two and serve.

7. Variations: ~To make a roasted tomatillo dressing, dice tomatillos, place on a baking sheet, and roast at 400F for 15-20 minutes before adding them to the food processor.

8. ~If you'd like even more tomatillo flavor, use 4-5 large tomatillos and decrease the buttermilk or milk in the Ranch dressing by

recipes.title: Cajun Chicken Pasta

ingredients.name: boned and skinned chicken breasts
ingredients.display_text: 2 boned and skinned chicken breasts (sliced thin)

recipes.instructions:
1. Coat the chicken with Cajun seasoning. Sauté in butter over medium heat until nearly cooked.
   Uses: 2 boned and skinned chicken breasts (sliced thin)
   Uses: 2 tsp Cajun seasoning
   Uses: 2 tbsp butter

2. Add the peppers, mushrooms, green onion, and zucchini. Cook and stir for 2 to 3 minutes. You can add yellow squash with the vegetables, as suggested in the original.
   Uses: 2 red and green bell peppers
   Uses: 4 large mushroom
   Uses: 1 green onion
   Uses: 2 Zucchini

3. Reduce the heat, add the cream and seasonings, and heat through. Check that the chicken reaches 165°F.
   Uses: 1 cup heavy cream
   Uses: 1/4 tsp dried basil
   Uses: 1/4 tsp lemon pepper
   Uses: 1/4 tsp salt
   Uses: 1/8 tsp garlic powder
   Uses: 1/8 tsp pepper

4. Toss with the cooked linguine and heat through. Sprinkle with Parmesan. Liz doubles everything except the cream.
   Uses: 4 oz linguine (cooked and drained)
   Uses: Parmesan cheese

recipes.title: California Marinade
recipes.instructions:
1. Put the ingredients in a screw-top jar and shake thoroughly.
   Uses: 1/3 cup oil
   Uses: 2 tbsp orange juice
   Uses: 2 tbsp cider vinegar
   Uses: 1 tbsp sugar
   Uses: 1/4 tsp dry mustard
   Uses: salt
   Uses: pepper

2. Pour over the meat and marinate for 1 hour in the refrigerator.

3. Grill the meat. For basting, set some marinade aside before it contacts the raw meat.

recipes.title: Caramel Corn
recipes.instructions:
1. Combine the brown sugar, corn syrup, and butter in a pan and bring to a boil.
   Uses: 2 cups brown sugar
   Uses: 1 cup light corn syrup
   Uses: 1/2 cup butter

2. Stir in the sweetened condensed milk and boil to the soft-ball stage.
   Uses: 1 can sweetened condensed milk

3. Stir in the vanilla and pour over the popped corn.
   Uses: 1 tsp vanilla
   Uses: 6–8 quarts popped corn

recipes.title: Caramels
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix all ingredients together and cook until temperature reaches 242°F. Butter a 9x9 glass dish.
   Uses: 2 cups sugar
   Uses: 3/4 cup Dark Karo syrup
   Uses: 1 cup heavy cream
   Uses: 1/4 cup milk
   Uses: 1/2 cup butter

2. Pour mixture into dish. Do not pour the last little bit or caramel into pan.

3. Pour it onto a separate plate ( it is the last of the pan and will be harder). Cool and cut into squares. Wrap in wax paper.

4. TAR BARS:Add 7 to 10 drops of anise to caramel toward the end of cooking. Black food coloring could also be added.

5. I like 10 drops.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
recipes.instructions: Beat oil, eggs and sugar.  Add rest of ingredients.  Bake in large tube pan for about one hour.  Or in 9 x 13 pan.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball

ingredients.name: Kraft old english cheese spread
ingredients.display_text: 1 jar Kraft old english cheese spread

recipes.instructions:
1. Mix all ingredients.
   Uses: 2 8 oz package cream cheese
   Uses: 1 jar Kraft old english cheese spread
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups sharp cheddar cheese (grated)
   Uses: 1 tsp lemon juice
   Uses: 1 tsp onion salt
   Uses: 1/2 tsp garlic powder
   Uses: 1 tbsp parsley

2. Shape into two balls, roll into chopped pecans. Chill. Eat with crackers.

recipes.title: Chewy No-Bake, No-Nut Granola Bars

ingredients.name: coconut oil
ingredients.prep_notes: (or any oil to slick your pan)
ingredients.display_text: 1 tbsp coconut oil ((or any oil to slick your pan))

ingredients.name: unsweetened crisp brown rice cereal
ingredients.display_text: 1 1/2 cups unsweetened crisp brown rice cereal

recipes.instructions:
1. Grease an 8x8 baking pan with coconut oil.
   Uses: 1 tbsp coconut oil ((or any oil to slick your pan))

2. Mix the oats, seeds, oat bran, cereal, apricots, and ginger together in a larger bowl and set aside.
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups rolled oats
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups unsweetened crisp brown rice cereal
   Uses: 1 cup dried apricots (coarsely chopped)
   Uses: 3 tbsp finely chopped crystallized ginger

3. Combine the rice syrup, sugar, vanilla, and salt in a small saucepan over medium heat and stir constantly as it comes to a boil and thickens just a bit, about 4 minutes. (I just microwave, since I am simplifying wherever possible.)
   Uses: 1 tsp vanilla

4. Pour over the oat mixture and stir until the syrup is evenly incorporated.

5. Spread into the prepared pan and place in the freezer for 20 minutes to cool and make them easier to cut cleanly into 12 squares. Wrap in waxed paper or plastic wrap. These keep for one month in the cupboard or up to six in the freezer.

recipes.title: Chewy Oatmeal Cookies
recipes.instructions:
1. Cream the shortening and both sugars. Beat in the eggs and vanilla.
   Uses: 1 cup shortening
   Uses: 1 cup brown sugar
   Uses: 1 cup white sugar
   Uses: 2 eggs
   Uses: 1 tsp vanilla

2. Mix in the flour, baking soda, salt, and oats. Stir in the raisins.
   Uses: 2 cups flour
   Uses: 1 tsp soda
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt
   Uses: 2 cups quick-cooking oats
   Uses: 1 cup raisins

3. Drop by spoonfuls onto a cookie sheet and bake at 375°F for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Chewy Sesame Bread
recipes.instructions:
1. Stir the sugar and yeast into the warm water.
   Uses: 2 cups warm water
   Uses: 1 tbsp sugar
   Uses: 1 tbsp yeast

2. Add the salt, dill, and flour. Mix well with a spoon, cover with a towel, and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled.
   Uses: 1 tsp salt
   Uses: 1/2 tsp dill weed
   Uses: 4 cups flour

3. Spread the dough on two cookie sheets or drip pans. Melt the butter, pour it over the dough, and sprinkle with the sesame seeds.
   Uses: 1/4 cup butter
   Uses: sesame seeds

4. Bake at 375°F for 25 to 30 minutes, until golden brown.

recipes.title: Chicken and Stuffing

ingredients.name: boned and skinned chicken breast halves
ingredients.display_text: 6 boned and skinned chicken breast halves

recipes.instructions:
1. Place the chicken in the bottom of a casserole dish and season with salt and pepper.
   Uses: 6 boned and skinned chicken breast halves

2. Cover with the cheese and then the undiluted soup.
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups monterey jack cheese
   Uses: 1 can cream of chicken soup

3. Prepare the stuffing according to the package and spread it over the soup.
   Uses: 1 box stove top stuffing

4. Bake at 350°F for 1 hour. Check that the thickest pieces of chicken reach 165°F.

recipes.title: Chicken Broccoli Alfredo
recipes.instructions:
In saucepan combine Magic Mix and water. Stir rapidly (I use a wire wisk) over medium heat until it starts to bubble.

Add 1/2- 1 cup of parmesan cheese per one cup of white sauce and a dash of salt and pepper. You can stop here and have alfredo sauce or add in 1/4-1/2 C. pesto to make a creamy pesto sauce.

recipes.title: Chicken Cacciatore
recipes.instructions:
1. Wash chicken and pat dry.

2. Melt shortening in large skillet. Coat chicken pieces with flour.

3. Cook chicken in shortening over medium heat 15 to 20 minutes or until light brown.
   Uses: 3 lb chicken (cut up)

4. Remove chicken; set aside.

5. Add onion rings, green pepper and garlic to skillet; cook and stir over medium heat until onion and pepper are tender.
   Uses: 2 cups thinly sliced onion
   Uses: 1/2 cup green pepper (chopped)
   Uses: 2 cloves garlic (crushed)

6. Stir in remaining ingredients.

7. Add chicken to sauce.
   Uses: 1 can tomatoe sauce (8 oz)

8. Cover tightly; simmer 30 to 40 minutes or until thickest pieces are fork-tender.

9. Wendy Paterson uses: 2 cans spaghetti sauce plus 1 package of seasoning.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
recipes.instructions:
1. Place cooked chicken in 9 x 13 inch pan.

2. Mix soup and sour cream together and spread on top of chicken.
   Uses: 1 cup sour cream

3. Cover with the stuffing and top with melted butter and chicken broth.
   Uses: 1/2 cup melted butter
   Uses: 1 cup chicken broth

4. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°F. Freezes well.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserolet

ingredients.name: green or red pepper
ingredients.display_text: 1 medium green or red pepper (cut into 1/2" pieces)

ingredients.name: Great northern beans
ingredients.display_text: 2 15 oz cans Great northern beans (rinsed drained)

recipes.instructions:
1. Pat the chicken dry and cut it into 1-inch pieces.
   Uses: 8 oz chicken breast

2. Layer the carrots, bell pepper, onion, garlic, beans, undrained tomatoes, chicken, and sausage in a 3½- to 5-quart slow cooker.
   Uses: 2 medium carrot (sliced into 1/2 inch)
   Uses: 1 medium green or red pepper (cut into 1/2" pieces)
   Uses: 1 large onion (chopped)
   Uses: 3 cloves garlic (minced)
   Uses: 2 15 oz cans Great northern beans (rinsed drained)
   Uses: 1 14 1/2 oz Italian style stewed tomatoes
   Uses: 8 oz turkey sausage 1/2 " pieces (halved lengthwise)

3. Combine the broth, parsley, thyme, ground red pepper, and bay leaf and pour it into the cooker.
   Uses: 2 cups chicken broth
   Uses: 1 tbsp parsley (snipped)
   Uses: 1 tsp dried thyme (crushed)
   Uses: 1/4 tsp ground red pepper
   Uses: 1 bay leaf

4. Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours, or on high for 3½ to 4 hours. Discard the bay leaf before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken Divan
recipes.instructions:
1. In large saucepan, bring water to a simmer; add chicken breast, onion and celery.
   Uses: 1/2 medium onion
   Uses: 1 stalk celery

2. Bring water to a boil and gently boil chicken breasts in enough water to cover for 30 minutes.

3. Let chicken cool in broth and remove meat from bones. Discard skin and bones; reserve broth for another use.

4. Steam broccoli until just barely cooked and bright green.

5. Preheat oven to 350°. Make sauce by combining soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice and curry powder.In 9x13 casserole, place broccoli on bottom, then top with chicken or visa versa which ever you like.
   Uses: 1 bunch broccoli

6. Cover with sauce, then cheese, and bread crumbs.

7. Bake 30 to 40 minutes or until bubbly.

8. Note:  Instead of using cream of chicken soup, you can make your own sauce. Make a roux by melting 3 tablespoons butter and stirring in 2 tablespoons flour and cooking it 3 minutes until golden.

9. Then whisk in 1 1/2 cups milk and 1 1/2 cups chicken broth seasoned with salt and pepper, cook over medium heat for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchiladas
recipes.instructions:
1. Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces. Coat a skillet with nonstick spray and cook the chicken over medium-high heat until it is no longer pink, about 5 minutes.
   Uses: 1 1/2 lb chicken breast

2. Transfer the chicken to a large bowl and stir in the salsa, 1/2 cup sour cream, and 1 cup cheese.
   Uses: 1 cup salsa
   Uses: 1/2 cup sour cream
   Uses: 1 cup shredded Monterey Jack

3. Coat the skillet again with nonstick spray. Sauté the onion over medium-high heat for 2 to 3 minutes, adding a little chicken broth as needed to keep it from browning.
   Uses: 1 cup onion (chopped)
   Uses: Chicken broth, as needed

4. Add the garlic, cumin, and chili powder, followed by the tomatoes, tomato sauce, and remaining broth. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat, cover, and cook for about 15 minutes.
   Uses: 1 clove garlic (minced)
   Uses: 1 tsp cumin (ground)
   Uses: 1 tbsp chili powder
   Uses: 1 can (15 oz) tomatoes (chopped)
   Uses: 1 can (8 oz) tomato sauce
   Uses: Remaining chicken broth

5. Preheat the oven to 350°F. Coat a 9-by-13-inch pan with nonstick spray.

6. Dip a tortilla in the tomato mixture and fill with about 1/3 cup chicken mixture. Roll it up and place it seam-side down in the pan. Repeat with the remaining tortillas.
   Uses: 12 corn tortilla

7. Stir the remaining 1/2 cup sour cream into the sauce, then pour the sauce over the enchiladas. Sprinkle with the remaining 1/3 cup cheese.
   Uses: 1/2 cup sour cream (remaining)
   Uses: 1/3 cup shredded Monterey Jack (remaining)

8. Bake for 30 minutes or until heated through.

recipes.title: Chicken Lettuce Wraps

ingredients.name: boned and skinned chicken breast
ingredients.display_text: 1 1/2 lb boned and skinned chicken breast (sliced)

recipes.instructions:
1. Prepare the sauce. Sauce - 1/2 cup water, 1/4 cup sugar, 2 Tbsp. soy sauce, 2 Tbsp rice vinegar, 2 Tbsp ketchup, 1 Tbsp, lemon juice, 1 Tbsp chinese hot mustard, 1 - 3 tsp. garlic chili paste, 1/8 tsp. sesame oil. Dissolve the sugar in the water in a small bowl.

2. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Refrigerate until ready to serve the lettuce wraps.

3. Cover mushrooms with boiling water and let stand for 30 minutes.

4. Combine hoisin sauce, soy sauce, 1 Tbsp apple juice, oyster sauce, 2 Tbsp. water, sesame oil, sugar and 2 tsp. cornstarch; set aside.
   Uses: 1 tbsp hoisin sauce
   Uses: 1 tbsp soy sauce
   Uses: 2 tbsp oyster sauce
   Uses: 1 tsp sesame oil

5. In a medium bowl, combine remaining 1 tsp. cornstarch, 2 tsp apple juice, 2 tsp. water, salt and pepper; lay chicken into mixture and spoon over to coat.

6. Stir in 1 tsp vegetable oil and let sit 15 minutes to marinate.

7. Heat a wok or large skillet over medium high hear; stir - fry chicken in 3 Tbsp. vegetable oil for 3 - 4 minutes; remove from wok/pan chop chicken and set aside.

8. Heat 2 Tbsp vegetable oil in wok/pan; add ginger, garlic, onions, and chiles; stir - fry for 1 minute; add mushrooms, bamboo shoots, and water chestnuts; stir fry for 2 minutes.
   Uses: 1 tsp fresh minced ginger
   Uses: 2 cloves garlic (minced)
   Uses: 2 green onion
   Uses: 2 small dried chiles (optional)
   Uses: 8 dried shiitake mushroom (optional)
   Uses: 8 oz bamboo shoots (drained and minced)
   Uses: 8 oz water chestnuts (drained and minced)

9. Return chicken to wok/pan; pour in reserved mixture, simmer until thickened and heated through.

10. Spoon mixture into lettuce leaves; add sauce and roll up like a burrito.

11. Eat and and enjoy. This is good with cellophane noodles, grated carrots, and sliced cucumbers ( that have marinated in apple cider vinegar for a few minutes).

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Soup
recipes.instructions:
1. Fill pot with 1 quart water. Wash and cut up chicken and onion.

2. Add to water, onion, 2 celery stalks, and 5 chicken bouillon.
   Uses: 2 stalks celery
   Uses: 5 cubes chicken bouillon

3. Bring to a boil and then add cut up chicken. Boil until chicken is done.

4. Remove chicken and let cool.

5. Strain broth and remove the chicken fat that has settled on top of broth.

6. Make more broth by adding more water and bouillon or by adding canned chicken broth or soup base. I personally like the soup base. Taste broth and add salt, pepper and extra soup base until it tastes right. Have about 2 quarts broth total.

7. Bring to boil and add either homemade noodles, frozen or dry noodles. Homemade and frozen are best, dry is last resort.

8. Add cut up chicken and cook until noodles are done. Serve with hot homemade french bread.

9. When making final broth grated carrots and diced celery add extra flavor. This is a family favorite especially on a cold day.

recipes.title: Chicken Pasta Primavera

ingredients.name: Broccoli Florets
ingredients.display_text: 16 oz Broccoli Florets (cauliflower and carrots thawed)

recipes.instructions:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions.

2. Saute chicken and garlic in butter.
   Uses: 2 cloves Garlic
   Uses: 2 tbsp butter

3. Add vegetables and cream. Cook until vegetables are tender.

4. Add cooked pasta, parmesan cheese, salt and pepper. Cook until heated through. Serve
   Uses: 3/4 cup Parmesan cheese
   Uses: 1 tsp salt
   Uses: 1/4 tsp pepper

5. Description:  "From Holly Allred"

6. Serves 6 (400 calories per serving)

recipes.title: Chicken Salad
recipes.instructions:
1. Combine mayonnaise, lemon juice, salt and nutmeg.
   Uses: 1 tsp lemon juice
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt
   Uses: 1/4 tsp nutmeg (optional)

2. Add everything else and let sit 2 hours. Serve this salad on lettuce leaf, croissant roll, or bagel. I use less mayonnaise, more pineapple.. I also leave out the pecans and it still is excellent.

recipes.title: Chicken Tetrazzini
recipes.instructions:
1. In a large heavy saucepan cook the mushrooms in 1/4 cup of the butter over moderate hear, stirring, until most of the liquid they give off has evaporated, stir in the flour, and cook the mixture over low heat, stirring, for 3 minutes.

2. Add in a stream the milk, broth, and the white grape juice, stirring, bring the mixture to a boil,  simmer the sauce for 5 minutes.
   Uses: 1/4 cup white grape juice

3. In a kettle of boiling salted water cook the spaghetti until it is al dente and drain it well.In a large bowl combine the spaghetti, mushroom sauce, chicken,  peas, and salt and pepper to taste, stir in 1/3 cup of the parmesan, and transfer the mixture to a buttered shallow 3-quart casserole.

4. In a small bowl combine the remaining  1/3 cup parmesan, the bread crumbs and salt and pepper to taste, sprinkle the mixture evenly over the tetrazzine, and dot the top with the remaining1 tablespoon butter, cut into bits.
   Uses: 5 tbsp butter

5. The tetrazzini may be prepared up to this point in advance and kept frozen, covered.

6. Bake the tetrazzini in the middle of a preheated 375° oven for 30-40 minutes, or until it is bubbling and the top is golden. Tip - If you have a child that doesn't like mushrooms just take and blend the mushroom sauce so that they don't know that there are any mushrooms in the casserole.
   Uses: 1/3 lb mushroom

7. The mushrooms add a much needed flavor to the tetrazzine. This is also excellent made with rotisserie chicken.

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka Masala

ingredients.name: garlic cloves
ingredients.display_text: 2 medium garlic cloves (minced or pressed, about 2 tsp)

ingredients.name: garlic cloves
ingredients.prep_notes: minced or pressed through a garlic press (about 2 teaspoons)
ingredients.display_text: 2 medium garlic cloves (minced or pressed through a garlic press (about 2 teaspoons))

ingredients.name: fresh serrano chile
ingredients.prep_notes: ribs and seeds removed, flesh minced (see note above)
ingredients.display_text: 1 fresh serrano chile (ribs and seeds removed, flesh minced (see note above))

recipes.instructions:
1. In a small bowl, combine the cumin, coriander, cayenne, and salt. Press the spice mixture onto both sides of the chicken. Cover and refrigerate for 30 to 60 minutes.
   Uses: 1/2 tsp ground cumin
   Uses: 1/2 tsp ground coriander
   Uses: 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper
   Uses: 1 tsp table salt
   Uses: 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts (trimmed)

2. In a large bowl, whisk together the yogurt, oil, garlic, and ginger. Set aside. Low-fat plain yogurt can be used in place of whole-milk yogurt.
   Uses: 1 cup plain whole-milk yogurt
   Uses: 2 tbsp vegetable oil
   Uses: 2 medium garlic cloves (minced or pressed, about 2 tsp)
   Uses: 1 tbsp grated fresh ginger

3. For the sauce, heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat until shimmering. Cook the onion, stirring frequently, until light golden, 8 to 10 minutes.
   Uses: 3 tbsp vegetable oil
   Uses: 1 medium onion (diced fine (about 1 1/4 cups))

4. Add the garlic, ginger, chile, tomato paste, garam masala, coriander, cardamom, cinnamon, and black pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 3 minutes.
   Uses: 2 medium garlic cloves (minced or pressed through a garlic press (about 2 teaspoons))
   Uses: 2 tsp grated fresh ginger
   Uses: 1 fresh serrano chile (ribs and seeds removed, flesh minced (see note above))
   Uses: 1 tbsp tomato paste
   Uses: 1 tbsp garam masala
   Uses: 2 tsp ground coriander
   Uses: 1/4 tsp ground cardamom
   Uses: 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon
   Uses: 1/2 tsp ground black pepper

5. Add the crushed tomatoes, sugar, and salt and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
   Uses: 1 (28-ounce) can crushed tomatoes
   Uses: 2 tsp sugar
   Uses: 1/2 tsp table salt

6. Stir in the cream and return to a simmer. Remove from the heat and cover to keep warm.
   Uses: 2/3 cup heavy cream

7. While the sauce simmers, place a rack about 6 inches below the broiler and heat the broiler. Set a wire rack in a foil-lined rimmed baking sheet or broiler pan.

8. Use tongs to coat the chicken thickly with the yogurt mixture and arrange it on the rack. Discard any yogurt mixture that contacted the raw chicken. Broil for 10 to 18 minutes, turning halfway through. The source calls for a reading of 160°F before resting.

9. Rest the chicken for 5 minutes. Check that the thickest part reaches 165°F before serving. Cut into 1-inch chunks and stir into the warm sauce without simmering. Add the cilantro, adjust the salt, and serve.
   Uses: 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves

10. Source notes: The original listed McCormick garam masala, Brown Cow plain yogurt, and Muir Glen crushed tomatoes as test-kitchen favorites.

recipes.title: Chicken, Broccoli and Rice Casserole
recipes.instructions:
1. In a buttered dish layer, 1) rice 2) chicken 3) broccoli.

2. Mix soup, sour cream and grated cheese.
   Uses: 1 can cream of chicken soup
   Uses: 1 cup sour cream
   Uses: 1 cup cheddar cheese

3. Spread on top of rice, chicken and broccoli layers.

4. Mix corn flakes with melted butter.
   Uses: 1 cup corn flakes (crushed)
   Uses: 2 tbsp butter

5. Sprinkle over casserole and bake for 35-40 minutes at 350.

recipes.title: Chicken-cabbage Salad

ingredients.name: Slaw Package or grated cabbage
ingredients.display_text: 1 lb Slaw Package or grated cabbage

recipes.instructions:
1. Combine the cabbage, cooked chicken, carrots, green onion, almonds, sesame seeds, and ramen noodles.
   Uses: 1 lb Slaw Package or grated cabbage
   Uses: 2 cups cook chicken breast
   Uses: 1/2 cup grated carrots
   Uses: 2 tbsp green onion
   Uses: 2 tbsp almond slivers
   Uses: 2 tbsp toasted sesame seeds
   Uses: 1 package chicken ramen noodle

2. Whisk together the oil, rice vinegar, ramen seasoning, sugar, salt, and Accent.
   Uses: 1/2 cup oil
   Uses: 3 tbsp rice vinegar
   Uses: ramen season packet
   Uses: 1 tbsp sugar
   Uses: 1 tsp salt
   Uses: 1/2 tsp accent® seasoning mix

3. Toss the salad with the dressing and refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Chickpea Salad

ingredients.name: (15 ounce) can chickpeas
ingredients.display_text: 2 (15 ounce) can chickpeas ((garbanzo beans), drained and rinsed)

ingredients.name: grape tomatoes
ingredients.display_text: 2 cups grape tomatoes (halved or roma tomatoes)

recipes.instructions:
1. saute onion and garlic together then,

2. In a large bowl, toss together chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, onion, garlic, parsley flakes, dried basil, and Parmesan cheese.
   Uses: 2 (15 ounce) can chickpeas ((garbanzo beans), drained and rinsed)
   Uses: 1 cucumber
   Uses: 2 cups grape tomatoes (halved or roma tomatoes)
   Uses: 1/2 cup fresh parsley flakes
   Uses: 2 tbsp grated Parmesan cheese

3. Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar, and season to taste with salt. Toss until well combined, and adjust seasoning as needed. Cover and refrigerate at least 45 minutes before serving. Serve chilled.
   Uses: 3 tbsp olive oil
   Uses: 1/4 tsp salt

recipes.title: Chinese Won Ton Salad
recipes.instructions:
1. Cut the wonton skins into ½-inch strips and fry in hot oil until lightly browned.
   Uses: 1/2 package won ton skins

2. Combine the lettuce, chicken, celery, green onions, water chestnuts, and toasted sesame seeds. Add the fried wonton strips.
   Uses: 1 head lettuce
   Uses: 4 chicken breast
   Uses: 1 cup celery (diced)
   Uses: 3 green onion (diced)
   Uses: 1 can water chestnuts (sliced)
   Uses: 1/4 cup sesame seeds (toasted)

3. Mix the dressing and toss it with the salad just before serving.
   Uses: 1/4 cup oil
   Uses: 4 tbsp sugar
   Uses: 1 tsp salt
   Uses: 1 tbsp soy sauce
   Uses: 4 tsp rice vinegar

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Brownie Bars
recipes.instructions:
1. Start the chocolate chip layer. Melt its butter and whisk in the brown sugar until smooth. Let cool while you make the brownie layer.
   Uses: 1 1/2 sticks butter
   Uses: 1 cup brown sugar

2. For the brownie layer, melt its butter and whisk in the cocoa until smooth. Whisk in the sugar, salt, vanilla, and eggs, adding the eggs one at a time.
   Uses: 1 1/2 sticks butter
   Uses: 3/4 cup cocoa
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups sugar
   Uses: 1/4 tsp salt
   Uses: 1 1/2 tsp vanilla
   Uses: 2 egg

3. Stir the flour into the brownie batter just until blended and spread it in a 9-by-13-inch pan.
   Uses: 3/4 cup flour

4. Return to the cooled chocolate chip mixture. Whisk in the egg and vanilla, then stir in the flour, baking soda, and salt. Mix in the chocolate chips.
   Uses: 1 egg
   Uses: 1 tsp vanilla
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups flour
   Uses: 1/2 tsp soda
   Uses: 1/4 tsp salt
   Uses: 1 cup chocolate chip

5. Drop spoonfuls of the chocolate chip dough over the brownie layer and spread to cover. Bake at 350°F for 35 to 40 minutes, until a toothpick comes out with moist crumbs.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.instructions:
1. Beat the sugars and shortening until creamy.
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups sugar
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups brown sugar
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups shortening

2. Add the eggs, salt, baking soda, vanilla, and flour. Mix well.
   Uses: 4 eggs
   Uses: 1 1/2 tsp salt
   Uses: 1 1/2 tsp baking soda
   Uses: 1 1/2 tsp vanilla
   Uses: 4 cups flour

3. Fold in the chocolate chips.
   Uses: 1 package chocolate chip

4. Bake at 350°F until done. The cookies are best when they are just baked through.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Fruities
recipes.instructions:
1. Put all the ingredients in a bowl and beat them together.
   Uses: 1 cup shortening
   Uses: 1 cup sugar
   Uses: 1/4 cup honey
   Uses: 2 eggs
   Uses: 2 cups flour
   Uses: 1 tsp salt
   Uses: 1 tsp cinnamon
   Uses: 1 tsp ginger
   Uses: 1 tsp soda
   Uses: 1/2 cup sour cream
   Uses: 1 cup raisins
   Uses: 3 cups rolled oats
   Uses: 3 mashed bananas
   Uses: 1 cup chocolate chips

2. Bake at 375°F until done.

recipes.title: Chocolate Ice Cream Cake Roll
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix cake mix, water, and eggs.
   Uses: 1 package devil's food cake mix
   Uses: 1/2 cup water
   Uses: 4 egg

2. Beat 2 minutes at high speed.  .

3. Heat oven to 350°F. Grease 2 (15 x 10- inch) jelly roll pans; line with waxed paper and grease again.

4. Spread half the batter in each prepared pan.

5. Bake one cake at a time on middle rack of oven.

6. Bake 14 minutes. Immediately invert cake onto clean kitchen towels; that have been generously sprinkled with powdered sugar.

7. Remove waxed paper. Starting at shorter end of cake, roll up cake in towel.

8. Cool completely. Carefully unroll cake, but do not lay flat; remove towel.

9. Spread each cake with 1 quart ice cream and roll up loosely. Wrap in foil; freeze until firm.To serve, cut into 1-inch slices.

10. Drizzle with fudge topping. Store in freezer.
   Uses: ice cream topping

11. I bake  in 12x17 inch pans, for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Sauce
recipes.instructions:
1. Melt chocolate and butter.
   Uses: 1/2 square chocolate
   Uses: 2 tbsp butter

2. Add sugar, cream, and corn syrup.
   Uses: 2 tbsp corn syrup

3. Bring to boil. Boil to soft ball stage.

4. Add enough additional cream for right consistency.
   Uses: 1/2 cup cream

recipes.title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
recipes.instructions:
1. Grate zucchini.

2. Mix flour, baking powder, cinnamon, salt, soda and cloves.
   Uses: 3 cups flour
   Uses: 1 1/2 tsp baking powder
   Uses: 1/2 tsp cinnamon
   Uses: 1 1/4 tsp salt
   Uses: 1/8 tsp cloves

3. Cream oil and sugar, add eggs one at a time.
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups oil
   Uses: 2 1/2 cups brown sugar
   Uses: 4 egg

4. Beat in melted chocolate.

5. Add dry ingredients, beat till smooth.

6. Fold in zucchini and chips and nuts.
   Uses: 1 cup chocolate chips

7. Bake in greased and floured bundt pan.

8. Bake 350°F, 1 hour 20 min. Cool 10 minutes before removing.

recipes.title: Cider Syrup
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix sugar, cornstarch, cinnamon and nutmeg in saucepan.
   Uses: 1/2 cup sugar
   Uses: 1 tbsp cornstarch
   Uses: 1/8 tsp cinnamon
   Uses: 1/8 tsp nutmeg

2. Stir in apple cider and lemon juice.
   Uses: 1 tbsp lemon juice

3. Heat to boiling, stirring constantly.

4. Boil one minute.

5. Blend in butter. Serve warm.
   Uses: 2 tbsp butter

recipes.title: Cincinnati-style Chili
recipes.instructions:
1. Cook and stir ground beef and about 3/4 cup of the onions in 3 quart saucepan until beef is brown and onions are tender; drain.
   Uses: 1 lb ground beef

2. Stir in chili powder, salt, tomatoes, beans and tomato sauce; break up tomatoes.
   Uses: 1 can 8 oz tomato sauce

3. Cook uncovered over medium heat until desired consistency, about 10 minutes.

4. Cook spaghetti as directed on package; drain. For each serving, spoon about 3/4 cup beef mixture over 1 cup hot spaghetti.

5. Sprinkle each serving with cheese and onion.
   Uses: 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese

recipes.title: Cinnamon Snaps
recipes.instructions:
1. In a mixing bowl, cream shortening and brown sugar.
   Uses: 3/4 cup shortening
   Uses: 1 cup brown sugar (packed)

2. Add egg and molasses.
   Uses: 1 egg
   Uses: 1/4 cup molasses

3. Combine the flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt; gradually add to creamed mixture.

4. Roll into 1-in balls, then roll in additional sugar.
   Uses: additional sugar

5. Place 2 in. apart on ungreased baking sheets. Bake at 350°F for 10-12 minutes or until cookies are set and tops are cracked.

6. Remove to wire racks to cool.

7. Yield:  "4 1/2 dozen"

recipes.title: Cinnamon Swirl
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix the batter ingredients in a greased 8-by-8-inch baking dish. Let rest for 10 minutes.
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups flour
   Uses: 1/4 cup sugar
   Uses: 1/4 tsp salt
   Uses: 2 envelopes rapid rise yeast
   Uses: 2/3 cup very warm milk (120* to 130*F)
   Uses: 2 tbsp butter melted
   Uses: 2 tbsp oil

2. Combine the cinnamon mixture with a fork. Spread it evenly over the batter and poke it into the batter with your fingers.
   Uses: 3 tbsp butter melted
   Uses: 3/4 cup brown sugar
   Uses: 1 1/2 tsp cinnamon

3. Place the dish in a cold oven, then set the oven to 350°F. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until lightly browned and firm in the center. Cool for 10 minutes.

4. Mix the icing ingredients and drizzle over the warm cake.
   Uses: 1 cup powdered sugar
   Uses: 2 tbsp milk
   Uses: 1 tbsp butter melted
   Uses: 1/2 tsp vanilla

recipes.title: Cinnamon Swirl Pancakes

ingredients.name: packed light brown sugar
ingredients.display_text: 1/4 cup + 2 tablespoons packed light brown sugar

recipes.instructions:
1. Prepare the filling. In a medium bowl, stir together the butter, brown sugar, and cinnamon. Scoop into a quart-sized heavy zip baggie and set aside (see *Tips below).
   Uses: 4 tbsp unsalted butter (melted)
   Uses: 1/4 cup + 2 tablespoons packed light brown sugar
   Uses: 1/2 tbsp ground cinnamon

2. Prepare the glaze. In a small pan, heat the butter over low heat until melted. Turn off the heat and whisk in the cream cheese until almost smooth.
   Uses: 4 tbsp unsalted butter (melted)
   Uses: 2 oz cream cheese (at room temperature)

3. Sift the powdered sugar into the glaze, stir, and add vanilla. Set the pan aside while you make the pancakes.
   Uses: 3/4 cup powdered sugar
   Uses: 1/2 tsp vanilla extract

4. Whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt in a medium bowl.
   Uses: 1 cup all-purpose flour
   Uses: 2 tsp baking powder
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt

5. Whisk in the milk, egg, and oil just until the batter is moistened. A few small lumps are fine.
   Uses: 1 cup milk
   Uses: 1 large egg (lightly beaten)
   Uses: 1 tbsp canola or vegetable oil

6. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat and spray with nonstick spray. Scoop batter into the pan with an ice cream scoop or 1/3 cup measuring cup. Use the bottom of the scoop or cup to spread it to about 4 inches across. Reduce the heat to medium-low.

7. Snip the corner of the baggie and squeeze the filling into the open corner. When bubbles form on the pancake, squeeze a swirl of filling onto the batter, starting at the center.

8. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until the bubbles begin to pop and the bottom is golden brown. Slide a thin, wide metal spatula underneath and flip gently and quickly. Cook for another 2 to 3 minutes, until the other side is golden.

9. Flip the pancake onto a plate to show the cinnamon swirl. Wipe the pan with a paper towel and repeat with the remaining batter and filling.

10. Briefly rewarm the glaze if needed. Serve with a drizzle of glaze.

recipes.title: Clam Chowder
recipes.instructions:
1. Drain the clam juice into a pot with the celery, onion, and potatoes. Add water to cover and simmer for about 20 minutes, until tender.
   Uses: 1 cup diced celery
   Uses: 1/2 cup chopped onion
   Uses: 4 cups cubed potatoes
   Uses: Juice from 1 can minced clams

2. In a saucepan, melt the butter and stir in the flour. Add the half-and-half and milk and cook until thickened.
   Uses: 3/4 cup butter
   Uses: 3/4 cup flour
   Uses: 1 pt half and half
   Uses: 2 cups milk

3. Add the sauce, clams, salt, and sugar to the vegetables. Heat through without boiling.
   Uses: 1 can minced clams
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt
   Uses: 1/2 tsp sugar

recipes.title: Clark's Infamous Barbecued Beef Brisket
recipes.instructions:
1. Soak mesquite in water to cover for 1 hour; drain. Prepare barbecue grill, lighting fire at one end only; rub meat with dry rub. When coals are white, place meat over coals; sear for 5 min. on each side; move meat to side of grill away from fire;
   Uses: 2 tbsp dry rub

2. spread 4 c. mesquite over coals; cover grill. Smoke brisket for 1 hour, keep temperature about 200°F; sprinkle mesquite with water occasionally;

3. spread rest of mesquite over coals; continue smoking meat for 1 more hour.

4. Preheat oven to 200°F; wrap meat tightly with heavy duty foil; bake for 8 hours; slice meat across grain; serve with barbecue sauce.

5. Dry Rub:1 1/2 tsp. groung red pepper1 1/2 tsp freshly ground pepper1/4 cup salt

6. Mix. Can be stored several weeks in air-tight jar.

7. Barbecue Sauce:4 oz. liquid smoke5 oz. worcestershire sauce5 oz. soy sauce1 tsp. tabasco1 T. garlic salt1 1/2 T. chili powder1 tsp. celery seed1 cup brown sugar1. T. Dijon mustard32 oz. catsup

8. Mix all ingredients in suacepan; simmer for 15 min. Can be stored in refrigerator. Makes a lot. We usually half the recipe

recipes.title: Cocoa Apple Cake
recipes.instructions:
1. Beat the eggs, sugar, butter, and water until fluffy.
   Uses: 3 egg
   Uses: 2 cups sugar
   Uses: 1 cup butter
   Uses: 1/2 cup water

2. Sift the flour, cocoa, baking soda, cinnamon, and allspice into a separate bowl. Mix into the wet ingredients.
   Uses: 2 1/2 cups flour
   Uses: 2 tbsp cocoa
   Uses: 1 1/2 tsp baking soda
   Uses: 1 tsp cinnamon
   Uses: 1 tsp allspice

3. Fold in the grated apples, nuts, chocolate chips, and vanilla. Spoon into a greased and floured tube pan.
   Uses: 2 cups apples (grated)
   Uses: 1 cup nuts
   Uses: 1/2 cup chocolate chips
   Uses: 1 tbsp vanilla

4. Bake at 325°F for 60 to 70 minutes.

recipes.title: Coconut Chicken
recipes.instructions:
1. Pat the chicken dry and cut into 2-inch strips.
   Uses: 6 chicken breast (boneless)

2. Mix the coconut and cornflake crumbs with the salt and pepper.
   Uses: 1/4 cup coconut
   Uses: 1 cup corn flake crumbs
   Uses: 1/4 tsp salt
   Uses: 1/8 tsp pepper

3. Beat the egg white until foamy. Dip the chicken into the egg white, then into the cornflake mixture.
   Uses: 1 egg white

4. To fry, heat the oil in a skillet and fry the strips until the thickest pieces reach 165°F.
   Uses: 1/4 cup oil (for frying)

5. To bake instead, preheat the oven to 400°F. Arrange the strips in a single layer on a lined baking sheet. Start checking after 10 minutes and bake until the thickest pieces reach 165°F.

6. For the sauce, stir together the crushed pineapple, Dijon mustard, and brown sugar.
   Uses: 1/3 cup crushed pineapple
   Uses: 1/2 tsp Dijon mustard
   Uses: 1 tsp brown sugar

7. Mix the cornstarch with the water. Stir it into the pineapple mixture and cook over medium heat until thickened. Serve warm with the chicken.
   Uses: 1 tsp cornstarch
   Uses: 2 tbsp water

recipes.title: Congo Bars
recipes.instructions:
1. Sift flour, baking powder, salt.
   Uses: 2 1/2 cups sifted flour
   Uses: 2 1/2 tsp baking powder
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt

2. Melt shortening and add sugars, cool a little.
   Uses: 3/4 cup shortening

3. Add eggs one at a time.
   Uses: 3 eggs

4. Add dry ingredients, nuts and chips.
   Uses: 1 cup nuts (optional)
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups chocolate chips

5. Spread into a jelly roll pan, 9x15. Bake at 350° for 20-25 minutes.

recipes.title: Cookie Pie
recipes.instructions:
1. Cream shortening and sugars.
   Uses: 2/3 cup shortening

2. Add egg and vanilla.
   Uses: 1 egg
   Uses: 1 tsp vanilla

3. Stir in flour, salt and soda.
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups flour
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt
   Uses: 1/2 tsp soda

4. Spread into 2 pie tins.

5. Bake 375° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Corn Bread

ingredients.name: buttermilk
ingredients.prep_notes: (3 T. dry powdered milk + 1 C. Water and 1 T. lemon juice or vin
ingredients.display_text: 1 cup buttermilk ((3 T. dry powdered milk + 1 C. Water and 1 T. lemon juice or vin)

ingredients.name: flour
ingredients.display_text: 1 cup flour ((half and half or all-purpose))

ingredients.name: eggs
ingredients.prep_notes: (2 T. Dehydrated egg powder + 1/4 C. Water)
ingredients.display_text: 2 eggs ((2 T. Dehydrated egg powder + 1/4 C. Water))

recipes.instructions:
1. Melt butter; add to the sugar and stir well.
   Uses: 1/2 cup butter
   Uses: 2/3 cup sugar

2. Add eggs and beat until well blended.
   Uses: 2 eggs ((2 T. Dehydrated egg powder + 1/4 C. Water))

3. Combine buttermilk and soda and stir into sugar-egg-butter mixture.

4. Add cornmeal, flour, and salt and stir until just blended.
   Uses: 1 cup yellow cornmeal
   Uses: 1 cup flour ((half and half or all-purpose))
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt

5. Pour into greased 8-inch square pan. Bake at 375 degrees about 30 minutes or until it begins to pull away from sides of pan. Serve piping hot with butter and honey. Reid likes the middle not cooked 28-30 mins

6. Note: For glass pan, reduce heat to 350 degrees.

recipes.title: Corn Chowder

ingredients.name: frozen supper sweet white corn kernels
ingredients.display_text: 1 lb frozen supper sweet white corn kernels

recipes.instructions:
1. Roast the garlic by wrapping it in foil and place in a hot oven for about 30 minutes; when it is done you can just squeeze it out of the papery skin.

2. Cook the onion in the bacon grease.
   Uses: 2 tbsp red onion (chopped)
   Uses: 1/8 lb bacon (fried and crumbled)

3. Drain the remaining grease and add butter, flour, salt, peppers and crushed garlic.
   Uses: 1 tbsp butter
   Uses: 1/4 cup flour
   Uses: 1 tsp salt
   Uses: 3 cloves garlic (roasted)

4. Stir quickly to avoid lumps and add the corn and chicken broth. Cover and cook for 5 - 10 minutes.
   Uses: 16 oz chicken broth

5. Add the half and half and garnish with tomato chumks. May need to thin with up to 1 cup of milk.I always double this recipe. The orginal recipe calls for 5 ears of corn, kernels sliced off.
   Uses: 1 cup fat free half-and-half

recipes.title: Cornbread Cake
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix the cake mix, cornbread mix, eggs, and milk. Pour the batter into a 9-by-13-inch pan.
