   Uses: 1 package yellow cake mix
   Uses: 2 packages cornbread mix
   Uses: 2 eggs
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups milk

2. Bake at 350°F for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Country Style Chicken Kiev
recipes.instructions:
1. Oven 375°F. Melt butter.
   Uses: 2/3 cup butter

2. Combine bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese, basil, oregano, garlic salt.
   Uses: 1/2 cup dried bread (crumbs)
   Uses: 2 tbsp Parmesan cheese
   Uses: 1/2 tsp garlic salt

3. Dip chicken in butter, then coat with crumbs. Save butter.

4. Place chicken skin side up in ungreased 10-inch pan.

5. Bake 50-60 minutes or until chicken is fork tender.

6. Meanwhile, add apple juice, green onion and parsley to reserved butter. When chicken is golden brown, pour butter sauce over chicken.
   Uses: 1/4 cup apple juice

7. Bake 3-5 minutes.

recipes.title: Couscous and Black Bean Salad
recipes.instructions:
1. Bring the chicken broth to a boil in a saucepan that holds at least 2 quarts. Stir in the couscous, cover, remove from heat, and let stand for 5 minutes.
   Uses: 1 1/4 cups chicken broth
   Uses: 1 cup uncooked couscous

2. Whisk the olive oil, lime juice, vinegar, and cumin in a large bowl. Add the green onions, pepper, cilantro, corn, and beans. Toss to coat.
   Uses: 3 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil
   Uses: 2 tbsp fresh lime juice
   Uses: 1 tsp red wine vinegar
   Uses: 1/2 tsp ground cumin
   Uses: 8 green onions
   Uses: 1 red bell pepper
   Uses: 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro
   Uses: 1 cup frozen corn kernels (thawed)
   Uses: 2 15-oz cans black beans (drained)

3. Fluff the couscous and break up any clumps. Toss with the vegetables and season to taste. Serve immediately or refrigerate until serving.
   Uses: salt and pepper (to taste)

recipes.title: Cowboy Cookies
recipes.instructions:
1. Cream shortening and sugar.
   Uses: 1 cup shortening (half butter)

2. Beat in eggs.
   Uses: 2 eggs

3. Add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly.

4. Drop by tsp. on ungreased cookie sheet, flatten out; Bake at 350° for 8-10 minutes. till lightly browned edges.

recipes.title: Cranberry Jello Salad
recipes.instructions:
1. Dissolve the cherry gelatin and sugar in the boiling water, then stir in the orange juice.
   Uses: 2 3 oz package cherry jello
   Uses: 3 cups boiling water
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups sugar
   Uses: 1/2 cup orange juice

2. Stir the cranberries, pineapple, and apples into the gelatin mixture and refrigerate until set.
   Uses: 1 lb ground cranberries
   Uses: 1 medium can crushed pineapple
   Uses: 2 cups chopped apples

3. Serve chilled. The original suggests it for Thanksgiving.

recipes.title: Cream of Chicken Soup (Condensed)
recipes.instructions:
1. Place 1 tablespoon of chicken stock in a saucepan over medium-low heat, and cook and stir the onion and garlic in the broth until they are softened, about 3 minutes.
   Uses: 1 tsp finely chopped onion
   Uses: 1 clove garlic (finely chopped)

2. Pour in the rest of the broth and 1/2 cup of milk, and whisk in the salt, black pepper, parsley, lemon pepper seasoning, allspice, and paprika.
   Uses: 1/4 tsp salt
   Uses: 1/4 tsp black pepper
   Uses: 1/4 tsp chopped fresh parsley
   Uses: 1/8 tsp lemon pepper seasoning
   Uses: 1 pinch ground allspice
   Uses: 1 pinch ground paprika

3. Bring the mixture to a boil, reduce heat, and allow to simmer for 1 to 2 minutes. Whisk together the remaining milk and the flour until smooth, and whisk the milk mixture into the hot stock mixture.

4. Keep whisking continuously to avoid lumps until the soup comes almost to a boil and thickens.

recipes.title: Creamed Chicken
recipes.instructions:
1. Melt butter; add flour and stir until smooth.
   Uses: 1 stick butter
   Uses: 1/2 cup flour

2. Combine remaining ingredients and add to flour mixture. Stir until thickened over low hear.

3. Add chicken. Server over rice, noodles or frozen Pepperidge Farm patty shells.
   Uses: 4 cups cooked chicken

recipes.title: Creamed Corn
recipes.instructions:
1. Melt butter  with corn.
   Uses: 2 tbsp Butter
   Uses: 4 cups Corn

2. Add 2/3 cup water and boil. Simmer for 10 mins. Add cream, sugar and cornstarch.
   Uses: 2/3 cup Water
   Uses: 1 tsp Sugar

recipes.title: Creamy Broccoli Soup
recipes.instructions:
1. In medium saucepan, combine all ingredients; bring to the boiling point.
   Uses: 1 package lipton chicken noodle soup
   Uses: 3 1/2 cups milk
   Uses: 1 package frozen broccoli flowerets

2. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally, 5 minutes or until noodles are tender.

recipes.title: Creamy Jumbo Drops
recipes.instructions:
1. Cream the butter and both sugars together.
   Uses: 1/2 cup butter
   Uses: 1 cup brown sugar
   Uses: 1/2 cup white sugar

2. Mix in the eggs, evaporated milk, and vanilla. Stir in the flour, baking soda, and salt, then add the chocolate chips.
   Uses: 2 eggs
   Uses: 1 cup evaporated milk
   Uses: 1 tsp vanilla
   Uses: 2 3/4 cups flour
   Uses: 1/2 tsp soda
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt
   Uses: 1 cup chocolate chips

3. Drop spoonfuls of dough onto a baking sheet and bake at 350°F until set.

recipes.title: Creamy Vegetables
recipes.instructions: Peel carrots and slice into thin carrot sticks.  Cut broccoli into small bite size pieces.  Slice onions very thin.  Cook in pressure cooker until pressure just begins to build.  Or steam until just barely done.  Drain vegetables and place in a 9x13 dish..  .Sauce.  Melt butter add flour and stir well.  Add milk and cook until thickened.  Add salt and softened cream cheese.  Pour over vegetables then sprinkle with grated cheese and then bake for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Crepes
recipes.instructions:
1. Combine all the batter ingredients in a bowl or blender and beat until smooth.
   Uses: 1 cup flour
   Uses: 1 tbsp sugar
   Uses: 2 egg
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups milk
   Uses: 1/8 tsp salt

2. Lightly grease a 6-inch skillet and heat it. Remove from the heat and spread about 2 tablespoons batter evenly in the pan.

3. Return to the heat. Brown on one side, then flip and brown the other side.

recipes.title: Crispy, Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 325°F. Grease cookie sheets or line with parchment paper.

2. Sift together the flour, baking soda and salt; set aside.
   Uses: 2 cups flour
   Uses: 1/2 tsp baking soda
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt

3. In a medium bowl, cream together the melted butter, brown sugar and white sugar until well blended.
   Uses: 3/4 cup unsalted butter (melted)
   Uses: 1 cup brown sugar (packed)
   Uses: 1/2 cup white sugar

4. Beat in the vanilla, egg and egg yolk until light and creamy.
   Uses: 1 tbsp vanilla extract
   Uses: 1 large egg
   Uses: 1 egg yolk

5. Mix in the sifted ingredients until just blended.

6. Stir in the chocolate chips by hand using a wooden spoon.
   Uses: 2 cups semisweet chocolate chip

7. Drop cookie dough 1/4 cup at a time (for giant cookies) or a tablespoon at a time (for smaller cookies) onto the prepared cookie sheets. Cookies should be about 3 inches apart.

8. Bake larger cookies for 15 to 17 minutes, or 10 to 12 minutes for smaller ones (check your cookies before they're done; depending on your scoop size, your baking time will vary) in the preheated oven, or until the edges are lightly toasted. Cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to wire racks to cool.

recipes.title: Crown Jewel Jello

ingredients.name: jello - line
ingredients.display_text: 4 3 oz package jello - line (cherry orange lemon)

recipes.instructions:
1. Prepare the three gelatin flavors other than lemon separately. For each flavor, dissolve one package in 1 cup boiling water, stir in ½ cup cold water, and pour into an 8-inch square pan. Chill until very firm.
   Uses: 3 packages flavored gelatin (3 oz each, other than lemon)
   Uses: 1 cup boiling water and 1/2 cup cold water per flavor

2. Stir the lemon gelatin and sugar into 1 cup boiling water until dissolved. Stir in the pineapple juice and chill until slightly thickened.
   Uses: 1 package lemon gelatin (3 oz)
   Uses: 1 cup boiling water
   Uses: 1/4 cup sugar
   Uses: 1/2 cup pineapple juice

3. Cut the first three flavors into small squares. Blend the whipped topping with the lemon mixture, then fold in the cubes and chill for 3 to 4 hours.
   Uses: 2 cups cool whip

recipes.title: Curried Carrot Soup

ingredients.name: pounds carrots
ingredients.prep_notes: scrubbed but unpeeled, cut into 1/2-inch thick rounds
ingredients.display_text: 2 pounds carrots (scrubbed but unpeeled, cut into 1/2-inch thick rounds)

ingredients.name: plain nonfat yogurt or light coconut milk
ingredients.display_text: 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt or light coconut milk (optional)

recipes.instructions:
1. Heat the oil over medium heat. Add the onion, celery, and garlic and cover the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is golden, about 5 minutes.
   Uses: 1 tbsp olive oil
   Uses: 1 medium onion (chopped)
   Uses: 1 rib celery (chopped)
   Uses: 1 clove garlic (chopped)

2. Stir in the carrots. Add the curry powder and ginger and stir almost constantly for 30 seconds.
   Uses: 2 pounds carrots (scrubbed but unpeeled, cut into 1/2-inch thick rounds)
   Uses: 1 tbsp Madras-style curry powder
   Uses: 1 tsp ground ginger

3. Pour in the broth and bring to a boil over high heat. Lower the heat to medium-low, partially cover, and simmer until the carrots are very tender, about 30 minutes.
   Uses: 5 cups reduced-sodium chicken broth

4. Purée with an immersion blender in the pot, or use a blender in batches and return the puréed soup to the pot.

5. If desired, stir in the yogurt or coconut milk and heat gently until hot. Season to taste.
   Uses: 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt or light coconut milk (optional)
   Uses: Salt (and freshly ground pepper)

recipes.title: Date Pinwheels
recipes.instructions:
1. Combine dates, raisins, sugar, water in pan; cook over low heat till thick and add the nuts and cool.
   Uses: 2 1/4 cups chopped dates
   Uses: 1/2 cup raisins
   Uses: 1 cup water
   Uses: 1 cup chopped nuts

2. Cream shortening, sugar, add eggs.
   Uses: 1 cup shortening
   Uses: 3 eggs

3. Sift together dry ingredients; add to creamed mixture, mix well.

4. Chill thoroughly.

5. Divide the mixture into 2 parts, roll out to rectangles little less than 1/2" thick.

6. Spread each with some date filling and roll as for jelly roll into two long rolls.

7. Chill again over night, if possible.

8. Cut with sharp knife or thread. Bake at 375° till light brown around edges.

recipes.title: Doug's Chilli

ingredients.name: water drained form boiled pinto beans
ingredients.display_text: 30 oz water drained form boiled pinto beans

recipes.instructions:
1. Brown the ground chuck with the onion, salt, and black pepper.
   Uses: 10 lb ground chuck
   Uses: 1 cup onion (chopped)
   Uses: 1 tsp salt
   Uses: 1/2 tsp black pepper

2. Add the cumin, chili powder, oregano, seasoned pepper, Season-All, crushed red pepper, ground red pepper, and garlic. Simmer for 30 minutes.
   Uses: 3 tbsp cumin
   Uses: 10 tbsp chili powder
   Uses: 1 tsp whole oregano
   Uses: 1 tsp seasoned pepper
   Uses: 1 tsp season-all
   Uses: 1 tsp crushed red pepper
   Uses: 1 tsp ground red pepper
   Uses: 1 1/2 tsp garlic (minced)

3. Add the jalapeños, stewed tomatoes, whole tomatoes, tomato sauce, and water from cooked pinto beans. Simmer for about 3 hours.
   Uses: 3 jalapeno pepper (finely chopped)
   Uses: 3 1/2 cups stewed tomatoes
   Uses: 1 3/4 cups whole tomato
   Uses: 2 cans tomatoe sauce
   Uses: 30 oz water drained form boiled pinto beans

4. Save the cooked beans for another dish. The original uses only their cooking liquid in the chili.

recipes.title: Dump Cake
recipes.instructions:
1. In a 9x13 inch pan layer the pineapple, pie filling, cake mix, and nuts.
   Uses: 1 can tart cherry pie filling
   Uses: 1 box yellow cake mix
   Uses: 1 cup nuts (optional)

2. Melt butter and drizzle over top. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Serve hot or cold with whipped cream or ice cream.
   Uses: 2 sticks butter

recipes.title: Eclairs
recipes.instructions:
1. Boil water, add butter until melted.
   Uses: 1 cup water
   Uses: 1/2 cup butter

2. Add flour all at once, cook stirring vigorously until mixture forms ball around spoon (only takes a minute). Take off heat, cool 2 to 3 minutes.

3. Add eggs 1 at a time, beating vigorously after each addition. After last egg is added beat until shiny and smooth.
   Uses: 4 eggs

4. Drop by spoonful shaped to long oval.  onto greased cookie sheet.

5. Bake 450° for 10 minutes, 325° last 10 minutes. When cool split and add chilled pudding. Frost with chocolate frosting, chill.

6. Hint-  Pudding taste better is some cool whip or whipped cream is added. Use cooked pudding - it tastes better.

recipes.title: Edamame Salad

ingredients.name: (1 pound) package frozen shelled edamame
ingredients.display_text: 1 (1 pound) package frozen shelled edamame ((green soybeans))

ingredients.name: (15 ounce) can black beans
ingredients.display_text: 1 (15 ounce) can black beans (rinsed and drained)

recipes.instructions:
1. In a large serving bowl, whisk together the red wine vinegar, grapeseed oil, cilantro, lime juice, sugar, salt and garlic. Set aside.
   Uses: 5 tbsp red wine vinegar
   Uses: 3 tbsp grapeseed oil
   Uses: 1/3 cup chopped fresh cilantro
   Uses: 2 limes, juiced
   Uses: 1 tsp white sugar
   Uses: 3/4 tsp salt
   Uses: 2 cloves garlic (minced)

2. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the soybeans and boil for 3 minutes. Add corn to the boiling water and continue cooking for 1 more minute.
   Uses: 1 (1 pound) package frozen shelled edamame ((green soybeans))
   Uses: 3 cups frozen corn kernels

3. Drain very well, and pour into the bowl with the dressing.

4. Gently mix in the cherry tomatoes, green onions and black beans.
   Uses: 1 pt cherry tomatoes (quartered)
   Uses: 4 green onions (thinly sliced)
   Uses: 1 (15 ounce) can black beans (rinsed and drained)

5. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving to chill and blend the flavors.

recipes.title: Egg Noodles
recipes.instructions:
1. In a large bowl, stir together the flour and salt.
   Uses: 1 pinch salt

2. Add the beaten egg, milk, and butter.
   Uses: 2 eggs, beaten
   Uses: 1/2 cup milk
   Uses: 1 tbsp butter

3. Knead dough until smooth, about 5 minutes.

4. Let rest in a covered bowl for 10 minutes.

5. On a floured surface, roll out to 1/8 or 1/4 inch thickness.

6. Cut into desired lengths and shapes.

7. Allow to air dry before cooking.

8. To cook fresh pasta, in a large pot with boiling salted water cook until al dente.

recipes.title: Eggplant Curry

ingredients.name: ginger garlic paste
ingredients.display_text: 1 tbsp ginger garlic paste ((or make some))

recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C).

2. Place eggplant on a medium baking sheet.

3. Bake 20 to 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until tender.

4. Remove from heat, cool, peel, and chop.

5. Heat oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
   Uses: 2 tbsp vegetable oil

6. Mix in cumin seeds and onion. Cook and stir until onion is tender.
   Uses: 1 tsp cumin seeds
   Uses: 1 medium onion (thinly sliced)

7. Mix ginger garlic paste, curry powder, and tomato into the saucepan, and cook about 1 minute.
   Uses: 1 tbsp ginger garlic paste ((or make some))
   Uses: 1 tbsp curry powder

8. Stir in yogurt.
   Uses: 1/2 cup plain yogurt

9. Mix in eggplant and jalapeno pepper, and season with salt.
   Uses: 1 tsp salt

10. Cover, and cook 10 minutes over high heat.

11. Remove cover, reduce heat to low, and continue cooking about 5 minutes. Garnish with cilantro to serve.

recipes.title: Elsie's Smoked Beans and Meat
recipes.instructions: Put in a crock pot and heat.  If more liquid is needed add green bean juice or water.  Great for cold days.

recipes.title: Elsie's Fudge
recipes.instructions:
1. Stir together the fudge ingredients in a heavy saucepan before heating. This helps keep the cream from curdling.
   Uses: 4 cups sugar
   Uses: 2 tbsp light corn syrup
   Uses: 1 cup heavy cream
   Uses: 2 squares baking chocolate
   Uses: 1/4 cup water
   Uses: 1/4 cup butter
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt

2. Bring to a boil. Cover for 1 to 2 minutes to wash down the sides, then uncover and stir to prevent burning. Heat to 232°F.

3. Pour onto a cold, wet slab. Let cool until neither hot nor cold, then stir until the fudge starts to set. Add any nuts or flavoring at that point. For vanilla fudge, omit the chocolate and add vanilla.

4. For the frosting variation, bring the frosting ingredients to a boil, cover for 3 minutes, then wash down the sides with a wet paper towel. Heat to 232°F, cool, and stir. Microwave on low to soften before frosting.
   Uses: 4 cups sugar
   Uses: 1 cup half-and-half
   Uses: 1/2 cup cream
   Uses: 2 tbsp corn syrup
   Uses: 2 tbsp butter
   Uses: 2 squares chocolate

recipes.title: Elsie's Rolls
recipes.instructions:
1. Warm milk, add eggs, oil. Dissolve yeast in water.
   Uses: 5 egg
   Uses: 1 cup oil
   Uses: 4 packages yeast

2. Add to milk, stir in 3 to 4 cups. flour, beat till smooth.
   Uses: 4 cups milk
   Uses: 14 cups flour

3. Stir in rest. (Secret of good rolls is to keep rolls as soft as possible and still be able to knead them.)

4. Let rest 10 min. Knead for at least 10 min. more if necessary.

5. Let rise in warm place til double in bulk. Punch down, let rise again for 30 min. Roll out on floured board, shape as you please.

6. Let rise until double. Bake at 375. This dough is very versatile, it makes wonderful cinnamon rolls, orange rolls or can also be refrigerated and used later.

recipes.title: English Toffee
recipes.instructions:
1. Combine the butter, water, corn syrup, sugar, and pecans in a heavy saucepan. Cook over medium heat until the mixture turns brown.
   Uses: 1/2 lb butter
   Uses: 1/4 cup water
   Uses: 1/4 cup white Karo syrup
   Uses: 1 cup sugar
   Uses: 1 cup chopped pecans

2. Spread quickly on a cookie sheet and cool slightly. Add the chocolate chips and spread the melted chocolate over the candy.
   Uses: 1 cup milk chocolate chips

3. Let cool and break into pieces.

recipes.title: Ethiopian Cabbage

ingredients.name: potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.display_text: 5 potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes

recipes.instructions:
1. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.

2. Cook the carrots and onion in the hot oil about 5 minutes.

3. Stir in the salt, pepper, cumin, turmeric, and cabbage and cook another 15 to 20 minutes.
   Uses: 1 tsp sea salt
   Uses: 1/2 tsp ground black pepper
   Uses: 3/4 tsp ground cumin
   Uses: 1 tsp ground turmeric
   Uses: 1 head napa cabbage (shredded)

4. Add the potatoes; cover.

5. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook until potatoes are soft, 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Everyday Waffles
recipes.instructions:
1. Sift together dry ingredients.

2. Combine yolks, milk and oil; stir into dry ingredients.
   Uses: 2 beaten egg yolks
   Uses: 1 3/4 cups milk
   Uses: 1/2 cup oil

3. Fold in whites, leaving a few fluffs. Bake. Makes 3 10-inch waffles.
   Uses: 2 stiffly beaten egg whites

recipes.title: Fajita or Nacho Marinade

ingredients.name: canned chipotle peppers
ingredients.display_text: 4 canned chipotle peppers (with a little sauce)

ingredients.name: grated cheese
ingredients.display_text: 8 oz grated cheese (cheddar, Jack, or pepper Jack)

recipes.instructions:
1. Blend the olive oil, lime juice, chipotle peppers, garlic, and cilantro. Coat the steak with the marinade in a sealed bag or covered dish and refrigerate for at least 24 hours.
   Uses: 1/3 cup olive oil
   Uses: 2 limes
   Uses: 4 canned chipotle peppers
   Uses: 4 cloves garlic
   Uses: 1 handful cilantro
   Uses: 1 flank steak

2. Preheat the oven to 350°F and heat a lightly oiled grill, grill pan, or skillet. Grill the steak over very high heat for about 4 minutes per side. For grill marks, turn it 45 degrees halfway through each side. Set it aside to rest.

3. Heat a couple of tablespoons of olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the onions and peppers for 3 to 5 minutes, until softened and starting to char.
   Uses: 2 yellow onions
   Uses: 2 bell peppers
   Uses: Olive oil for the skillet

4. Slice half the steak against the grain and chop it into bite-sized pieces. Chop the cooked peppers and onions.

5. Arrange the chips on an ovenproof platter or sheet pan and cover with grated cheese. Bake for about 3 minutes, until the cheese melts.
   Uses: Sturdy tortilla chips
   Uses: 8 oz grated cheese

6. Top with the peppers, onions, and steak and warm in the oven for another minute at most. Serve with guacamole, salsa, and sour cream.
   Uses: Guacamole
   Uses: Salsa
   Uses: Sour cream

recipes.title: Fajitas
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix the apple juice, oil, onion, lime juice, garlic, and pepper. Add the steak, cover, and refrigerate for about 1 hour.
   Uses: 1 cup apple juice
   Uses: 1/2 cup oil
   Uses: 1 thin sliced onion
   Uses: 1 lime-juiced
   Uses: 1 clove garlic
   Uses: pepper to taste
   Uses: 1 1/2 lb skirt steak

2. Heat a charcoal grill or cast-iron skillet. Cut the meat into pieces about 6 inches long and grill quickly, turning once, no more than 3 to 4 minutes per side.

3. Slice thinly on the diagonal and serve in warm flour tortillas with sour cream, guacamole, and pico de gallo.

recipes.title: Famous Chocolate Cake
recipes.instructions:
1. Stir the lemon juice into the milk to make sour milk. Let stand for 5 minutes.
   Uses: 2 tbsp lemon juice
   Uses: 1/2 cup sour milk

2. Put all the ingredients except the boiling water in a large bowl. Mix until just moistened.
   Uses: 2 eggs (beaten)
   Uses: 2 cups sugar
   Uses: 1/2 cup shortening
   Uses: 1/2 cup cocoa
   Uses: 2 cups flour
   Uses: 2 tsp soda
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt
   Uses: 2 tsp vanilla

3. Mix in the boiling water until smooth. Pour into a 9-by-13-inch pan.
   Uses: 1 cup boiling water

4. Bake at 350°F for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: French Bread
recipes.instructions:
1. Dissolve 1/2 warm water with 2T. yeast. Put in large bowl;water, sugar, salt and oil.
   Uses: 2 tbsp yeast

2. Add 3 cups flour, beat well.

3. Add: yeast mixture, beat well.

4. Add 3 cups flour. Beat well, use a spoon. Leave in bowl.

5. Let rest 10 min. Beat down with spoon.

6. Repeat  5 times. On the 5th time divide dough into two parts.

7. Roll out into a 12-14" rectangle.

8. Roll up like jelly roll. Put on oiled cookie sheet with seam side down.

9. Let rise 30 min. Bake 375°F for 30 min. Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: French Dijon Dressing
recipes.instructions:
1. Whisk all ingredients together.
   Uses: 1/3 cup white vinegar
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt
   Uses: 1/2 tsp pepper
   Uses: 1 tbsp dijion mustard
   Uses: 1 tsp sugar
   Uses: 2 tsp thyme or tarragon
   Uses: 1/2 cup EVOO

2. Refrigerate until ready to use.

recipes.title: Frog Eye Salad
recipes.instructions:
1. Combine sugar, flour and 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Gradually stir in pineapple juice and eggs. Cook over moderate heat, stirring until thickened.
   Uses: 1 3/4 cups pineapple juice
   Uses: 2 eggs (beaten)

2. Add lemon juice.
   Uses: 1 tbsp lemon juice

3. Cool mixture to room temperature.

4. Bring water, remaining 2 teaspoons salt and oil to boil.
   Uses: 1 tbsp oil

5. Add acini di pepe. Cook at a rolling boil until acini de pepe is done.

6. Drain acini de pepe, rinse with water, drain again and cool to room temperature.

7. Combine egg mixture and acini de pepe.

8. Mix lightly but thoroughly.

9. Refrigerate overnight in airtight container.

10. Add remaining ingredients.

11. Mix lightly but thoroughly. Refrigerate until chilled in airtight container. Salad may be refrigerated for as long as a week in airtight container.

recipes.title: Frozen Hot Chocolate
recipes.instructions:
1. Chop the chocolate. Melt it in a double boiler over simmering water, stirring occasionally.
   Uses: 6 pieces chocolate

2. Stir in the hot chocolate mix and sugar until dissolved. Remove from the heat and gradually stir in ½ cup milk until smooth. Cool to room temperature.
   Uses: 2 tsp store-bought hot chocolate mix
   Uses: 1 1/2 tbsp sugar
   Uses: 1/2 cup milk

3. Blend the cooled chocolate mixture with the remaining milk and the ice on high speed until smooth and slushy.
   Uses: 1 cup milk (remaining)
   Uses: 3 cups ice

4. Pour into a large glass and top with whipped cream and chocolate shavings.
   Uses: whipped cream
   Uses: chocolate shavings

recipes.title: Fruit Dip
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix the strawberry yogurt and whipped topping until smooth. Serve with fresh fruit.
   Uses: 8 oz strawberry yogurt
   Uses: 8 oz cool whip

recipes.title: Fruit Pizza
recipes.instructions:
1. Spread a 1/4 inch thick layer of cookie dough in large cookie sheet. Bake until light brown. Cool.
   Uses: 1 batch sugar cookie dough

2. Mix sugar, cream cheese, vanilla, and cool whip.
   Uses: 1/2 cup sugar
   Uses: 8 oz cream cheese
   Uses: 1 tsp vanilla
   Uses: 1 large scoop cool whip

3. Spread over cookie and cover with favorite fruit.

4. Ideas. Kiwi, strawberries, blueberries, pineapple, peaches.

recipes.title: Fry Bread
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix the flour, baking powder, hot water, and salt.
   Uses: 3 cups flour
   Uses: 3 tsp baking powder
   Uses: 1 cup hot water
   Uses: dash salt

2. Roll very thin, cut into squares, and fry in a little oil in a skillet. Toss in sugar to serve.

recipes.title: Fudgesicle

ingredients.name: vanilla pudding mix
ingredients.display_text: 1 small package vanilla pudding mix (not instant)

ingredients.name: chocolate pudding mix
ingredients.display_text: 1 small package chocolate pudding mix (not instant)

recipes.instructions:
1. Cook the pudding mixes, milk, and corn syrup for about 10 minutes, until slightly thickened.
   Uses: 1 small package vanilla pudding mix (not instant)
   Uses: 1 small package chocolate pudding mix (not instant)
   Uses: 5 cups milk
   Uses: 1 cup corn syrup

2. Let cool, pour into molds, and freeze.

recipes.title: Ganache
recipes.instructions:
1. Melt butter add cream bring to almost a boil.
   Uses: 2 tbsp butter
   Uses: 3/4 cup cream

2. Pour over chocolate sit for about 5 minutes and wisk. Amy used milk chocolate but semi sweet or bitter sweet also are wonderful.
   Uses: 8 oz chocolate

recipes.title: German Apple Pancake
recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F. Spray small oval baker with nonstick cooking spray. For apple filling, peel, core and slice apples.

2. Melt butter over medium heat.

3. Add apple, brown sugar and cinnamon.
   Uses: 1/4 cup brown sugar
   Uses: 1 tsp cinnamon

4. Cook 20 minutes or until apple is tender and most of liquid has evaporated. Meanwhile, for pancake, combine flour, sugar and salt in bowl. Whisk together eggs, milk and melted butter.
   Uses: 1/2 cup flour
   Uses: 1/4 tsp salt
   Uses: 2 eggs
   Uses: 1/2 cup milk

5. Add egg mixture to flour mixture; whisk until dry ingredients are moistened.

6. Pour batter over apples in oval baker.

7. Bake 20 minutes or until puffed and golden brown.

8. I cook apples in a iron skillet and then just mix the batter all together in a blender and pour over apples and bake in skillet. When done flip onto a plate and sprinkle with powered sugar and serve with whipped cream.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Cake

ingredients.name: (1 ounce) squares German sweet chocolate or 1 cup
ingredients.display_text: 4 (1 ounce) squares German sweet chocolate or 1 cup

recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour 3 - 9 inch round pans.

2. Sift together the flour, baking soda and salt. Set aside. In a small saucepan, heat water and 4 ounces chocolate until melted.
   Uses: 1 tsp baking soda
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt
   Uses: 1/2 cup water

3. Remove from heat and allow to cool.

4. In a large bowl, cream 1 cup butter and 2 cups sugar until light and fluffy.

5. Beat in 4 egg yolks one at a time.

6. Blend in the melted chocolate mixture and vanilla.

7. Beat in the flour mixture alternately with the buttermilk, mixing just until incorporated.
   Uses: 1 cup buttermilk

8. In a large glass or metal mixing bowl, beat egg whites until stiff peaks form.

9. Fold 1/3 of the whites into the batter, then quickly fold in remaining whites until no streaks remain.

10. Pour into 3 - 9 inch pans Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean. Allow to cool for 10 minutes in the pan, then turn out onto wire rack.

11. To make the Filling: In a saucepan combine 1 cup sugar, evaporated milk, 1/2 cup butter, and 3 egg yolks. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly until thickened.
   Uses: 1 cup evaporated milk

12. Remove from heat.

13. Stir in coconut, pecans and vanilla. Cool until thick enough to spread.
   Uses: 1 1/3 cups flaked coconut
   Uses: 1 cup chopped pecans

14. Spread filling between layers and on top of cake. In a small saucepan, melt shortening and 1 ounce of chocolate. Stir until smooth and drizzle down the sides of the cake.
   Uses: 1/2 tsp shortening

recipes.title: German Pancakes
recipes.instructions:
1. Combine flour, salt, eggs and milk.
   Uses: 1 cup flour
   Uses: 1/4 tsp salt
   Uses: 6 egg
   Uses: 1 cup milk

2. Heat oven to 425°F. Place the butter in a 9 x 13 inch baking pan in oven. When butter is melted, pour the flour mixture over it. Do not stir. Bake for 25 minutes. Or until brown.

3. Cut and serve with syrup.

recipes.title: Ginger Glazed Mahi Mahi
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix the honey, soy sauce, vinegar, ginger, garlic, and olive oil in a shallow glass dish.
   Uses: 3 tbsp honey
   Uses: 3 tbsp soy sauce
   Uses: 3 tbsp balsamic vinegar
   Uses: 1 tsp grated fresh ginger
   Uses: 1 clove garlic
   Uses: 2 tsp olive oil

2. Season the fish and add it to the marinade, skin-side down if the fillets have skin. Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes.
   Uses: 4 mahi-mahi fillets
   Uses: salt and pepper (to taste)

3. Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Remove the fish from the dish and keep the marinade for the glaze. Fry for 4 to 6 minutes per side, turning once, until the fish flakes easily. Transfer to a platter and keep warm.
   Uses: 1 tbsp vegetable oil

4. Pour the reserved marinade into the skillet and bring to a boil. Continue cooking over medium heat until reduced to a glaze. Spoon over the fish and serve.

recipes.title: Gingerbread
recipes.instructions:
1. Combine flour, sugar, ginger, cinnamon - cut in butter, add egg.
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups flour
   Uses: 1 cup sugar
   Uses: 2 tsp ginger
   Uses: 1 tsp cinnamon
   Uses: 1/2 cup butter
   Uses: 1 egg (beaten)

2. Stir in molasses. Dissolve soda and salt in buttermilk add to mixture. Reserve 1/4 cup for topping.

3. Bake 350° in a greased 9 inch square pan for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Gingerbread House
recipes.instructions:
1. Cream the brown sugar and butter.
   Uses: 1 cup brown sugar
   Uses: 1 cup butter

2. Mix in the molasses, flour, cinnamon, ginger, and baking soda.
   Uses: 1/2 cup molasses
   Uses: 3 1/2 cups flour
   Uses: 2 tsp cinnamon
   Uses: 1 tbsp ginger
   Uses: 1 tsp baking soda

3. Roll the dough 1/4 inch thick. The original recommends rolling it directly onto a large cookie sheet, cutting out the shapes, and removing the excess dough.

4. Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes. For candy windows, take the pieces out after 10 minutes, add crushed Life Savers to the openings, and return the pan to the oven for the remaining 5 minutes.

5. Assemble the house with royal frosting. Decorate with candy.

Candy used in 2001- small sixlets package, pez, gum drops( big and little), M&M's (big and little),1 pkg. chicklets, 2 -fruit stripe gum, cinnamon bears, tootsie rolls, Brach carmel logs, Christmas runts,1-whoppers (small package), gummy bears, 1 small nerds, 1 small spree, peppermint rounds, candy canes, licorice rope, life savers, 1 chocolate kiss, 1 peanut butter cup, 3- 3 musketeer bars, 3 rolls necco Wafers, necco mint patties, 1 pkg Starburst, ice cream sugar cones, sprinkles, green rings-gummy, Wafers, 2 chocolate Santa, 2 chocolate snowmen.

recipes.title: Girl Scout Cookies - Thin Mints
recipes.instructions:
1. Combine the cookie ingredients in a large bowl, adding the water a little at a time until the dough forms. Cover and chill for 2 hours.
   Uses: 1 package chcoclate fudge cake mix
   Uses: 3 tbsp shortening (melted)
   Uses: 1/2 cup cake flour (measured then sifted)
   Uses: 1 egg
   Uses: 3 tbsp water

2. Preheat the oven to 350°F.

3. On a lightly floured surface, roll out a portion of the dough to just under 1/16-inch thick. Use a 1½-inch round cookie cutter or a lid from a spice container (Schilling brand works well) to cut the dough into rounds. Arrange the rounds on a baking sheet lightly coated with nonstick cooking spray. Bake for 10 minutes. Remove from the oven and allow the wafers to cool completely.
   Uses: pam

4. Combine the chocolate chips, peppermint extract, and shortening in a large microwave-safe glass or ceramic bowl. Microwave at 50% power for 2 minutes. Stir gently, then microwave for an additional minute at 50% power. Stir again. If the chocolate is not completely smooth, continue microwaving in 30-second intervals, stirring after each interval, until smooth.
   Uses: 3 12 oz semisweet chocolate chips
   Uses: 3/4 tsp peppermint extract
   Uses: 6 tbsp shortening

5. Use a fork to dip each wafer into the melted chocolate. Gently tap the fork against the edge of the bowl to allow the excess chocolate to drip off. Place the cookies side by side on a baking sheet lined with wax paper. Refrigerate until the chocolate is firm.

Yield: 108 cookies (9 dozen).

recipes.title: Gnocchi with Tomato Basil
recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 475°F for the oven finish. Heat the oil in an oven-safe skillet until shimmering. Cook the gnocchi, stirring, until lightly browned, about 4 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
   Uses: 2 tbsp Olive oil
   Uses: 1 lb Gnocchi

2. Cook the onion until soft, about 3 minutes. Add the garlic and pepper flakes and cook for another 30 seconds.
   Uses: 1 Onion (chopped)
   Uses: 6 cloves Garlic (minced)
   Uses: 1/8 tsp Red pepper flakes

3. Add the crushed tomatoes and water. Cook for about 5 minutes, until slightly thickened.
   Uses: 1 can (16 oz) Tomato (crushed)
   Uses: 1/2 cup Water

4. Return the gnocchi to the skillet and stir in the basil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 5 to 7 minutes, until the gnocchi are tender.
   Uses: 1/2 cup Basil (chopped)

5. Top with mozzarella and bake until well browned, about 8 minutes. For a stovetop finish, stir in the cheese until melted.
   Uses: 1/2 cup Mozzarella

recipes.title: Golden Anniversary Punch

ingredients.name: frozen orange juice concentrate
ingredients.display_text: 1 6 oz can frozen orange juice concentrate

recipes.instructions:
1. Add water to frozen concentrates according to directions on cans. (If frozen pineapple juice is unavailable, use 1 large can of pineapple juice.)
   Uses: 1 6 oz can frozen pineapple juice

2. Add Chilled apricot nectar and lemon juice. Just before serving, spoon in sherbet. To keep carbonation, carefully pour ginger ale down the side of the bowl.
   Uses: 1/2 cup lemon juice
   Uses: 2 large bottle ginger ale (chilled)

recipes.title: Golden Chicken Nuggets
recipes.instructions:
1. Cut chicken into 1 x 1 pieces.

2. Mix egg, water, salt, and flour.
   Uses: 1 egg (slightly beaten)
   Uses: 1/2 cup water
   Uses: 3/4 tsp salt
   Uses: 1/2 cup flour

3. Dip chicken into batter.

4. Pour corn oil into pan. Carefully add chicken, fry 3-5 min. or until golden brown.

5. Drain. Serve with barbecue sauce, LaChoy Sweet & Sour Sauce or nippy pineapple sauce.

6. NIPPY PINEAPPLE SAUCEMix 1/2c. pineapple preserves, 2 T. prepared mustard and 2 T. horseradish in saucepan.

7. Cook 3 min. Makes 3/4 cup.

recipes.title: Good H2o
recipes.instructions:
1. Stir together the water, sugar, lemon extract, and citric acid in a punch bowl.
   Uses: 5 qt water
   Uses: 3 cups sugar
   Uses: 1 tbsp lemon extract
   Uses: 1 tbsp citric acid

2. Add ice. Serve with lemon slices floating on top, if desired.

recipes.title: Granola

ingredients.name: pure maple syrup or honey
ingredients.display_text: 3 tbsp pure maple syrup or honey

recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 250°F. Mix all the ingredients except the cacao nibs in a large bowl and spread them in a thin layer on a baking sheet.
   Uses: 1/3 cup raw pumpkin seeds
   Uses: 1/3 cup raw sunflower seeds
   Uses: 1/3 cup raw sesame seeds
   Uses: 2 cups organic rolled oats
   Uses: 2 tsp organic ground cinnamon
   Uses: 3 tbsp pure maple syrup or honey
   Uses: 3 tbsp organic coconut oil
   Uses: 1 tsp vanilla extract
   Uses: 1/2 cup organic raisins
   Uses: 1/2 cup organic dried cranberries

2. Bake for 15 minutes. Toss the granola, rotate the pan, and bake for 15 more minutes. Repeat until the granola is dry and light golden, about 1 hour total.

3. Let cool and stir in the cacao nibs, if using. Store in an airtight container.
   Uses: 1/4 cup raw cacao nibs (optional)

recipes.title: Granola Bars

ingredients.name: to 3/4 cup granulated sugar
ingredients.prep_notes: (use more for a sweetness akin to most purchased bars; use less
ingredients.display_text: 1/2 to 3/4 cup granulated sugar ((use more for a sweetness akin to most purchased bars; use less)

ingredients.name: oat flour
ingredients.prep_notes: (or 1/3 cup oats, processed till finely ground in a food process
ingredients.display_text: 1/3 cup oat flour ((or 1/3 cup oats, processed till finely ground in a food process)

ingredients.name: to 3 cups dried fruits and nuts and or puffed grai
ingredients.display_text: 2 to 3 cups dried fruits and nuts and or puffed grai ((total of 10 to 15 ounces)*)

ingredients.name: peanut butter or another nut butter optional)
ingredients.display_text: 1/3 cup peanut butter or another nut butter optional)

ingredients.name: honey
ingredients.display_text: 1/4 cup honey (maple syrup or corn syrup)

recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 350°F. Line an 8? x 8? x 2? pan in one direction with parchment paper, allowing it to go up the opposing sides. Lightly grease the parchment paper and the exposed pan, or coat with a non-stick spray.

2. Stir together all the dry ingredients, including the fruit and nuts.

3. In a separate bowl, whisk together the vanilla, melted butter or oil, liquid sweeteners and water.
   Uses: 1 tsp vanilla extract ((optional))
   Uses: 6 tbsp melted butter
   Uses: 1 tbsp water

4. Toss the wet ingredients with the dry (and peanut butter, if you’re using it) until the mixture is evenly crumbly.

5. Spread in the prepared pan, pressing them in firmly to ensure they are molded to the shape of the pan. (A piece of plastic wrap can help with this, as you press down on the back of it.)

6. Bake the bars for 30 to 40 minutes, until they’re brown around the edges — don’t be afraid to get a little color on the tops too. They’ll still seem soft and almost underbaked when you press into the center of the pan but do not worry, they’ll set completely once completely cool.

7. Cool the bars in their pan completely on a cooling rack. (Alternately, after about 20 minutes you can use your parchment “sling” to lift and remove the bars, and place them in their paper on the rack to cool the rest of the way. This can speed the process up.)

8. Once cool, a serrated knife (or bench knife) to cut the bars into squares. [Updating to note, as many had crumbling issues:] If bars seem crumbly, chill the pan of them further in the fridge for 30 minutes which will fully set the “glue”, then cut them cold.

9. To store, wrap the bars individually in plastic or stack them in an airtight container. In humid weather, it’s best to store bars in the refrigerator. They also freeze well.

10. *Suggestions: Dried cranberries, apricots, pecans, sunflower seeds, coconut, walnuts, sesame seeds, pepitas, drieda pples or even chocolate chips.

recipes.title: Great Lasagna
recipes.instructions:
1. Brown meat. Spoon off fat.

2. Add next 5 ingredients.

3. Simmer uncovered 30 minutes. Stir occasionally.

4. Cook noodles, drain, rinse.
   Uses: 10 oz lasagna noodles

5. Beat egg until foamy; add remaining ingredients except mozzarella. Layer 1/3 noodles in a 9x13 pan, 1/3 cottage cheese, 1/3 mozzarella cheese, 1/3 meat sauce.

6. Repeat ending with sauce then sprinkle with mozzarella cheese.
   Uses: 1 lb mozzarella cheese (grated)

7. Bake 375°F 1 hour. If assemble before and refrigerated, bake 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Green Smoothie

ingredients.name: or a whole lemon
ingredients.display_text: 1/3 or a whole lemon ((yep, peel and all))

ingredients.name: spirulina powder
ingredients.display_text: 1 tsp spirulina powder ((this is a blue algae))

ingredients.name: micro-scoops Stevia Powder
ingredients.prep_notes: (the KAL brand is the best flavor I've found)
ingredients.display_text: 2 micro-scoops Stevia Powder ((the KAL brand is the best flavor I've found))

ingredients.name: agave
ingredients.prep_notes: (once again a good quality, low temp processed)
ingredients.display_text: 1/8 cup agave ((once again a good quality, low temp processed))

recipes.instructions:
1. Blend the water, chia seeds, hemp seeds, fish oil, soaked almonds, and lemon for about 30 seconds.
   Uses: 2 cups water
   Uses: 1/8 cup Chia Seed
   Uses: 1/4 cup Hemp Seed
   Uses: 2 tsp cold pressed fish oil
   Uses: 1/2 cup soaked almonds
   Uses: 1/3 or a whole lemon ((yep, peel and all))

2. Add the collard greens, chard, and both kinds of kale. Blend for about 30 seconds.
   Uses: 3 large pieces collard greens
   Uses: 3 large pieces Swiss chard
   Uses: 3 large pieces curly kale
   Uses: 3 large pieces lacinato kale

3. Add the spinach, bean sprouts, spirulina, stevia, and agave. Blend for another 30 seconds.
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups spinach
   Uses: 1/3 cup bean sprouts
   Uses: 1 tsp spirulina powder ((this is a blue algae))
   Uses: 2 micro-scoops Stevia Powder ((the KAL brand is the best flavor I've found))
   Uses: 1/8 cup agave ((once again a good quality, low temp processed))

4. Add the strawberries, bananas, and any other fruit you like. Blend for 30 more seconds.

5. Tip: wash all your greens and fruits really well. You can also use frozen fruit like your bananas that have started to turn brown, just peel them and toss them in a freezer bag for smoothies later. The soaked/sprouted almonds should be soaked at least 24 hours but no longer than 48 hours; rinsing and changing their soaking water morning and night each day. They can then be stored in the fridge for about 4 days or dehydrate them (under 115) for 24hours and they keep longer.
Also an additional note on almonds. The almonds you buy commercially from a store may say "raw" but they have actually been pasteurized. The stores are required to sell pasteurized almonds due to a congressional law against selling raw foods. (thank you congress) so you need to seek out a source that actually purchases true "raw" almonds from the almond growers. Almonds are an amazing food and worth the effort to locate raw ones!!

recipes.title: Guacamole
recipes.instructions:

recipes.title: Guiltless Alfredo Sauce
recipes.instructions:
1. Place milk, cream cheese, flour, and salt in a blender and blend until smooth. In a non-stick sauce pan, melt butter on med-high heat and add garlic.
   Uses: 1 tbsp Butter
   Uses: 3 cloves Garlic

2. Let the garlic saute for about 30 seconds, you don’t want to burn it.

3. Then add milk mixture to the pan. Stir constantly for about 3 or 4 minutes or until it just comes to a simmer. Keep stirring and let it cook for a few minutes more. It should be much thicker now.

4. When it’s nice and thickened remove the pan from the heat.

5. Add the cheese, stir it up and then cover immediately.

6. Let stand for at least 10 minutes before using. It will continue to thicken upon standing. Also, if you have leftovers in the fridge, the sauce will thicken almost into a solid. Just re-heat and add a little milk and it will be back to normal again.

recipes.title: Habaneros Pickles
recipes.instructions: slice pickes, combine all but garlic and 5 habaneros, put pickle mixture in jar with garlic and let sit for 3 weeks. Use left over juice to moisten next batch.

recipes.title: Hamburger Potato Casserole
recipes.instructions:
1. Peel and thinly, slice potatoes. Brown hamburger, season.
   Uses: 1 lb hamburger

2. Grease a 2 quart baking dish, dust lightly with garlic powder. Alternate thin layers of potatoes, onion and hamburger, ending with hamburger; season each layer.

3. Mix soup with milk.
   Uses: 1 can cream of mushroom soup
   Uses: 1 cup evaporated milk

4. Pour over potatoes. Bake at 375°F for 1  to 1 1/2 hour, or till done. Ten Minutes before removing from oven, sprinkle with cheese.
   Uses: 1 cup grated cheddar cheese

recipes.title: Hamburger Stroganoff
recipes.instructions:
1. Fill large pot with 3 quarts of water, add 2 teaspoon salt.

2. Bring to boil, add the noodles. Cook until noodles are done, drain. While noodles are cooking start the hamburger to brown. Brown hamburger, add onions and cook until they are transparent.
   Uses: 1 lb hamburger
   Uses: 1 small onion

3. Add cream of mushroom soup, cook for 5 minutes.
   Uses: 1 can cream of mushroom soup

4. Add sour cream and serve over noodles
   Uses: 1 cup sour cream

recipes.title: Hawaiian Delight Cake
recipes.instructions:
1. Beat cream cheese with 1/2 cup of the milk.
   Uses: 1 8 oz package cream cheese

2. Add rest of milk and then pudding mix; beat and spread over cooled cake.
   Uses: 1 package yellow cake mix

3. Chill 30 minutes.

4. Drain juice completely from pineapple. Put on top of pudding.
   Uses: 2 1 lb. cans crushed pineapple

5. Add whipped cream to cool whip and blend together.

6. Spread over tip of cake and sprinkle with coconut.
   Uses: coconut

7. Make cake according to package directions and bake at 350°F in 12 x 16 inch pan for 15-20 minutes.

recipes.title: Heavenly Hamburger Casserole
recipes.instructions:
1. Brown hamburger, seasoning with salt, pepper, garlic powder and sugar.
   Uses: dash garlic salt
   Uses: 1 tsp sugar

2. Add tomato sauce, and onions and simmer 15 minutes.
   Uses: 2 8 oz cans tomato sauce
   Uses: 6 green onion

3. Cook noodles; drain.

4. Cream together cream cheese and sour cream. Layer meat mix, cheese mixture, noodles, three times and top with shredded cheese.

5. Bake 350°F for 20-30 minutes.

recipes.title: Homemade Vanilla Pudding

ingredients.name: cream
ingredients.prep_notes: ( You can use all milk, but I like to use at least part cream fo
ingredients.display_text: 1 cup cream (( You can use all milk, but I like to use at least part cream fo)

recipes.instructions:
1. Combine sugar, salt, and cornstarch in a saucepan.
   Uses: 3/4 cup sugar
   Uses: 1/8 tsp salt
   Uses: 4 tbsp cornstarch

2. Whisk in cream, milk, and egg yolks, Cook over medium high heat, stirring constantly for 3-5 minutes or until thickened.
   Uses: 1 cup cream (( You can use all milk, but I like to use at least part cream fo)
   Uses: 2 1/2 cups milk
   Uses: 3 egg yolks

3. Remove from heat.

4. Stir in vanilla and butter. Whisk until butter is melted.
   Uses: 1 tbsp vanilla
   Uses: 1 tbsp butter

5. Strain through a fine mesh sieve to remove any lumps.

6. Cover with plastic wrap for storage. To prevent a skin or film from forming be sure to place plastic wrap up against the pudding, not just over the top of the bowl. Serve warm or cold.

recipes.title: Honey Butter
recipes.instructions:
1. Bring the ingredients to room temperature. Whip the butter with an electric mixer for about 2 minutes.
   Uses: 1 lb butter

2. Whip in the honey until well blended, then whip in the marshmallow crème.
   Uses: 1 lb honey
   Uses: 1 pt Marshmallow cream

3. Refrigerate between servings. This makes a large batch and can be halved.

recipes.title: Honey Chicken Stir-Fry
recipes.description: This all-in-one stir-fry with a hint of sweetness from honey is a big time-saver

ingredients.name: Chicken breast
ingredients.display_text: 1 lb Chicken breast (cut into 1 inch pieces)

ingredients.name: Frozen broccoli stir-fry vegetable blend
ingredients.display_text: 16 oz Frozen broccoli stir-fry vegetable blend

recipes.instructions:
1. In a large nonstick skillet or wok, stir-fry chicken and garlic in 2 teaspoons oil.
   Uses: 2 cloves Garlic (minced)

2. Add the honey, soy sauce, salt and pepper. Cook and stir until chicken is lightly browned and juices run clear.
   Uses: 2 tbsp Soy sauce
   Uses: 1/8 tsp Salt
   Uses: 1/8 tsp Pepper
   Uses: 2 tbsp Orange juice

3. Remove and keep warm.

4. In the same pan, stir-fry the vegetables in remaining oil for 4-5 minutes or until heated through.

5. Return chicken to the pan; mix well.

6. Combine cornstarch and cold water until smooth; stir into chicken mixture.

7. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 1 minute or until thickened. Serve over rice. 259

recipes.title: Honey-glazed Pineapple Carrots
recipes.instructions:
1. Cut the carrots into 2-inch strips. In a microwave-safe dish, combine the carrots and water. Microwave covered on HIGH for 4-6 minutes, until carrots are tender.
   Uses: 1/2 cup water

2. Add brown sugar, butter, honey, and pineapple. Mix well and microwave covered for an additional 2 minutes. Sprinkle with chipped chives or parsley as garnish.
   Uses: 1/2 cup brown sugar
   Uses: 2 tbsp butter
   Uses: 1 tbsp honey
   Uses: 1/3 cup crushed pineapple
   Uses: chives or parsley for garnish

recipes.title: Hot Clam Dip
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix all but clams and cheese with mixer until smooth.

2. Add drained clams.
   Uses: 1 can minced clams

3. Mix with spoon and pour into a Pyrex dish or glass pie plate. Sprinkle with cheese and paprika. Bake at 350°F for 20 Minutes. Serve with carrots or tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Hummus

   Uses: pepper

recipes.title: Indian Vegetable Curry

ingredients.name: cans
ingredients.prep_notes: (15 oz) garbanzo beans, rinsed and drained
ingredients.display_text: 2 cans ((15 oz) garbanzo beans, rinsed and drained)

recipes.instructions:
1. Cook onion and carrot in oil for cook 5 minutes or until tender.
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups onion (chopped)
   Uses: 1 cup carrots (sliced 1/4 inch thick)
   Uses: 1 tbsp olive oil

2. Add curry powder, sugar, ginger, and garlic; cook 1 minutes, stirring constantly.
   Uses: 1 tbsp curry powder
   Uses: 1 tsp brown sugar
   Uses: 1 tsp grated fresh ginger

3. Place mixture in crock pot.

4. Stir in next 7 ingredients. Cook on high for 6 hours or until vegetables are tender.

5. Add spinach and coconut
   Uses: 3 cups fresh baby spinach

recipes.title: Italian Beef

ingredients.name: Good Seasons Italian Salad Dressing Mix
ingredients.display_text: 3 packages Good Seasons Italian Salad Dressing Mix

recipes.instructions:
1. Cook the roast covered at 325°F for about 4 hours. Cool and slice it thinly. The butcher can slice it after it has cooled if you lack a slicer.
   Uses: 8 lb sirloin  tip roast

2. Combine the dressing mix, basil, Worcestershire sauce, oregano, bouillon, Italian seasoning, and water. Add the sliced roast and cook for at least 1 hour before serving.
   Uses: 3 packages Good Seasons Italian Salad Dressing Mix
   Uses: 2 tsp Basil
   Uses: 8 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
   Uses: 4 tsp Oregano
   Uses: 3 cubes beef bouillon
   Uses: 1/2 tsp Italian seasoning
   Uses: 4 cups water

3. Serve the meat with its cooking liquid.

recipes.title: Italian Sausage Soup with Tortellini
recipes.instructions:
1. In a 5 quart Dutch oven, brown sausage.

2. Remove sausage and drain, reserving 1 tablespoon of the drippings.

3. Saute onions and garlic in drippings.
   Uses: 1 cup chopped onion
   Uses: 2 cloves garlic (minced)

4. Stir in beef broth, water, wine, tomatoes, carrots, basil, oregano, tomato sauce, and sausage.

5. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer uncovered for 30 minutes.

6. Skim fat from the soup.

7. Stir in zucchini and parsley.
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups sliced zucchini
   Uses: 3 tbsp chopped fresh parsley

8. Simmer covered for 30 minutes.

9. Add tortellini during the last 10 minutes. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese on top of each serving.

recipes.title: Italian Zucchini
recipes.instructions:
1. Melt butter in large saucepan.
   Uses: 2 tbsp butter

2. Saute' onion until tender.
   Uses: 1/3 can onion (chopped)

3. Mix in tomato, basil, zucchini, sugar, water, lemon juice. Cover; simmer 10 min.
   Uses: 2 tbsp lemon juice

recipes.title: Jalapeno Relish
recipes.instructions:
1. Chop onions and red pepper.
   Uses: 2 cups onion
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups red pepper

2. Slice jalapenos.
   Uses: 5 cups jalapeno

3. Grate carrots.
   Uses: 2 cups carrots

4. Add rest of ingredients and boil for 15 minutes. Seeds of the jalapeno are what make the relish hot or not. If you want it hot add plenty of seeds, some if you want it medium and none if you want it mild.
   Uses: 1 tbsp mustard seed

recipes.title: Jam Bars
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix oats, flour, soda and sugar.
   Uses: 2 cups quick-cooking oats
   Uses: 1 3/4 cups sifted flour
   Uses: 1/2 tsp baking soda
   Uses: 1 cup brown sugar

2. Cut in shortening until mixture is crumbly.

3. Divide into 2 parts, pack 1/2 firmly in bottom of oiled 7 1/2 x 11" baking pan.

4. Spread jam evenly on top, then add remaining dough and pack firmly.

5. Bake in moderate oven 350°F, 40 min. Cool thoroughly.

recipes.title: Jam Thumbprints
recipes.instructions:
1. Cream butter and sugar till fluffy.
   Uses: 2/3 cup butter
   Uses: 1/3 cup sugar

2. Add egg yolks, vanilla and salt; beat well. Gradually add flour, mixing well.
   Uses: 2 egg yolk
   Uses: 1 tsp vanilla
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups flour

3. Shape into 3/4 inch balls; dip in egg whites, then roll in nuts.
   Uses: 3/4 cup finely chopped nuts

4. Place 1 inch apart on greased cookie sheet. Press down centers with thumb. Bake at 350° for 15 -17 minutes.

5. Cool slightly; remove from pan and cool on rack. Just before serving, fill centers with preserves. Makes 36.

recipes.title: Japanese Chicken
recipes.instructions:
1. Cut chicken into bite size pieces.

2. Sprinkle chicken with ginger, then dredge with flour. Brown chicken in butter.
   Uses: 1 tsp ginger
   Uses: flour
   Uses: 2 tbsp butter

3. Mix water, soy sauce, vinegar, and brown sugar.
   Uses: 2 tbsp cider vinegar
   Uses: 1/4 cup brown sugar

4. Pour sauce and then pineapple over chicken.
   Uses: 10 oz crushed pineapple

5. Turn down heat to low. Cover and cook for 30 to 45 min. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Jello Delight
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix cool whip and cheese add drained pineapple.
   Uses: 12 oz Cool Whip®
   Uses: 2 cups cottage cheese
   Uses: 6 oz crushed pineapple

2. Sprinkle dry jello into it and mix together. Put into refrigerator to set up.
   Uses: 6 oz jello

3. Kelly's favorite.

recipes.title: Jello Fingers
recipes.instructions:
1. dissolve jello and gelatin in boiling water.
   Uses: 3 3 oz package jello
   Uses: 1 package knox unflavored gelatin
   Uses: 3 cups water

2. Add cream and pour into 9x9. Put in refrigerator
   Uses: 1 cup cream

3. Description:  "Elsie Thackeray's layered jello fingers"

recipes.title: Karen's Chocolate Pie

ingredients.name: instant pudding mix dark chocolate
ingredients.display_text: 1 small instant pudding mix dark chocolate

recipes.instructions:
1. Soften the cream cheese. Mix it with the whipped topping, milk, and instant chocolate pudding mix.
   Uses: 8 oz cream cheese
   Uses: 8 oz Cool Whip®
   Uses: 2 cups milk
   Uses: 1 small instant pudding mix dark chocolate

2. Transfer to the graham cracker crust and freeze.
   Uses: 1 graham cracker crumb pie crust

recipes.title: Katheryn Parson's Butter Rolls
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix milk, sugar, and butter in bowl, heat until butter starts to melt. Make sure that milk is the temperature of a baby's bottle then add the yeast, 2 cups flour and salt.
   Uses: 2 cups milk
   Uses: 1 cup sugar
   Uses: 2 tbsp yeast
   Uses: 2 tsp salt

2. Mix throughly, add eggs and 2 more cups flour. Keep adding flour until all is added. Dough will be sticky.

3. Put in refrigerator over night. Take 1/2 of dough and divide that into thirds.

4. Roll each third into a circle brush with melted butter.

5. Cut into 1/8th roll up.

6. Brush with butter again and let rise for 4 hours. Makes 48 rolls.

7. Bake 400°F for 10 minutes.

8. 1/2 batch will fill a big cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Killer Brownies
recipes.instructions:
1. Melt butter, add sugar and cocoa.
   Uses: 1 cup melted butter
   Uses: 2 cups sugar
   Uses: 1/2 cup cocoa

2. Beat in eggs one at a time.
   Uses: 4 eggs

3. Add flour and vanilla.
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups flour
   Uses: 1 tsp vanilla

4. Pour into 9x13 greased pan; sprinkle on nuts; bake at 350°F for 25-30 minutes.
   Uses: 1/2 cup chopped nuts

recipes.title: Krieger Pasta Salad
recipes.instructions:
1. Cook the rotini according to the package and let it cool.
   Uses: 6 cups Rotini pasta

2. Chop the cooked chicken, cooked bacon, and vegetables. Toss with the pasta.
   Uses: 2 cups chicken
   Uses: 1/2 cup bacon
   Uses: 1/2 bell pepper
   Uses: 1/2 cup green onion
   Uses: 1/2 cup cucumber
   Uses: 1/2 cup red onion
   Uses: tomato

3. Mix in the ranch dressing and barbecue sauce and serve.
   Uses: 1 cup Ranch salad dressing
   Uses: 1/2 cup Barbecue Sauce

recipes.title: Lemon-Spinach Salad
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix oil and lemon juice and zest, salt, pepper, tabasco. Wisk well.
   Uses: 1 lemon - juice and zest

2. Add spinach, apples, craisins, oranges, and almonds. Serve.
   Uses: spinach
   Uses: 2 sliced apples
   Uses: 1 cup craisin
   Uses: 1 can mandarin orange
   Uses: sugared almonds

recipes.title: Lemon Bars
recipes.instructions:
1. Cream butter and 1/2 cup powdered sugar.
   Uses: 2 sticks butter

2. Stir in 2 cups flour.

3. Place in 9 X 13 inch pan.

4. Bake 20 minutes at 350°F. Beat eggs, 2 cups sugar and lemon juice for 5 minutes. Lightly mix or fold in 4 tablespoons flour.
   Uses: 6 tbsp fresh lemon juice

5. Bake 25 minutes at 350°F .

6. Sprinkle when done with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Lemon Cardamom Drops
recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°.

2. Beat 1 cup sugar, cream cheese, and butter till fluffy.
   Uses: 4 oz cream cheese
   Uses: 2 tbsp butter

3. Add egg, lemon zest, vanilla and lemon extract, beat till smooth.In a separate bowl combine flour, baking powder and cardamom, add to 1st. mixture til a soft dough is formed. Take the remaining 1/4 c. of sugar and drop ball of dough in, rolling them in the sugar.

4. Place balls on a greased cookie sheet 2 in. apart. Flatten the cookies with  bottom of a glass first dipped in sugar.

5. Bake 5-7 minutes or until bottoms are light brown.

6. Drizzle with icing.

7. Icing-3/4 cup powdered sugar, 3 Tablespoons milk, 1/4 teaspoon vanilla.

recipes.title: Lemon Chicken
recipes.instructions:
1. Pound the chicken to an even thickness. Dredge lightly in flour and shake off any excess.
   Uses: 4 boned and skinned chicken breast
   Uses: flour for dredging

2. Heat the butter and oil over medium-high heat until sizzling. Sauté the chicken, turning once or twice, until cooked through and the thickest part reaches 165°F. Set it aside.
   Uses: 2 tbsp butter
   Uses: 2 tbsp olive oil

3. Whisk flour into the pan and cook for 1 minute, until the mixture bubbles. Whisk the lemon juice into the stock, then whisk into the pan and reduce the heat to a simmer.
   Uses: 2 lemon's juiced
   Uses: 3 cups chicken broth

4. Return the chicken to the pan and heat through while the sauce thickens to your liking. Season with salt and ground white pepper.
   Uses: salt and pepper to taste

5. Serve on basmati rice with sauce spooned over the chicken. Garnish with chopped parsley and lemon slices.

recipes.title: Lemon Pie
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix the cold water with the cornstarch.
   Uses: 1/2 cup cold water
   Uses: 7 tbsp cornstarch

2. Bring the hot water and sugar to a boil. Stir in the cornstarch mixture and cook, stirring constantly, until thick and clear.
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups hot water
   Uses: 1 1/4 cups sugar

3. Stir a small amount of the hot mixture into the egg yolks. Stir the warmed yolks back into the mixture and cook for 3 more minutes.
   Uses: 3 egg yolks

4. Remove from the heat. Stir in the lemon zest, lemon juice, and butter. Cool, stirring occasionally, then pour into the pie shell.
   Uses: 2 grated lemon rind and juice
   Uses: 1 tbsp butter

5. Beat the egg whites until they form peaks. Gradually beat in the sugar, then fold in the lemon juice. Spread over the filling and brown the meringue.
   Uses: 3 egg whites
   Uses: 6 tbsp sugar
   Uses: 1 tbsp lemon juice

recipes.title: Lemon-Herb Zucchini Fettuccine

ingredients.name: Fettuccine
ingredients.prep_notes: (that's just 1/2 of a normal box like in the picture)
ingredients.display_text: 1/2 lb Fettuccine ((that's just 1/2 of a normal box like in the picture))

recipes.instructions:
1. Prepare grill. You could also do this on the stove top in a skillet, or a grill pan.

2. Place chicken in a zip-lock bag with the juice of one lemon, a couple tablespoons of olive oil, and a couple tablespoons of red wine vinegar. Smoosh around and set bag aside while you get your other things ready.
   Uses: 2 lemons
   Uses: 2 tsp Red Wine Vinegar

3. (If you've got time to spare, let the chicken marinade for 30 minutes, if you don't, just take what you can get. I did mine for 15 min and it was great.)

4. slice the zucchini in half length-wise if grilling. Or chop to cook in pan.

5. Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
   Uses: Salt (and Pepper)

6. Press, or finely mince garlic cloves. In a small sauce pan on the stove, place 1/4 C olive oil and add garlic.
   Uses: 5 6 cloves garlic

7. Turn burner onto low-med heat. It shouldn't be popping and frying, it should just slowly warm, infusing the oil with the garlic and removing that zing fresh garlic has.

8. Remove chicken from bag and salt and pepper both sides.

9. Place chicken, and zucchini on grill.

10. While chicky and zuchs are grilling and pasta is boiling, chop herbs and get out cheese. Zest both lemons and juice the one that hasn't been juiced.

11. Reserve about 1/2 C pasta water.

12. Drain pasta and immediately place in a big bowl.

13. Place chopped zuch and chicken on top.

14. Add lemon zest, lemon juice, cheese, herbs, and garlic-olive oil mixture.

15. Now take some tongs and give everything a big toss. If you feel it needs more moisture, add a little of the pasta water, or a little more olive oil. This will make 4 generous servings.

recipes.title: Lentil Soup
recipes.instructions:
1. In a large soup pot, heat oil over medium heat. Add onions, carrots, and celery; cook and stir until onion is tender. Stir in garlic, bay leaf, oregano, and basil; cook for 2 minutes.
   2. Stir in lentils, and add water and tomatoes. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer for at least 1 hour. When ready to serve stir in spinach, and cook until it wilts. Stir in vinegar, and season to taste with salt and pepper, and more vinegar if desired.
 Serve with cornbread

recipes.title: London Broil
recipes.instructions:
1. Prick the steak with a fork to tenderize it.
   Uses: 3 lb london broil

2. Combine the soy sauce, sugar, water, and garlic in a gallon-sized bag. Add the steak and marinate in the refrigerator for up to 3 hours.
   Uses: 1 cup soy sauce
   Uses: 1 tbsp sugar
   Uses: 1/4 cup water
   Uses: 1 clove garlic

3. Broil or grill, then slice thinly to serve.

recipes.title: Lone Star Chicken Fried Steak
recipes.instructions:
1. Trim steak, tenderize, cut into 5 pieces.

2. Combine flour, salt and pepper. Dredge all steak pieces in flour mixture until lightly coated.

3. Combine beaten egg and milk.
   Uses: 2 egg

4. Dip steak into egg mixture and dredge again in flour.

5. Heat 1/2 inch of oil in a heavy skillet.

6. Place steaks in skillet and fry until golden brown on both sides. To make gravy, remove steaks to warm oven, retaining 6 tablespoons of drippings (or use bacon drippings).

7. Add 6 tablespoons flour. Cook and stir until flour begins to brown.

8. Add 3 cups hot milk and stir until thickened.

9. Season with salt and pepper to taste and pour over warm steaks.
   Uses: 1 tsp salt

recipes.title: Low Fat Pineapple Upside-down Cake

ingredients.name: pineapple rings in juice
ingredients.display_text: 1 can 20 oz pineapple rings in juice (drained)

recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350degrees. Spray 9x 13 inch pan with nonstick spray.

2. Place 2 tablespoons butter in pan and place in oven to melt; remove pan as soon as it is melted.

3. Sprinkle brown sugar over bottom of pan. Evenly distribute pineapple rings over brown - sugar mixture. Set aside.

4. Combine flour and baking soda in a small bowl and st aside.In large bowl, combine 1/4 cup butter and sugar until mixed well.
   Uses: 2 cups flour
   Uses: 1 tsp baking soda

5. Add egg whites one at a time.  beating 30 seconds after each addition.
   Uses: 4 egg whites or 2 eggs

6. Add vanilla extract and mix well.

7. Add half of flour and soda mixture, then half of buttermilk, mix and repeat. Spoon batter over pineapple - do not stir - then smooth the top.

8. Bake 40 minutes, or until sharp knife inserted in center comes out clean. Allow cake to cool 10 minutes, then turn upside down onto serving platter.

9. Remove any pineapple or sugar that sticks in pan and place it back on cake.

10. To make it a bit more fattening and a little bit more gooey. Increase butter to 1/4 cup and brown sugar to 1/2 cup for the gooey bottom.

recipes.title: Low-fat Chicken-tortilla Casserole

ingredients.name: reduced fat cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.display_text: 2 101/2 oz can reduced fat cream of mushroom soup

ingredients.name: boneless chicken breast
ingredients.display_text: 6 boneless chicken breast (cooked and cut up)

recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray a 9 by 13 inch pan with nonstick spray; set aside.

2. Spray small pan with nonstick spray and cook onion over medium-high heat until softened, adding water or chicken broth if needed.In a large bowl, add onion to soup, milk, sour cream and green chiles.In prepared pan layer 1/3 of the tortillas, then 1/3 of the chicken, 1/3 of the sauce and 1/3 of the cheese.
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups cheddar cheese (grated)

3. Repeat two or more times, ending with cheese.

4. Bake 30 minutes, or until hot and bubbling around the edges.

recipes.title: Lyndsay's Curry

ingredients.name: garbanzo beans
ingredients.display_text: 2 can (15 oz) garbanzo beans (rinsed and drained)

recipes.instructions:
1. Cook the onion and carrots in oil for 5 minutes or until tender.
   Uses: 1 tbsp olive oil
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups onion (chopped)
   Uses: 1 cup carrots (sliced 1/4 inch thick)

2. Add the curry powder, ginger, and garlic. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
   Uses: 1 tbsp curry powder
   Uses: 1 tsp grated fresh ginger
   Uses: 2 cloves garlic (minced)

3. Put the mixture in a slow cooker and stir in the garbanzo beans, potatoes, green pepper, green beans, black pepper, diced tomatoes, and vegetable broth.
   Uses: 2 can (15 oz) garbanzo beans (rinsed and drained)
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups baking potatoes (peeled and cubed)
   Uses: 1 cup diced green pepper
   Uses: 1 cup green beans (cut into 1-inch pieces)
   Uses: 1/4 tsp black pepper
   Uses: 1 can (14.5 oz) diced tomatoes (undrained)
   Uses: 1 can (14 oz) vegetable broth

4. Cook on high for 6 hours or until the vegetables are tender.

5. Stir in the spinach and coconut milk and heat through.
   Uses: 3 cups fresh baby spinach
   Uses: 1 cup light coconut milk

6. Serve with lemon wedges.
   Uses: 4 lemon wedges
recipes.source_warning: Some directions were reconstructed from an incomplete source. They have not been verified by the family.

recipes.title: Magic Mix

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.display_text: 1 cup butter (at room temperature and cubed)

recipes.instructions:
1. Combine dry milk, flour and butter into a large bowl.
   Uses: 1 cup butter (at room temperature and cubed)

2. Mix with electric hand mixer until it resembles cornema. Keep mix tightly covered in the refrigerator for up to six months. Yield: 5 cups.

3. To make alfredo use 1 cup water, 2/3 cup mix and parmeasen to taste.

4. Heat on medium high heat and stir  quickly.

5. add cheese after cooled.

recipes.title: Mama Stamber's Cranberry Relish Recipe
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix the cranberries, onion, sugar, sour cream, and horseradish. Freeze.
   Uses: 2 cups raw cranberries
   Uses: 1 small onion
   Uses: 1/2 cup sugar
   Uses: 3/4 cup sour cream
   Uses: 2 tbsp horseradish

2. Move to the refrigerator to thaw on Thanksgiving morning. Makes 1½ pints.

recipes.title: Mango Quinoa

ingredients.name: cooked quinoa* at room temperature
ingredients.display_text: 2 cups cooked quinoa* at room temperature (or chilled)

recipes.instructions:
1. Put the cooked quinoa in a large bowl. The quinoa can be cooked in water or broth.
   Uses: 2 cups cooked quinoa* at room temperature (or chilled)

2. Add the mango, bell pepper, green onions, black beans, and cilantro.
   Uses: 1 medium mango (peeled and diced)
   Uses: 1 red bell pepper (diced)
   Uses: 6 green onions (thinly sliced)
   Uses: 1 14oz can black beans (drained and rinsed)
   Uses: 1 handful chopped cilantro ((about 1/2 cup))

3. Whisk together the vinegar, olive oil, and lime juice. Pour over the salad and toss. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
   Uses: 4 tbsp red wine vinegar
   Uses: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
   Uses: 2 tbsp fresh lime juice
   Uses: Kosher salt and freshly cracked black pepper to taste

4. Chill for at least 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Manicotti
recipes.instructions:
1. Par boil noodles 10 min. Cool in noodle tray.

2. Beat eggs and milk with fork, soak bread in this mixture - set aside. Brown beef and sausage.
   Uses: 1 1/2 lb ground beef
   Uses: 1/2 lb Italian sausage

3. Add salt and pepper. Italian seasoning and parsley.
   Uses: salt
   Uses: pepper
   Uses: 2 tbsp italian seasoning

4. Mix 1/2 cheese into egg, milk and bread mixture.

5. Pour into meat mixture, stuff noodles with meat filling.

6. Place stuffed noodles in greased casserole, side by side.

7. Pour sauce over the top. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Marinade
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix marinade. Take chicken, remove fat, pour sauce over. Marinate covered with foil for 1 hour.
   Uses: 1 cup soy sauce

2. Bake 1/2 hour, remove foil, baste, cook until done. Or can marinate over night. Shake every once in a while.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix all the ingredients and transfer to a loaf pan.
   Uses: 1 lb ground beef
   Uses: 1/2 cup oatmeal
   Uses: 1/2 cup barbecue sauce
   Uses: 1/4 cup onion (chopped)
   Uses: 1 egg
   Uses: salt
   Uses: pepper

2. Bake at 350°F for 1 hour. Check that the center reaches 160°F.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Pepper Salad

ingredients.name: a red onion
ingredients.prep_notes: cut into a 1/2-inch dice (use less if your onion is huge)
ingredients.display_text: 1/2 a red onion (cut into a 1/2-inch dice (use less if your onion is huge))

ingredients.name: to 1/2 cup pitted kalmata olives and/or Spanish ol
ingredients.display_text: 1/4 to 1/2 cup pitted kalmata olives and/or Spanish ol

recipes.instructions:
1. Swish together the red wine vinegar, water, kosher salt and sugar in a small bowl until the salt and sugar are dissolved.

2. Add the red onion and set it aside. Meanwhile, time to practice your knife skills. Core and seed your bell peppers and chop them into 1/2-inch pieces.
   Uses: 1/2 a red onion (cut into a 1/2-inch dice (use less if your onion is huge))

3. Chop the cucumber and feta into similarly-sized chunks. Put your peppers, cucumber, feta and olives in a large bowl. By now, your onions will have lightly pickled, both sweetening and softening their blow.
   Uses: 1-2 cucumbers (sliced 1/2 inch thick)

4. Drain them and add them to the other vegetables in the large bowl, but reserve the vinegar mixture.

5. Pour a quarter cup of the vinegar mixture over the salad, then drizzle with olive oil.
   Uses: 1/4 cup olive oil

6. Season generously with salt and freshly ground black pepper, or to taste.
   Uses: 3 bell peppers (your choice of colors)

7. Toss evenly and serve at once, or let the flavors muddle together in the fridge for a few hours.

recipes.title: Mexican Bean Salad

ingredients.name: (15 ounce) can black beans
ingredients.display_text: 1 (15 ounce) can black beans (rinsed and drained)

ingredients.name: (15 ounce) can cannellini beans
ingredients.display_text: 1 (15 ounce) can cannellini beans (drained and rinsed)

recipes.instructions:
1. In a large bowl, combine beans, bell peppers, frozen corn, and red onion.
   Uses: 1 red onion (chopped)

2. In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, lime juice, lemon juice, sugar, salt, garlic, cilantro, cumin, and black pepper.
   Uses: 2 tbsp fresh lime juice
   Uses: 1 tbsp lemon juice
   Uses: 2 tbsp white sugar
   Uses: 1 tbsp salt
   Uses: 1 clove crushed garlic
   Uses: 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro
   Uses: 1/2 tbsp ground cumin

3. Season to taste with hot sauce and chili powder.
   Uses: 1/2 tsp chili powder

4. Pour olive oil dressing over vegetables; mix well.
   Uses: 1/2 cup olive oil

5. Chill thoroughly, and serve cold.

recipes.title: Minestrone Hamburger Soup
recipes.instructions:
1. Brown beef and onion in large pan.
   Uses: 1 lb ground beef
   Uses: 1 cup onion (diced)

2. Add potatoes, carrots, celery, cabbage and tomatoes.
   Uses: 2 cups potatoes (diced)
   Uses: 1 cup carrots (diced)
   Uses: 1/2 cup celery (diced)
   Uses: 1 cup cabbage (shredded)
   Uses: 1 pound can tomatoes

3. Bring to boil.

4. Sprinkle rice into mixture.

5. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer 1 hour.

recipes.title: Moist Corn Bread
recipes.instructions:
1. Melt the butter and mix in the sugar. Add the eggs, beating well after each addition.
   Uses: 1/2 cup butter
   Uses: 1/3 cup sugar
   Uses: 2 egg

2. Stir the soda into the buttermilk, then stir into the egg mixture.
   Uses: 1/2 tsp baking soda
   Uses: 1 cup buttermilk (or milk + 1 T. Vinegar)

3. Combine the salt, flour, and cornmeal. Stir briefly into the wet mixture.
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt
   Uses: 1 cup flour
   Uses: 1 cup cornmeal

4. Bake in a greased 8-by-8-inch pan at 350°F for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Mom's Sugared Popcorn
recipes.instructions: Cook to 240°F bring down with milk, bring back to 240°F till color you want.  Should be light brown.  Pour over popcornMakes 2 bowls of popcorn.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
recipes.instructions:
1. Remove biscuits from can; cut each into four pieces; combine sugar and cinnamon in plastic bag; place pieces of dough into bag; shake; remove the pieces from bag; stand on edge in a greased bundt pan.

2. Bring to a boil the butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar; pour over the biscuits; bake at 350°F for 20 min. or until done; cool slightly; turn onto a serving plate.
   Uses: 1/3 cup butter
   Uses: 1/3 cup granulated sugar
   Uses: 1/3 cup brown sugar
   Uses: 2 cans refrigerator biscuits

recipes.title: Moose Munch
recipes.instructions:
1. Place popped corn in extra large bowl. In a large saucepan melt butter over medium heat. When melted stir in brown sugar, corn syrup and salt. Stirring constantly until reaching a rolling boil. Stop stirring and let boil for 5 minutes.
   Uses: 1/2 cup light corn syrup
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt

2. Immediately remove from heat and stir in vanilla and baking soda. Mixture will foam up.

3. Pour immediately over popped corn.

4. Place on large jelly roll pan and allow to coll.

5. Melt chocolate in a double broiler or in the microwave.

6. Add nuts at this time them so that they are well coated or else they won't stick to the popped corn.
   Uses: 1 lb nuts

7. Pour melted chocolate over popped corn and begin to mix until well coated.

8. Let cook and place in an airtight container. This recipe will stay fresh for one week.If the pop corn is still sticky place it in a warm oven until dry.

recipes.title: Muddy Buddies
recipes.instructions:
1. Pour the cereal into a large bowl and set it aside.
   Uses: 9 cups Chex or Crispex

2. Microwave the chocolate chips, peanut butter, and butter on high for 1 to 1½ minutes, stirring after 1 minute, until smooth. Stir in the vanilla.
   Uses: 1 cup semisweet chocolate chips
   Uses: 1/2 cup peanut butter
   Uses: 1/4 cup butter
   Uses: 1 tsp vanilla

3. Pour the chocolate mixture over the cereal and stir until evenly coated.

4. Transfer to a jumbo resealable bag with the powdered sugar. Seal and shake until all the pieces are coated.
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups powdered sugar

recipes.title: Muesli - Karen
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix the ingredients.
   Uses: 3-4 cups oatmeal
   Uses: 2 cups barley flakes
   Uses: 2 cups spelt flakes
   Uses: 1-2 cups raisins
   Uses: 1 cup peanuts
   Uses: 1 cup hazelnuts
   Uses: 1/2-1 cup flax seed
   Uses: 1 cup sunflower seeds
   Uses: dried apples

2. Store in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Mushroom Risotto

ingredients.name: pearl barly or Abroio Rice
ingredients.display_text: 1 cup pearl barly or Abroio Rice

ingredients.name: dry white wine
ingredients.display_text: 3/4 cup dry white wine ((or however you choose substitute it))

ingredients.name: freshly grated Parmesan or Pecorino
ingredients.display_text: 1/2 cup freshly grated Parmesan or Pecorino

ingredients.name: finely chopped parsley or thyme
ingredients.display_text: 1/4 cup finely chopped parsley or thyme

recipes.instructions:
1. Have the stock at a simmer.

2. Heat the oil in a heavy wide pan or soup pot.
   Uses: 2 tbsp olive oil

3. Add the onion and garlic an cook over medium heat until the onion is translucent, about 4 minutes.

4. Add the barley and cook for 1 minutes, stirring to coat the grains. Raise the heat a little and the wine, and cook, stirring frequently until the wine is nearly absorbed.

5. Add 2 1/2 cups of the stock, cover the pot and simmer until the stock is nearly absorbed.

6. Now start adding stock 1/2 cup at a time, stirring more or less constantly and waiting for each addition to be absorbed before adding more. After about 4 minutes the barley should be tender and the dish thick and creamy. You may not need to use the full amount of stock.

7. Stir in the butter, cheese, half of the parsley and lemon juice to taste. Taste for salt and season with pepper. Serve garnished with the remaining parsley.
   Uses: pepper

8. Heat a small skillet.

9. Add the butter, as the foam begins to subside add the shallot. When it begins to look tender- 2 minutes, add the mushrooms, cook until the release the liquid- about 8 minutes.
   Uses: 8 oz cremini mushrooms (sliced or quartered)

10. If they begin to stick and brown too much add a little bit of water, stock, white wine or whatever you choose to scrape the fond up and continue cooking. When mushrooms have finished cooking add the vinegar and turn off the heat. Taste for salt and pepper and garnish with thyme.
   Uses: 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar

recipes.title: Never Fail Flaky Pie Crust
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix flour and salt cut in shortening until fine crumb like texture.
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups flour
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt
   Uses: 2/3 cup shortening
