2. Beat egg, water and vinegar; add flour mixture and roll into 2 pie crusts.

recipes.title: Nichole Blair's Couscous
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix all the ingredients together.
   Uses: 3 cups Couscous (cooked)
   Uses: 10 oz frozen edamame ((cooked and cooled))
   Uses: 1 cup grape tomatoes (halved)
   Uses: 3/4 cup italian or greek dressing
   Uses: 1/4 cup red onion
   Uses: 1/4 cup fresh italian parsley (chopped)
   Uses: 1 yellow bell pepper (chopped)

2. Refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours before serving.

recipes.title: No-Knead Rolls
recipes.instructions:
1. Instructions Dissolve 1/2 warm water with  1 T. yeast. Put in large bowl;water, sugar, salt and butter.
   Uses: 1 tbsp yeast

2. Add 3 cups flour, beat well.
   Uses: 3 cups flour

3. Add: yeast mixture, beat well.. Beat well, use a spoon. Leave in bowl.

4. Let rest 10 min. Beat down with spoon.

5. Repeat 5 times.

6. Let rise 30 min. Bake 375°F for 30 min.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cake
recipes.instructions:
1. Pour the boiling water over the oats and butter. Mix and let stand for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups boiling water
   Uses: 1 cup quick-cooking oats
   Uses: 1/2 cup butter

2. Beat both sugars with the eggs. Mix in the flour, baking soda, salt, and cinnamon, then stir in the oatmeal mixture.
   Uses: 1 cup light brown sugar
   Uses: 1 cup sugar
   Uses: 2 eggs
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups flour
   Uses: 1 tsp soda
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt
   Uses: 1 tsp cinnamon

3. Pour into a greased 9-by-12-inch pan. Bake at 350°F for 30 to 40 minutes.

4. Mix the topping ingredients and spread them over the warm cake. Broil for 5 to 10 minutes, until browned.
   Uses: 1/2 cup butter
   Uses: 1 cup chopped pecans or walnuts
   Uses: 1 cup coconut
   Uses: 1/2 cup sugar
   Uses: 1/4 cup evaporated milk (or milk)
   Uses: 1/2 tsp vanilla

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cranberry White Chocolate Chunk Cookies
recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°. Using an electric mixer, beat butter and sugar together in a medium mixing bowl until light and fluffy.
   Uses: 2/3 cup butter (softened)
   Uses: 2/3 cup brown sugar

2. Add eggs, mixing well.
   Uses: 2 large egg

3. Combine oats, flour, baking soda and salt in a seperate bowl.
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups oats
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups flour
   Uses: 1 tsp baking soda
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt

4. Add to butter mixture in several additions, mixing well after each addition.

5. Stir in sweetened dried cranberries and white chcocolate chips.
   Uses: 2/3 cup white chocolate chip

6. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until golden brown. Cool on wire rack. Makes approzimately 2 1/2 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Pancakes
recipes.instructions:
1. Combine flour, oats, brown sugar, soda and salt.
   Uses: 1 cup quick-cooking oats
   Uses: 1 tbsp brown sugar
   Uses: 1 tsp baking soda
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt

2. Whisk in eggs, oil, and buttermilk and mix just until dry ingredients are well moistened; thin with water if needed.
   Uses: 2 egg (well beaten)
   Uses: 1 tbsp oil

3. Spread batter on hot griddle, turning one. Yield:  16 4 inch pancakes.

4. *Buttermilk substitute:  Put 2 tablespoons cider vinegar or lemon juice in 2 cup measure; add milk to equal 2 cups. Stir and let stand a few minutes to thicken. * To use dry milk:  Mix 1/2 cup dry milk with dry ingredients.

5. Put 2 tablespoons vinegar or lemon juice in cup; add water to equal scant 2 cups buttermilk. Note:  Pancakes will be thinner when using either of these substitutions.

6. These pancakes are great with cider syrup and fried apples.

recipes.title: Orange Slice Oatmeal Cookies
recipes.instructions:
1. Reserve 1/2 cup flour. Put cut up orange slices into reserved flour.
   Uses: 1 cup candy orange slices

2. Sift remaining flour, baking powder and soda and salt together.
   Uses: 1/2 tsp baking powder
   Uses: 1/2 tsp baking soda
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt

3. Cream shortening and sugar, beat in egg and vanilla.
   Uses: 1 egg
   Uses: 1 tsp vanilla

4. Stir in sifted dry ingredients.

5. Add oatmeal, coconut, and floured orange pieces. Mix well.
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups oatmeal
   Uses: 1 cup coconut

6. Drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheet or roll into ball and press out.

7. Bake 350° for 8 - 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Orange Sugar Ring
recipes.instructions:
1. Separate the biscuits. Combine the melted butter and orange juice in one bowl. In another, mix the brown sugar, granulated sugar, orange peel, and nutmeg.
   Uses: 2 packages refrigerator biscuits
   Uses: 1/4 cup butter (melted)
   Uses: 2 tbsp orange juice
   Uses: 1/2 cup brown sugar (packed)
   Uses: 1/2 cup sugar
   Uses: 1 tsp orange peel (grated)
   Uses: 1/4 tsp nutmeg

2. Dip the biscuits into the butter mixture, then into the sugar mixture. Stand them upright in a well-greased Bundt pan.

3. Bake at 450°F for 12 to 15 minutes without overbaking. Turn out onto a plate.

recipes.title: Oven Fried Chicken
recipes.instructions:
1. Wash and dry chicken.

2. Combine flour and seasonings in paper bay. Shake 2 or 3 pieces chicken at a time in flour mixture. In shallow pan in oven melt butter; remove pan from oven.
   Uses: 1/4 cup butter

3. Arrange chicken in pan in single layer, with skin side down.

4. Bake, uncovered, 30 minute; turn chicken pieces with tongs; bake 15 minutes or until brown and fork tender.

5. CREAM GRAVY:Pour drippings from baking pan into measuring cup. Measure 1/2 cup fat into skillet; add 6 tablespoons flour (left over from coating chicken plus more flour as needed). Stir over low heat, loosening brown bits from baking pan, till smooth.

6. Stir in 1 cup chicken broth and 1 1/2 cups half and half cream.

7. Cook, stirring in a little water. Serve with chicken.

recipes.title: Oven Potatoes
recipes.instructions:
1. Peel and rinse the potatoes, then cut lengthwise into eighths.
   Uses: 5 medium potato

2. Preheat the oven to 425°F. Melt the butter in a square cake pan without browning it. Add the potatoes and turn to coat.
   Uses: 3 tbsp butter

3. Bake for 30 minutes, until the undersides start to brown. Turn the potatoes and continue baking until soft inside and crisp outside. Salt and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Pasta con Broccoli
recipes.instructions:
1. Cook noodles in boiling water in medium saucepan until 1/2 done (about 4 minutes).
   Uses: 4 oz noodles (fettucine or linguini)

2. Drain and return to pan.

3. Add cream, butter, garlic, tomato sauce and broccoli and bring to boil over medium heat about 4-5 minutes. When noodles are done, stir in mushrooms to heat.
   Uses: 2 tbsp tomato sauce
   Uses: 1/4 cup sliced mushrooms

4. Remove and sprinkle with cheese.
   Uses: 1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese

5. Salt and pepper. Toss and serve.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad

ingredients.name: red and green bell peppers
ingredients.display_text: 1/4 cup red and green bell peppers (diced)

recipes.instructions:
1. Cook rotini noodles, drain, rinse, cool. Blanch carrots and broccoli, cool, add to rotini, then add rest of ingredients.
   Uses: 1 lb rotini noodles

2. Add just enough dressing to suit your own personal taste.
   Uses: light Italian dressing

recipes.title: Peach Cake
recipes.instructions:
1. Cream butter and brown sugar; stir in egg; add sifted dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk; stir in peaches.
   Uses: 1/2 cup butter
   Uses: 1 egg
   Uses: 1 cup buttermilk
   Uses: 4 peaches (peeled and diced)

2. Bake in 9 x 13 greased pan at 350°F for 30 -35 min. while still hot, add topping of 1/4 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
recipes.instructions:
1. Melt butter in baking dish while mixing batter. When butter is melted, pour batter over it and then spoon on the peaches. Bake at 350°F until brown or 1 hour. I use 1 qt. undrained peaches with 1 cup frozen blueberries or raspberries.
   Uses: 1 can peaches

recipes.title: Peach French Toast
recipes.instructions:
1. Over medium-low heat, stir brown sugar and butter until butter melts.
   Uses: 1 cup brown sugar
   Uses: 1/2 cup butter

2. Add water and cook until sauce is thick and foamy about 5 minutes.

3. Pour into 9x13x2 inch baking dish.

4. Let cool 10 minutes.

5. Place peaches on top of sauce.

6. Cover with bread, trimming to fit in one layer. Whisk together eggs, milk and vanilla.
   Uses: 5 large eggs
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups milk
   Uses: 3 tsp vanilla

7. Pour over bread. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350°F, uncovered, 40 minutes or until set and golden.
   Uses: 14 slices french bread

8. Cover with foil if browning too quickly. Serve with warmed reserved peach syrup, if desired. This is rich and yummy.

recipes.title: Peach Torte
recipes.instructions:
1. Arrange a rack in the lower third of the oven.

2. preheat the oven in 350.

3. In mixer cream 3/4 cup sugar and butter.
   Uses: 8 tbsp Butter

4. add the flour, baking powder, eggs and salt and beat the mixture well.

5. Place in 9 or 10 inch ungreased springform pan.

6. cover the top with LOTS of  peaches.

7. Mix the cinnamon with the remaining 1-2 tabls sugar and sprinkle over the top.
   Uses: 1 tsp Cinnamon

8. Bake for 45-50 minutes until the center tests done. remoe and cool.

9. (This can be frozen for several months well wrapped, to serve return to room tempature and reheat at 300 until warm.)

10. This works well with any stone fruit, plum etc)

recipes.title: Peach Upside Down Cake

ingredients.name: peaches cut into 1 in. wedges
ingredients.display_text: 4 large peaches cut into 1 in. wedges

recipes.instructions:
1. Topping-91/2 inch or 10 in. non-stick ovenproof skillet.

2. Mix sugar with 3T. water - boil swirling pan till starts to turn light brown.

3. Remove from heat.

4. stir in butter, lemon juice and nectar.
   Uses: 1 tbsp lemon juice
   Uses: 2 tbsp peach nectar

5. Cool slightly.

6. Arrange peach slices, (overlapping peaches)Cake - Sift flour, baking powder, soda and spices.
   Uses: 1 tsp baking powder
   Uses: 1/2 tsp baking soda

7. Mix egg, sugar, butter and extracts, beat 3 minutes until pale and smooth.
   Uses: 1/4 tsp almond extract

8. Mix egg and flour alternating with buttermilk.
   Uses: 2/3 cup buttermilk

9. Spread over peaches.

10. Bake 350 25-30 minutes.

11. Let sit 5 minutes - flip over.

recipes.title: Peek a Berry Boos
recipes.instructions:
1. Sift first 4 ingredient.

2. Cream sugars and butters.
   Uses: 1/2 cup butter

3. Add next 3  ingredients. Beat well, blend in dry ingredients, add 2 cups quick oatmeal.

4. Mix thoroughly.

5. Spread half into greased cookie sheet, spread layer of jam, spread second half of cookie dough.

6. Bake 400°F 15-20 min.

recipes.title: Peppermint Crunch Bark

ingredients.name: red and white hard peppermint candies
ingredients.display_text: 30 red and white hard peppermint candies

recipes.instructions:
1. Turn large baking sheet bottom side up.

2. Cover securely with foil. Mark 12 x 9 inch rectangle on foil.

3. Stir white chcoclate in metal bowl set over saucepan of barely simmering water (do not allow bottom of bowl to touch water) until chocolate is melted and smooth and candy thermometer registers 110.
   Uses: 30 red and white hard peppermint candies

4. Remove from over water.

5. Pour 2/3 cup melted white chocolate onto rectangle on foil. Using icing spatula, spread chocolate to fill rectangle. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup crushed peppermints. Chill until set, about 15 minutes.
   Uses: 17 oz white chocolate

6. Stir bittersweet chcoclate, cream and peppermint extract in heavy medium saucepan over medium low heat until just melted and smooth. Cool to barely lukewarm, about 5 minutes.
   Uses: 4 tbsp whipping cream
   Uses: 3/4 tsp peppermint extract

7. Pour bittersweet chocolate misture in long lines over white chocolate rectangle. Using icing spatula spread bittersweet chocolate in even layer. Refrigerate until very cold and firm, about 25 minutes. Rewarm remaining white chocolate in bowl set over barely simmering water to 110F.

8. Working quickly, pour white chocolate over firm bittersweet chocolate layer; spread to cover. Immediately sprinkle with remaining crushed peppermints.

9. Chill just until firm, about 20 minutes. Lift foil with bark onto work surface; trim edges.

10. Cut bark crosswise into 2- inch - wide strips. Using metal spatula, slide bark off foil and onto work surface.

11. cut each strip crosswise into 3 sections and each section diagonally into 2 triangles.

recipes.title: Pesto

ingredients.name: pine nuts or walnuts
ingredients.display_text: 3 tbsp pine nuts or walnuts (toasted and chopped)

recipes.instructions:
1. To make the pesto:In a blender or small food processor blend together all ingredients with salt and pepper to taste until smooth. Pesto keeps, covered and chilled, up to 1 week. Makes about 2/3 cup.
   Uses: 1 cup basil leaves
   Uses: 3 tbsp pine nuts or walnuts (toasted and chopped)
   Uses: 1 clove garlic
   Uses: 3 tbsp Parmesan cheese
   Uses: 1/3 cup olive oil

recipes.title: Pico de Gallo
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix all ingredients and place in covered bowl in refrigerator for 5 - 6 hours. Serve on fajitas, or tacos.
   Uses: 1 bundle green onions and stalks (chopped)
   Uses: 1 medium tomato (diced)
   Uses: 1 large anaheim pepper (finely chopped)
   Uses: 1 tsp salt
   Uses: 2 tsp fresh cilantro (chopped)
   Uses: 1 can rotel

recipes.title: Pizza Bites

ingredients.name: roll refrigerated pizza dough*
ingredients.display_text: 1 roll refrigerated pizza dough* ((or make your own))

ingredients.name: olive oil or melted butter
ingredients.display_text: 1 tbsp olive oil or melted butter

recipes.instructions:
1. You can use regular pizza dough, or thin crust.

2. Combine ingredients in a jar (preferably one with a sprinkle top) and shake.

3. Sprinkle on top of breadsticks or combine 1 1/2 Tbsp. seasoning with 1/2 c. of softened real butter and spread on a loaf of French bread (cut in 1/2 lengthwise). Wrap in foil and bake at 375 until butter's melted.

4. If you want, you could also pop it open-faced under the broiler for a few minutes so it gets brownish and crispy.

5. Preheat oven to heat specified on pizza dough package. Usually it's 400 degrees. If you make your own dough, 400 is usually a good heat as well.

6. Unroll your pizza dough onto a lightly floured surface. Pat or roll the dough so it's about 12" by 8". You're going to want to cut it into 24 squares, so just eyeball it if you need to. Use a pizza cutter to slice the dough into 24 squares (bet ya didn't see that one comin' did ya?)

7. Place cheese and desired toppings on each square. (Note that you're not putting the marinara sauce on the dough- it's for dipping after)  You guys are smart, right? Just eyeball how much. You just need to be able to enclose the toppings in the dough so keep that in mind.

8. When all of your dough squares have cheese and toppings on them, carefully lift up each square and wrap the dough around the toppings. Pinch to make sure each ball is sealed shut and then place them seam side down in a lightly sprayed pie pan (or similar sized dish).

9. Brush the tops of the dough balls with olive oil or melted butter (I've used both and there's not much difference in result) and then sprinkle with the garlic and Italian seasoning and top with Parmesan cheese.
   Uses: 2 tbsp grated Parmesan cheese

10. (In lieu of the Parmesan, garlic, and Italian seasoning you could  substitute this garlic bread seasoning.)

11. Cook them in the oven for about 15-20 minutes or until golden brown on top. Keep an eye  on them! Doughs vary, so I'd check them after even 10 minutes.

12. Serve warm with warmed marinara sauce on the side for dipping.

recipes.title: Pizza Dough - Sandra's

ingredients.name: to 5 1/2 cups unbleached all-purpose flour
ingredients.prep_notes: divided, plus additional for dusting (I often go half whole whe
ingredients.display_text: 4 1/2 to 5 1/2 cups unbleached all-purpose flour (divided, plus additional for dusting (I often go half whole whe)

recipes.instructions:
1. Whisk together yeast, 2 tablespoons flour, and 1/2 cup warm water in a measuring cup and let stand until mixture develops a creamy foam, about 10 minutes. (If mixture doesn’t foam, discard and start over with new yeast.) Stir together salt and 3 cups flour in a large bowl.
   Uses: 2 (1/4-ounces) packages active dry yeast
   Uses: 2 tsp salt

2. Add yeast mixture and remaining 1 1/2 cups warm water and stir until smooth, then stir in 1 cup more flour. If dough sticks to your fingers, stir in just enough flour (up to 3/4 cup), a little at a time, to make dough just come away from side of bowl.

3. (This dough may be wetter than other pizza doughs you have made.)

4. Knead dough on a lightly floured surface with floured hands, lightly reflouring work surface and your hands when dough becomes too sticky, until dough is smooth, soft, and elastic, about 10 minutes.

5. Divide dough in half and form into 2 balls, then generously dust balls all over with flour and put each in a medium bowl.

6. Cover bowls with plastic wrap and let dough rise in a draft-free place at warm room temperature until doubled, 1 to 1 1/4 hours.

recipes.title: Pizza Sauce

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.prep_notes: (just use the empty tomato paste can)
ingredients.display_text: 6 oz water ((just use the empty tomato paste can))

ingredients.name: sugar or honey
ingredients.prep_notes: (I usually use sugar because it's easier and hey, I think we'v
ingredients.display_text: 1 tbsp sugar or honey ((I usually use sugar because it's easier and hey, I think we'v)

recipes.instructions:
1. Empty tomato paste into a bowl and add water a few tablespoons at a time, stirring constantly until combined.
   Uses: 6 oz water ((just use the empty tomato paste can))

2. Add remaining ingredients, stir to combine, and allow to stand until ready to use. Covers two average-sized pizza; freezes extremely well.

recipes.title: Play Dough
recipes.instructions:
1. Cook over medium heat in a pot on the stove. Stir until the dough comes together.
   Uses: 1 cup all purpose flour
   Uses: 1/2 cup salt
   Uses: 2 tsp cream of tartar
   Uses: 1 cup water
   Uses: 1 tbsp vegetable oil

2. Let the dough cool for a minute, as in the original directions.

3. Knead in the food coloring and scent by hand on wax paper or in a large bowl.
   Uses: liquid (food coloring)
   Uses: 2-4 drops scented oil

4. Store in a ziplock bag or storage container.
recipes.source_warning: Non-food recipe. Original directions are incomplete.

recipes.title: Plum Torte
recipes.instructions:
1. Arrange a rack in the lower third of the oven.

2. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.

3. In an electric mixer, cream the 3/4 cup of sugar and butter.
   Uses: 8 tbsp unsalted butter

4. Add the flour, baking powder, eggs and salt and beat to mix well.
   Uses: 1 cup unbleached flour
   Uses: 1 tsp baking powder
   Uses: 2 large eggs
   Uses: pinch salt

5. Place in a 9 or 10 inch ungreased springform pan.

6. Cover the top with the plums.

7. Mix the cinnamon with the remaining 1 or 2 tablespoons of sugar and spinkle over the top.
   Uses: 1 tsp cinnamon

8. Bake for 40 to 50 minutes until the center tests done with a toothpick.

9. Remove and cool to room temperature or serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

10. Note. The torte may be regrigerated or frozen for several months, well wrapped. To serve return to room temperature and reheat at 300 degrees until warm.

11. This works well with any stone fruit.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Muffins
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix dry ingredients.

2. Mix egg, milk and oil.
   Uses: 1 egg
   Uses: 3/4 cup milk
   Uses: 1/4 cup oil

3. Combine, stir in poppy seed and lemon peel.
   Uses: 1 tbsp poppy seeds
   Uses: 1 tsp lemon peel

4. Grease 12 muffin cups.

5. Bake 400°F, 20 min or till golden.

recipes.title: Porcupine Meatballs
recipes.instructions:
1. Combine meat, rice, egg, parsley, onion, salt, pepper, and 1/4 cup condensed tomato soup.
   Uses: 1/4 cup rice
   Uses: 1 egg (slightly beaten)
   Uses: 1 tbsp snipped parsley
   Uses: 2 tbsp onion (minced)
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt
   Uses: dash pepper

2. Mix thoroughly; shape in about 20 small balls and place in skillet.

3. Mix remaining soup, water, and Worcestershire sauce; pour over meatballs, add sliced carrots.
   Uses: 1 tsp worcestershire sauce
   Uses: 4 carrots (sliced)

4. Bring to boil; reduce heat; cover and simmer 30 - 40 minutes, stirring every once in a while.

recipes.title: Pork Sausage-rice Casserole

ingredients.name: dried chicken noodle soup
ingredients.display_text: 1 package dried chicken noodle soup (uses 4 cups of)

recipes.instructions:
1. Cook onion and celery in butter until transparent stirring occasionally.
   Uses: 1 medium onion (finely chopped)
   Uses: 1/2 cup celery (cut fine)
   Uses: 1 tbsp butter

2. Add crumbled pork sausage and cook until done.
   Uses: 1 lb sausage

3. Drain off excess fat. Make chicken noodle soup according to directions on package.

4. Add meat  mixture and dry rice. Put in 3 1/2 qt. casserole dish and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

5. Bake uncovered.

recipes.title: Pork Tenderloin
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix the soy sauce, brown sugar, cumin, dry mustard, paprika, garlic, and parsley.
   Uses: 1/4 cup soy sauce
   Uses: 3 tbsp brown sugar
   Uses: 1 tsp cumin
   Uses: 1 tsp dry mustard
   Uses: 1/2 tsp paprika
   Uses: 5 cloves garlic (sliced)
   Uses: 2 tbsp parsley

2. Add the pork and marinade to a large resealable bag and refrigerate for 30 to 60 minutes.
   Uses: 2 lb pork tenderloin

3. Broil or grill 3 inches from the heat for 10 to 12 minutes, or until the pork reaches 160°F. Slice and serve.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix all ingredients together and tip with crushed potato chips.
   Uses: 1 package hashed brown potatoes
   Uses: 1 can cream of chicken soup
   Uses: Onion to taste
   Uses: 8 oz sour cream
   Uses: 1 stick melted butter
   Uses: pinch salt
   Uses: 1/2 cup cheddar cheese

2. Bake one hour at 375°F.

recipes.title: Potato Soup 1
recipes.instructions:
1. In pot, cook peas, carrots, celery, and potatoes in water to cover, boil 15 minutes.
   Uses: 40 oz peas and carrots (frozen)
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups celery
   Uses: 6 potato (peeled and cubed)

2. In large pot put 2 quarts water, bouillon, and onion bring to boil and turn down.

3. Melt butter, add flour and stir til paste. Put 1/2 cup of the onion water into butter and stir.
   Uses: 1 cup butter
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups flour

4. Add rest of onion water. Soften cheese wiz and put into onion stock, add veggies, salt and pepper. Eat.
   Uses: 1 large onion

recipes.title: Potato Soup 2

ingredients.name: whole Small Russet Potatoes
ingredients.display_text: 6 whole Small Russet Potatoes (Peeled And Diced)

ingredients.name: Grated Cheese Of Your Choice
ingredients.display_text: 1 cup Grated Cheese Of Your Choice

ingredients.name: Low Sodium Chicken Or Vegetable Broth
ingredients.display_text: 8 cups Low Sodium Chicken Or Vegetable Broth

recipes.instructions:
1. Add bacon pieces to a soup pot over medium heat and cook bacon until crisp and fat is rendered.
   Uses: 6 slices Thin Bacon (Cut Into 1-inch Pieces)

2. Remove the bacon from the pot and set it aside.

3. Pour off most of the grease, but do not clean the pot.

4. Return the hot to medium-high heat and add the onions, carrots, and celery. Stir and cook for 2 minutes or so, then add the diced potatoes. Cook for 5 minutes, seasoning with salt, pepper, and Cajun spice.
   Uses: 1 whole Medium Onion (Diced)
   Uses: 3 whole Carrots (Scrubbed Clean And Diced)
   Uses: 3 stalks Celery (Diced)
   Uses: 1/2 tsp Salt (More To Taste)
   Uses: black pepper (to taste)

5. Pour in the broth and bring it to a gentle boil. Cook for 10 minutes, or until the potatoes are starting to get tender. Whisk together the flour and the milk, then pour into the soup and allow the soup to cook for another 5 minutes.
   Uses: 1 cup Milk

6. Remove half to 2/3 the soup and blend in a blender/food process until completely smooth.

7. Pour it back into the soup pot and stir to combine.

8. Let it heat back up as you taste for seasonings, adding more of what it needs.

9. Stir in cream, then stir in parsley, reserving a little for garnish. Serve in bowls garnished with parsley, grated cheese and crisp bacon pieces.
   Uses: 1/2 cup Heavy Cream
   Uses: 1 tsp Minced Fresh Parsley

recipes.title: Pretzels
recipes.instructions:
1. In a large bowl.

2. mix yeast and sugar in warm water; let sit 5 minutes
   Uses: 1 envelope dry yeast
   Uses: 1 1/2 tbsp sugar
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups warm water

3. Stir in salt and 2-3 C. flour for soft batter

4. Keeping your hands dusted with flour, knead inenough additional flour to make a dough stiff enough to roll out.

5. Still keeping your hands dusted, take a lump of dough about the size of a peach, and roll it between your hands to make an 8"or 12' rope about as thick as your finger.

6. Twist the rope into a pretzel and place it on a greased cookie sheet, brush it with a beaten egg, and sprinkle coarse salt on top. Repeat until all dough is used up.

7. Bake at 425°F for 12-15 min. or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Pulled Pork Sandwiches
recipes.instructions:
1. Place pork butt in crockpot or large kettle on stove. Cook until very tender and breaks apart easily with fork.
   Uses: 5 lb whole pork butt

2. Season with salt and pepper.

3. Remove from crockpot when done and remove all fat.

4. Return shredded pork back to crockpot and cover with your favorite barbecue sauce and simmer for one hour. Serve on sourdough buns or regular hamburger buns.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Chocolate Chip Muffins

ingredients.name: chocolate chips - large milk chocolate
ingredients.display_text: 1 cup chocolate chips - large milk chocolate

recipes.instructions: Mix dry ingredients together.  Break eggs in another bowl.  Add pumpkin and butter.  Whisk till blended.  Stir in choc chips.  Bake 350. 20-25 min.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Muffins
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix together the flour, sugar, soda, cinnamon and salt. Make a well and add liquid ingredients. Spoon into muffin tins. Bake at 350°F for 13-15 minutes.
   Uses: 2 1/2 cups flour
   Uses: 1 cup sugar
   Uses: 2 tsp baking soda
   Uses: 1 tsp cinnamon
   Uses: 1 tsp salt

recipes.title: Raspberry Cheesecake
recipes.instructions:
1. Make cake mix according to the directions on the package.

2. Divide the batter evenly into two greased and floured 9 1/2 x 13" baking pans. While the cakes are baking, make one package of raspberry danish dessert using the liquid from the thawed raspberries for part of the water.

3. Let the pudding cool, then fold in the drained raspberries. Blend together the cream cheese and powdered sugar.
   Uses: 8 oz cream cheese
   Uses: 2 cups powdered sugar

4. Fold in the cool whip and blend very well.

5. Spread this over the cooled cakes.

6. Then spread the cooled danish dessert over the top and chill.

7. Cut and serve. (This can be made a day ahead of when it will be used.)

recipes.title: Ratatouille
recipes.description:
Prep Time: 15 Minutes
Cook Time: 45 Minutes
	
Ready In: 1 Hour
Servings: 4
"This terrific dish is loaded with succulent Mediterranean vegetables."
recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Coat bottom and sides of a 1 1/2 quart casserole dish with 1 tablespoon olive oil.

2. Heat remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil in a medium skillet over medium heat.

3. Saute garlic until lightly browned.
   Uses: 3 cloves Garlic (minced)

4. Mix in parsley and eggplant.
   Uses: 2 tsp Parsley (dried)

5. Saute until eggplant is soft, about 10 minutes.

6. Season with salt to taste.

7. Spread eggplant mixture evenly across bottom of prepared casserole dish. Sprinkle with a few tablespoons of Parmesan cheese.
   Uses: 1 cup Parmesan (grated)

8. Spread zucchini in an even layer over top. Lightly salt and sprinkle with a little more cheese. Continue layering in this fashion, with onion, mushrooms, bell pepper, and tomatoes, covering each layer with a sprinkling of salt and cheese.

9. Bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Red Cabbage Pasta or Salad

ingredients.name: of nuts or sunflower seeds
ingredients.display_text: 1/2 cup of nuts or sunflower seeds

ingredients.name: natural cane sugar
ingredients.display_text: 1 tsp natural cane sugar ((or brown sugar))

ingredients.name: pasta
ingredients.prep_notes: (Fusilli or any pasta that will catch or hold the cabbage and ot
ingredients.display_text: 3/4 pasta ((Fusilli or any pasta that will catch or hold the cabbage and ot)

ingredients.name: head of red cabbage
ingredients.display_text: 1 lb head of red cabbage (quartered and chopped)

ingredients.name: ounces craisins
ingredients.prep_notes: raisins, or other plump, chopped dried fruit
ingredients.display_text: 3 ounces craisins (raisins, or other plump, chopped dried fruit)

recipes.instructions:
1. Roast the nuts or seeds in a dry skillet over medium-high heat until golden brown.

2. Sprinkle on the sugar and couple of pinches of salt. Stir until the sugar melts and coats the nuts. Transfer to a plate and let cool.

3. Cook pasta according to package directions or if making the spinach salad version, wash and dry spinach leaves.

4. Heat 2 T. olive oil in large skillet and saute the onion for a minute or two with a couple of pinches of salt.
   Uses: 1 red onion (diced)

5. Stir in the garlic, and the cabbage, and a few more pinches of salt. Stir and cook for just a minute or so, or until the cabbage softens up JUST A TOUCH.
   Uses: 4 medium cloves of garlic (minced)
   Uses: 1 lb head of red cabbage (quartered and chopped)

6. Then stir in rosemary, raisins, and 1 T. vinegar.
   Uses: 1 tsp fresh rosemary (minced)

7. Fold in the feta cheese and nuts.

8. Pour cabbage mixture over pasta or spinach leaves that has been tossed with 2 T. of the balsamic vinegar and 2 T. of olive oil. Garnish with grated Parmesan cheese.

recipes.title: Red Potato Salad with Green Beans and Basil

ingredients.name: lbs. red potatoes
ingredients.prep_notes: scrubbed and cut into 1 inch dice
ingredients.display_text: 3 lbs. red potatoes (scrubbed and cut into 1 inch dice)

ingredients.name: green beans
ingredients.display_text: 1 lb green beans (cut into 1 1/2 inch lengths)

ingredients.name: handfuls of basil
ingredients.prep_notes: (about a half a bunch), cut in a chifonade
ingredients.display_text: 2 handfuls of basil ((about a half a bunch), cut in a chifonade)

ingredients.name: of green onions
ingredients.prep_notes: sliced (use the greens and the whites)
ingredients.display_text: 1 bunch of green onions (sliced (use the greens and the whites))

ingredients.name: white or red wine vinegar
ingredients.display_text: 3 tbsp white or red wine vinegar

ingredients.name: freshly ground pepper or grains of paradise
ingredients.display_text: 1/2 tsp freshly ground pepper or grains of paradise

recipes.instructions: This salad can be served immediately or chilled for later.

recipes.title: Reid's Famous Chicken Keleguin
recipes.instructions:
1. Prehead the oven to 400 degrees F. Pierce softest eye of coconut with a metal skewer or screwdriver and drain liquid into a bowl to sample (see note, above).

2. Bake coconut in oven 15 minutes. With a hammer or back of a heavy cleaver break shell and with point of a strong knife remove flesh, levering it out carefully.

3. Remove brown membrane with a sharp paring knife or vegetable peeler.

4. Grate coconut into bowl.

5. Reduce the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).

6. Place whole chicken into a roasting pan.

7. Roast in the oven for 1 hour, or until the leg moves easily within its socket.

8. Remove from the oven, and allow the chicken to cool slightly.

9. Remove the skin from the chicken and discard. Tear the meat from the bones, and chop into small pieces. Discard bones, and place the chicken in a large bowl.

10. Stir in green onions and grated coconut.
   Uses: 1 bunch green onions (chopped)

11. Sprinkle liberally with lemon juice.

12. Season with salt and red pepper flakes. Taste and adjust amounts of lemon juice, salt and red pepper so that one does not overwhelm the others. Serve with Reid's Famous Coconut Rice

recipes.title: Reid's Famous Coconut Rice
recipes.instructions:
1. In a saucepan, combine coconut milk, water, sugar, and salt. Stir until sugar is dissolved.
   Uses: 1 can (14 oz) coconut milk
   Uses: 1 1/4 cups water
   Uses: 1 tbsp sugar
   Uses: 1 pinch salt

2. Stir in rice.

3. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Cover, reduce heat, and simmer 18 to 20 minutes, until rice is tender.

recipes.title: Reid's Famous Coleslaw
recipes.instructions:
1. Be sure cabbage and carrots are chopped up into very fine pieces (about the size of rice).

2. Combine the mayonaise, sugar, milk, buttermilk, lemon juice, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a large bowl and beat until smooth.
   Uses: 2 1/2 tbsp Lemon juice
   Uses: 1 1/2 tbsp Vinegar
   Uses: 1/2 tsp Salt
   Uses: 1/8 tsp Pepper

3. Add the cabbage, carrots, and onion, and mix well.
   Uses: 8 cups Cabbage (finely chopped)
   Uses: 1/4 cup Carrot (shredded)
   Uses: 2 tbsp Onion (minced)

4. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Reid's Famous Lemon Spinach Salad
recipes.instructions:
1. Zest the lemon into a mixing bowl.

2. Slice the lemon in half and squeeze the juice into the bowl.

3. Add olive oil to bowl and whisk ingredients.
   Uses: 2 tbsp Olive oil

4. Add 1 1/2 tablespoons sugar to bowl.

5. Add remaining 1/2 tablespoon to taste. Whisk.

6. Pour over spinach in a salad bowl.

7. Add craisins, candied almonds, and apple slices.
   Uses: 1/4 cup Craisins
   Uses: 1/4 cup Candied almonds
   Uses: 1 Apple (sliced thinly)

8. Mix salad up and serve.

recipes.title: Reid's Famous Orange Chicken
recipes.description: This chicken is tangy and flavorful.

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.display_text: 3 boneless skinless chicken breasts (chopped into bite sized pieces)

ingredients.name: crushed hot red chili pepper
ingredients.display_text: 1/2 tsp crushed hot red chili pepper

ingredients.name: rice wine or white grape juice
ingredients.display_text: 1 tbsp rice wine or white grape juice

recipes.instructions:
1. Place chicken pieces in large bowl.

2. Stir in egg, salt, pepper and 1 tablespoon oil and mix well.
   Uses: 1 egg
   Uses: 1 1/2 tsp salt

3. Stir cornstarch and flour together.
   Uses: 1/4 cup Flour

4. Add chicken pieces, stirring to coat.

5. Heat oil for deep-frying in wok or deep-fryer to 375 degrees.

6. Add chicken, small batches at a time, and fry 3 to 4 minutes or until golden crisp.

7. (Do not overcook chicken).

8. Remove chicken from oil with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels; set aside.

9. Clean wok and heat 15 seconds over high heat.

10. Add 1 tablespoon oil.

11. Add ginger and garlic and stir-fry until fragrant; about 10 seconds.
   Uses: 1 tsp garlic (minced)

12. Add and stir-fry crushed chiles and green onions.
   Uses: 1/4 cup green onion (chopped)

13. Add rice wine and stir 3 seconds.

14. Add Orange Sauce and bring to boil.

15. Add cooked chicken, stirring until well mixed.

16. Stir water into remaining 1 tablespoon cornstarch until smooth and add to chicken.

17. Heat until sauce is thickned.

18. Stir in sesame oil and orange zest if desired.
   Uses: 1/2 tsp sesame oil
   Uses: 1 Orange zest

19. Serve over jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Reid's Famous Toffee Delight
recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).

2. Arrange crackers in a single layer on the bottom of a 10x15 inch pan that has sides.

3. Boil the butter and the brown sugar together for 3 minutes.
   Uses: 1 cup butter
   Uses: 1 cup packed brown sugar

4. Pour evenly over the crackers. Be careful it's extremely hot and sticky.
   Uses: 4 ounces saltine crackers

5. Bake at 375 degrees F (190 degrees C) for 7 minutes.

6. Remove from oven and immediately sprinkle chocolate chips over hot mixture. Wait a few minutes for them to melt, then spread evenly with the back of a spoon. While still hot spread finely chopped walnuts over the top. Break or cut into desired size pieces.

recipes.title: Rice Krispies Treats
recipes.instructions:
1. Melt butter in large saucepan over low hear.
   Uses: 1/4 cup butter

2. Add marshmallows and stir until completely melted. Cook over low heat 3 minutes longer, stirring constantly.
   Uses: 4 cups miniature marshmallows

3. Remove from heat.

4. Add Rice Krispies cereal. Stir until well coated. Using buttered spatula or waxed paper, press mixture evenly into buttered 13 X 9 inch pan.

5. Cut into squares when cool.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding

ingredients.name: milk
ingredients.prep_notes: enough to just cover the rice
ingredients.display_text: milk (enough to just cover the rice)

ingredients.name: eggs
ingredients.prep_notes: 1 egg per cup of milk; adjust to amount of rice
ingredients.display_text: 2-4 eggs (1 egg per cup of milk; adjust to amount of rice)

recipes.instructions:
1. Place leftover rice in a pan.

2. Add enough milk to just cover the rice and simmer.

3. Add salt and sugar to taste.
   Uses: salt (to taste)

4. Beat 2 to 4 eggs, using 1 egg per cup of milk.

5. Add the beaten eggs to the rice and stir until it barely thickens.

6. Pour into a container to stop the cooking action and prevent curdling.

recipes.title: Rich and Charlie's Italian Salad
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix olive oil, vinegar, sugar, salt, pepper, garlic powder and dried mustard together with a whip. Set aside
   Uses: 1 cup olive oil
   Uses: 1/4 cup red wine vinegar
   Uses: 2 tbsp sugar
   Uses: 2 tsp salt
   Uses: 1/2 tsp pepper
   Uses: 1 tsp garlic powder
   Uses: 1 tsp dried mustard

2. Wash lettuce and tear into bite-size pieces into a salad bowl.

3. Add remaining ingredients to lettuce.

4. Pour dressing mixture that has been set aside on and toss. Serve immediately.

5. This makes way too much dressing. You could have it or 1/4 it and still have plenty.

recipes.title: Roast
recipes.instructions:
1. place roast in crock pot, salt and pepper the roast

2. peel carrots and potatoes

3. cut up carrots, potatoes, and onions
   Uses: 1 onion

4. place cut up vegetables in crock pot

5. mix the cream of mushroom soup and the onion soup mix and half a cup of water
   Uses: 1 can cream of mushroom soup

6. pour mixture over the roast and vegetable mix

7. put on lid

8. cook on high for 4-6 hours

recipes.title: Roasted Vegetables
recipes.instructions:
1. Peel sweet potatoes, squash, and carrots, and garlic. (Don't chop up garlic but keep them whole cloves, they become so sweet when they are roasted)  Chop up all vegetables into equal size pieces.
   Uses: 2 sweet potato
   Uses: 1 butternut squash
   Uses: 5 carrot
   Uses: 5 whole garlic cloves

2. Place foil on a cookie sheet and spray it with cooking spray.

3. Place all vegetables on the cookie sheet so that none of the vegetables overlap.

4. Sprinkle salt on vegetables. I'll make two if I'm having company.

5. Bake in 350°F oven for 20 minutes.

6. Turn vegetables over and bake for another 20 minutes. If desired, broil the vegetables for the last 3-5 minutes to make more roasted.

recipes.title: Root Beer Popcorn
recipes.instructions:
1. Combine the sugar, corn syrup, and butter and boil for 1½ minutes.
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups sugar
   Uses: 1/2 cup light corn syrup
   Uses: 1/2 cup butter

2. Remove from the heat and stir in the root beer extract. Pour over the popped corn.
   Uses: 1 tsp root beer extract
   Uses: 4–5 quarts popped corn

recipes.title: Royal Frosting
recipes.instructions:
1. Combine egg whites, powdered sugar, vanilla, and cream of tartar.
   Uses: 3 3/4 cups powdered sugar
   Uses: 1 tsp vanilla
   Uses: 1/2 tsp cream of tartar

2. Beat with electric mixer 7 to 10 minutes or till frosting is very stiff. Keep frosting covered with damp cloth at all times to prevent crust from forming. Makes 3 cups

recipes.title: Salty Oats

ingredients.name: package top quality bittersweet chocolate
ingredients.display_text: 1 10 oz package top quality bittersweet chocolate

recipes.instructions:
1. In large bowl beat butter a few minutes on medium-high speed until light and fluffy. Scrape down sides of bowl and add sugars, baking powder, baking soda and cinnamo, beating until mixture is well blended.

2. Reduce speed to medium and add eggs and vanilla extract, mixing until well incorporated.
   Uses: 2 large eggs
   Uses: 1 tsp vanilla

3. Reduce speed to low and add flour and oats, scraping down sides of bowl as necessary and mixing  just until they are incorporated.
   Uses: 1 3/4 cups flour
   Uses: 2 cups rolled oats (not quick cooking)

4. Add chocolate chips, if using.
   Uses: 1 10 oz package top quality bittersweet chocolate

5. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and chill dough for at least an hour before baking.

6. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Line large baking sheet with parchment paper. Form dough into golf ball size balls and place about 2 inches apart on the baking sheet.

7. Sprinkle sea salt on top of each ball of dough.

8. Bake 1 sheet at a time 12-15 minutes or until cookies are puffed and beginning to turn golden, being careful not to overbake. (The cookies should have a tender interior.)

9. Transfer cookies, still on parchment paper, to a wire rack to cool completely.We took a bar or dark chocolate and chopped it up to put into the cookies. They were wonderful.

recipes.title: Savory Chicken Breasts
recipes.description: "Oh so creamy under that crumb topping! Chicken blessed with Swiss cheese and a subtle cream sauce."

ingredients.name: Cream of Chicken Soup
ingredients.display_text: 1 can (10.5 oz) Cream of Chicken Soup

recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

2. Place chicken breasts in a 9x13 inch baking dish.

3. Season with ground black pepper to taste.

4. Top each breast with a slice of cheese.

5. Mix together the soup and milk and pour mixture over chicken.

6. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top and drizzle with melted butter.
   Uses: 1 cup dry bread crumbs
   Uses: 3 tbsp butter (melted)

7. Bake covered in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake for another 20 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Savory Croissant Rolls
recipes.instructions:
1. Blend cream cheese and butter.
   Uses: 8 oz cream cheese

2. Then add next six ingredients. Blend Well. Separate croissant rolls. Spoon 1/4 cup meat mixture on large end of triangle.

3. Roll up and place on cookie sheet.

4. Brush tops with melted butter. Sprinkle with bread crumbs.
   Uses: 3/4 cup Italian bread crumbs

5. Bake 350°F for 20 min or until brown. Be careful not to burn.

recipes.title: Seven Layer Salad
recipes.instructions:
1. Layer in clear bowl, water chestnuts, a layer of celery, and peas (do not cook).
   Uses: 1 cup diced celery

2. Stir mayonnaise and sour cream and frost top of salad like a cake. Be sure to seal edges. Sprinkle with sugar and sprinkle with cheese and bacon.
   Uses: 1/2 cup mayonnaise
   Uses: 1/2 cup sour cream
   Uses: 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese
   Uses: 1/4 cup bacon

3. Let set overnight or at least 6 hours.

recipes.title: Shrimp Paesano
recipes.instructions:
1. Clean and devein shrimp and soak in half and half for 10 minutes.

2. Drain and dredge in flour.
   Uses: flour

3. Saute in oil over medium heat for 3 - 5 minutes until pink.

4. Remove shrimp and place on baking pan in preheated oven.

5. Broil five minutes or until golden brown. Do not turn or move shrimp. (important for crisp shrimp) Drain, pour on sauce and serve.To make sauce, mix egg yolk and lemon juice in heavy sauce pan.

6. Add half of the butter and stir over low heat until melted.

7. Add garlic and remaining butter.
   Uses: 2 cloves garlic

8. Stir briskly until butter melts and sauce thickens.

9. Add chives and parsley. Serve with buttered linquine noodles.
   Uses: chopped chives
   Uses: chopped parsley

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes
recipes.instructions:
1. Brown beef, celery and onion.
   Uses: 2 stalks celery
   Uses: 1 small onion (chopped)

2. Drain.

3. Stir in rest and simmer covered for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Smitten Kitchen Ultimate Chocolate Chip Cookie

ingredients.name: plus 2 tablespoons
ingredients.display_text: 1 cup plus 2 tablespoons (8 ounces granulated s)

ingredients.name: bittersweet chocolate disks or fèves
ingredients.display_text: 1 1/4 lb bittersweet chocolate disks or fèves (at least 60 percent)

recipes.instructions:
1. Sift together both flours, baking soda, baking powder, and salt.
   Uses: 2 cups minus 2 tablespoons cake flour
   Uses: 1 2/3 cups bread flour (8 1/2 ounces)
   Uses: 1 1/4 tsp baking soda
   Uses: 1 1/2 tsp baking powder
   Uses: 1 1/2 tsp coarse salt

2. With a paddle attachment, cream the butter and both sugars until very light, about 5 minutes. Beat in the eggs one at a time, mixing well after each, then stir in the vanilla.
   Uses: 2 1/2 sticks unsalted butter (1 1/4 cups)
   Uses: 1 1/4 cups light brown sugar (10 ounces)
   Uses: 1 cup plus 2 tbsp granulated sugar
   Uses: 2 large eggs
   Uses: 2 tsp natural vanilla extract

3. On low speed, add the dry ingredients and mix just until combined, 5 to 10 seconds. Work in the chocolate pieces without breaking them.
   Uses: 1 1/4 lb bittersweet chocolate disks or fèves (at least 60 percent)

4. Press plastic wrap onto the dough and refrigerate for 24 to 36 hours. You can bake it in batches and refrigerate it for up to 72 hours.

5. Preheat the oven to 350°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment or a nonstick baking mat.

6. Place six 3½-ounce dough mounds on the sheet, turning any protruding chocolate pieces so they lie flat. Sprinkle lightly with sea salt and bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until golden and still soft.
   Uses: Sea salt

7. Cool on the sheet on a wire rack for 10 minutes, then transfer the cookies to a rack. Bake the rest of the dough, or refrigerate it for the next day. Serve warm.

8. Chocolate notes: I found Valrhona's fèves or oval-shaped chocolate pieces, at Whole Foods in half pounds. Baking discs can be found from a number of brands, from Jacques Torres to E. Guittard (Fresh Direct used to sell these by the quarter pound, but now just in one pound boxes, but still at a very reasonable price) to Ghiradelli. Can't find them? Use the largest chocolate chips you can find. Ghiradelli sells some slighly larger ones in the brown bag (as opposed to the standard-sized chips in the gold bag) though I may have mixed the two varieties up. It wouldn't be the first time.

recipes.title: Snapper
recipes.instructions:
1. Make a thick bed of spinach in a 9-by-13-inch dish. Brush with melted butter and season with salt and pepper.
   Uses: spinach
   Uses: butter
   Uses: salt and pepper

2. Lay the fillet on top, season it lightly, and spread with fresh pico de gallo and a squeeze of lime. Add crushed whole-grain crackers and drizzle with butter.
   Uses: snapper fillet
   Uses: fresh lime juice
   Uses: crackers (good brand of whole grain)

3. Cover with foil and bake at 400°F for 20 minutes, removing the foil for the last 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles
recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F. In mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar.
   Uses: 1 cup butter (softened)

2. Beat in eggs and vanilla.
   Uses: 2 eggs
   Uses: 1 tsp vanilla

3. Stir in flour, cream of tartar, baking soda and salt.
   Uses: 2 2/3 cups unsifted flour
   Uses: 1 tsp cream of tartar
   Uses: 1/2 tsp baking soda
   Uses: 1/4 tsp salt

4. Shape dough into balls.

5. Combine sugar and cinnamon; roll ball of dough in sugar mixture.

6. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheets. Flatten slightly.

7. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until eggs are set.

recipes.title: Sno Cone Syrup

ingredients.name: extract of choice
ingredients.display_text: 1 tbsp extract of choice (peppermint, lemon, or vanilla)

recipes.instructions:
1. Combine one cup of water with two cups granulated sugar in a small saucepan.
   Uses: 1 cup water
   Uses: 2 cups granulated sugar

2. Bring the mixture to a boil over medium-high heat.

3. Continue heating the mixture until all of the sugar has dissolved, and you are left with a slightly syrupy consistency.

4. Add one tablespoon of your extract of choice. Peppermint, lemon, and vanilla all work well, but choose the one you like best for your homemade snow cone syrup.

5. Add a few drops of food coloring, if desired, to the syrup. Stir well to combine all ingredients, and allow the snow cone syrup to cool in the refrigerator for a few hours before drizzling over shaved ice.

6. Store any leftover snow cone syrup in the refrigerator until ready to use again, and discard after one week if any portion is unused. Be sure to label the container if you make more than one batch of the same color.

recipes.title: Soba and Slaw Salad with Peanut Dressing
aliases: Soba And Slaw Salad With Peanut Dressing

ingredients.name: uncooked soba noodles
ingredients.display_text: 6 oz uncooked soba noodles (broken in half)

ingredients.name: Thai chile paste with garlic
ingredients.display_text: 2 tsp Thai chile paste with garlic

recipes.instructions:
1. Cook noodles according to package directions, omitting salt and fat.

2. Drain, rinse with cold water.

3. Combine noodles, shredded cabbage, carrot, 1/2 cup green onions, and chicken in a large bowl.
   Uses: 6 cups shredded red cabbage
   Uses: 2 cups grated carrot
   Uses: 1/2 lb chicken (coarsely chopped)

4. Combine soy sauce and next 4 ingredients (through chili paste) in a small bowl.

5. stir with a whisk until blended.

6. Add soy sauce mixture to noodle mixture, tossing gently to coat. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup green onion and peanute. Good served with fresh lime to squeeze on salad.

recipes.title: Sock It to Me Cake
recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 375°F. Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan.

2. Make the streusel. Combine 2 tablespoons dry cake mix, brown sugar, and cinnamon in a medium bowl. Stir in the pecans and set aside.
   Uses: 2 tbsp dry cake mix
   Uses: 2 tbsp brown sugar
   Uses: 2 tsp ground cinnamon
   Uses: 1 cup chopped pecan

3. For the cake, combine the remaining cake mix, eggs, sour cream, oil, water, and sugar in a large bowl. Beat on medium speed for 2 minutes.
   Uses: Remaining cake mix
   Uses: 4 large egg
   Uses: 1 cup sour cream
   Uses: 1/3 cup oil
   Uses: 1/4 cup water
   Uses: 1/4 cup sugar

4. Pour two-thirds of the batter into the pan. Sprinkle with the streusel and spoon the remaining batter evenly over it.

5. Bake for 45 to 55 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then invert onto a rack and cool completely.

6. Stir the powdered sugar and milk together until smooth. Drizzle over the cooled cake.
   Uses: 1 cup powdered sugar
   Uses: 2 tbsp milk

recipes.title: Soft Pretzels
recipes.instructions:
1. In a large bowl, mix the yeast and sugar into the warm water. Let sit for 5 minutes.
   Uses: 1 envelope dry yeast
   Uses: 1 1/2 tbsp sugar
   Uses: 1 1/2 cups warm water

2. Stir in the salt and 2 to 3 cups of the flour to make a soft batter.
   Uses: 1 tsp salt
   Uses: 2–3 cups flour

3. With flour-dusted hands, knead in enough of the remaining flour to make a dough stiff enough to roll out.
   Uses: Remaining flour, as needed

4. With floured hands, pull off a peach-sized piece of dough and roll it into a rope about as thick as a finger and 8 to 12 inches long. Twist it into a pretzel.

5. Place on a greased cookie sheet, brush with beaten egg, and sprinkle with coarse salt. Repeat with the remaining dough.
   Uses: 1 egg
   Uses: coarse salt

6. Bake at 425°F for 12 to 15 minutes, until golden brown. Cover loosely.

recipes.title: Soft Sugar Cookies
recipes.instructions:
1. Cream butter and sugar; add eggs, vanilla and sour cream; blend well.

2. Add dry ingredients and beat well. Refrigerate for about an hour and then roll out 1/4-inch thick on floured board.

3. Cut out shapes and bake at 350°F for 10 - 12 minutes. When cookies are cooled, ice and decorate as you wish.

4. For old-fashioned sugar cookies sprinkle with sugar before baking.
   Uses: 2 cups sugar

recipes.title: Sour Cream Chicken Enchiladas
recipes.instructions:
1. Rinse chicken and pat dry.

2. Cook in water to cover in saucepan until tender.

3. Drain, reserving 1 1/2 cups broth. Cool and chop chicken.

4. Saute onion in butter in skillet.
   Uses: 1 onion (chopped)

5. Add chicken, green chilies, mushrooms, cheddar cheese, garlic powder, 1/2 teaspoon chili powder, and 1 cup sour cream; mix well. Microwave tortillas on HIGH for 1 minute or until softened. Spoon chicken mixture onto tortillas.

6. Roll to enclose filling.

7. Place seam-side down in greased 9x13 inch baking dish.

8. Blend flour into butter in saucepan.
   Uses: 1/4 cup flour

9. Stir in reserved broth. Cook until thickened and bubbly, stirring constantly.

10. Stir in 1 cup Monterey Jack cheese, 1 1/2 cups sour cream, and additional chili powder to taste.

11. Pour over enchiladas. Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining 1 1/2 cups Monterey Jack cheese.

12. Bake just until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Spaghetti with Broccoli Cream Pesto

ingredients.name: Freshly
ingredients.prep_notes: ground black pepper or pinches of red pepper flak
ingredients.display_text: Freshly (ground black pepper or pinches of red pepper flak)

recipes.instructions:
1. Bring a large pot of salted water to boil for your pasta.

2. Remove broccoli florets from stems and chop into medium florets.

3. Peel stems with a vegetable peeler (I do this so that they cook quickly, plus, I prefer their taste without the tough stem skin.) and slice them into 1/2-inch segments.

4. Use your pot of future pasta water to steam (by suspending a mesh strainer over your pasta pot and covering it with a lid for 5 to 6 minutes)) or par-boil (for 3 to 5 minutes) your broccoli florets and stems until just tender, then drain if needed and set them aside.

5. Add pasta to water and cook until al dente, or about one minute less than fully cooked. Before draining pasta, reserve a cup of pasta cooking water and set it aside.

6. Drain pasta.

7. Wipe out pot so that you can use it again. In the bottom of pot, melt butter and olive oil together over medium heat.
   Uses: 1 tbsp unsalted butter
   Uses: 1 tbsp olive oil

8. Add onion and reduce to medium-low, sauteing it until tender, about 7 minutes.

9. Add garlic and cook for another two minutes.

10. Add steamed broccoli, salt and red or black pepper and turn the heat back up to medium-high, cooking it with the onion and garlic for a few additional minutes.
   Uses: 1/2 tsp table salt

11. Pour cream over mixture and let cook for 30 seconds.

12. Transfer broccoli mixture and all of its creamy bits at the bottom of the pan to a blender or food processor and blend in short bursts until it’s finely chopped and a little sauce. Don’t worry if it looks dry; that reserved pasta water will give it the sauciness it needs in a minute.

13. (Theoretically, one could also use an immersion blender here inside their pot to make the broccoli sauce, but it might be a bit messy with all of the chunks and small bits.)

14. Add the broccoli sauce back to the pot with the drained spaghetti and a splash or two of the reserved pasta water. Cook over medium-high for 1 to 2 minutes, tossing the mixture so that it evenly coats.

15. Add more pasta water as needed to loosen the sauce. Adjust seasonings to taste, adding more salt or pepper, and scoop into a serving bowl. Shower spaghetti with grated parmesan and dig in.

16. Do ahead: I make a large batch of the sauce and keep it in the fridge for several days, boiling a little pasta each day for lunch when I make it for Jacob.

recipes.instructions:

recipes.title: Stir Fry Beef and Broccoli with Oyster Sauce
aliases: Stir Fry Beef And Broccoli With Oyster Sauce

ingredients.name: broccoli
ingredients.prep_notes: florets cut into bite size piece
ingredients.display_text: 1 1/4 lb broccoli (florets cut into bite size piece)

ingredients.name: red bell pepper
ingredients.display_text: 1 small red bell pepper (cored seeded and diced)

recipes.instructions:
1. Combine the beef and soy sauce in a medium bowl; cover with plastic wrap and regrigerate at least 10 minutes or up to 1 hour, stirring once.
   Uses: 3 tbsp soy sauce

2. Meanwhile, whisk the apple juice, chicken broth, oyster sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, and cornstarch in a measuring cup.
   Uses: 1 tbsp apple juice
   Uses: 5 tbsp oyster sauce
   Uses: 1 tsp cornstarch

3. Combine the garlic, ginger, and 1 1/2 teaspoons of the peanut oil in a small bowl.
   Uses: 1 tbsp minced fresh ginger

4. Drain the beef and discard the liquid.

5. Heat 1 1/2 teaspoons of the peanut oil in a nonstick 12 inch skillet over high heat until smoking.

6. Add half of the beef to the skillet and break up the clumps; cook with stirring, 1 minute, then stir and cook until the beef is browned about the edges, about 30 seconds.

7. Transfer the beef to a medium bowl.

8. Add 1 1/2 teaspoons of the peanut oil to the skillet, heat until just smoking, and repeat with the remaining beef.

9. Add 1 Tablespoon of the oil to the now - empty skillet; heat until just smoking.

10. Add the broccoli and cook 30 seconds; add  the water, cover the pan, and lower the heat to medium.
   Uses: 1 1/4 lb broccoli (florets cut into bite size piece)
   Uses: 1/3 cup water

11. Steam the broccoli until tender-crisp, about 2 minutes; transfer to a peper towel-lined plate.

12. Add the remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons oil to the skillet; increase the heat to high and heat until just smoking.

13. Add the bell pepper and cook, stirring frequently, until spotty brown, about 1 1/2 minutes.

14. Clear the center of the skillet; add the garlic and ginger mixture to the clearing and cook, mashing the mixture with a spoon, until fragrant, 15 to 20 seconds, then stir the mixture into the peppers.

15. Return the beef and broccoli to the skillet and toss to combine.

16. Whisk the sauce to recombine, then add to the skillet; cook, stirring constantly, until the sauce is thickened and evenly distributed, about 30 seconds. Transfer to a serving platter. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookie Bar Frosting

recipes.instructions:
1. Preheat an oven to 190º C (375º F).

2. Place sweet potatoes on a baking sheet and roast for an hour or until soft.

3. Remove sweet potatoes from oven and peel them (you may want to let them cool a little, they are hot – I just peeled them with my hands), then mash with a fork. In a large stockpot, heat oil on medium-high heat.
   Uses: 2 tbsp vegetable oil

4. When hot, add in onions, garlic, lemongrass, and ginger, and let cook until fragrant and translucent.
   Uses: 2 medium sized onions (diced)
   Uses: 8 cloves garlic (minced)
   Uses: 2 stalks lemongrass (trimmed and cut into thirds)
   Uses: 2 tsp ginger (minced)

5. Add to the soup bell peppers, mushrooms, and curry paste and let cook about 5 more minutes, stirring every couple minutes to make sure everything is flavored well with the curry paste.

6. Pour in the water, bring back to a simmer, then remove from heat.
   Uses: 2 cups water

7. Remove the lemongrass from the soup (but keep because we’ll be adding it back in later) and use the immersion blender to purée the soup in the pot.

8. Add in the mashed sweet potato and coconut milk, and use the immersion blender to purée again the soup so that everything is smooth.
   Uses: 1 L coconut milk

9. Return the lemongrass to the soup and place the soup back on the stove – bring to a simmer, then reduce the heat to medium-low and let cook at a low simmer for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors develop. Serve with a side of steamed sticky rice, or just enjoy plain in a bowl. Enjoy!

4. Meanwhile, prepare your salad.

recipes.title: Taco Pizza

ingredients.name: taco seasoning
ingredients.display_text: 1 tsp taco seasoning (prepared or make your own)

ingredients.name: green leaf lettuce

recipes.instructions:
1. Can use Sandras pizza crust or this one. Make the pizza dough: Mix yeast with warm water and set aside for 8 to 10 minutes.
   Uses: 1 tsp active dry yeast
   Uses: 1-1 1/2 cups warm water

2. Mix flour, salt, and olive oil in a mixing bowl. With speed on low, drizzle in yeast/water mixture. Allow to mix until totally combined.

3. Cover bowl with a towel and set bowl in a warm, draft-free place. Allow to rise for 1 to 2 hours.

4. Pour black beans into a saucepan.

5. Add seasonings to taste and heat up beans over medium-low heat. Use a potato masher to mash the beans to desired texture. Continue cooking/heating beans over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, until no longer runny (should be the texture of refried beans. Set aside.

6. In a small skillet, heat canola oil over medium heat. When hot enough to fry, drop in the tortilla strips in batches, frying quickly and removing from oil with a fork when crisp–about 30 to 45 seconds per batch. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate. Set aside.
   Uses: 1/2 cup canola oil (for frying)

7. Place oven rack in the bottom position in the oven.

8. Preheat oven to 500 degrees.

9. Remove half the pizza dough from the bowl.

10. Place remaining half in a large plastic bag and refrigerate, saving for another use. With hands, spread pizza dough on an oiled baking sheet, making sure it’s relatively thin.

11. Spread layer of refried beans all over pizza crust.

12. Sprinkle mixed grated cheeses over the top.

13. Place pan in the oven (in the bottom half of the oven) and bake for 9 to 12 minutes. Watch it to make sure crust doesn’t burn.

14. Remove pizza from oven.

15. Sprinkle on shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, and cilantro leaves.
   Uses: 1 head green leaf lettuce (sliced or shredded thin)

17. Sprinkle with tortilla strips.

18. Cut into squares and serve immediately with good quality salsa.

1. Mix the rice, cheese, tuna, onion, parsley, seasoned salt, eggs, and milk. Divide among six greased muffin cups.

   Uses: 1 cup grated cheddar cheese
   Uses: 6 oz tuna
   Uses: 1 tbsp instant onion
   Uses: 1 tbsp parsley
   Uses: 1 tsp season salt

   Uses: 2 tbsp milk

3. For the sauce, mix the melted butter, lemon juice, seasoned salt, and parsley flakes. Serve with the muffins, or serve with lemon juice instead.

   Uses: 1/2 tsp seasoned salt
   Uses: 1/2 tsp parsley flakes

recipes.title: Tuna Ring with Cheese Sauce
recipes.instructions:
1. Heat oven to 375°F. Beat egg slightly; set aside 2 tablespoons of the egg.

2. Stir tuna, onion, cheese, parsley, celery salt and pepper into remaining egg.
   Uses: 2 cans tuna (drained)
   Uses: 1/2 cup chopped onion
   Uses: 1/4 cup parsley

3. Stir baking mix and water to a soft dough; knead 5 times on floured cloth-covered board.

4. Roll into rectangle, 15x10 inches.

5. Spread with tuna mixture.

6. Roll up, beginning at long side. With sealed edge down, shape into ring on greased baking sheet; pinch ends together. With paring knife, make cuts 2/3 of the way through ring at 1- inch intervals.

7. Turn each section on its side to show filling.

8. Brush top with reserved egg.

9. Bake 20 - 25 minutes. Serve with hot cheese sauce.

10. Cheese sauce-Melt 2 tablespoons butter in microwave, stir in 2 tablespoons flour.

11. Then add 1 cup milk, stir well.

12. Place in microwave and cook stirring every 30 seconds. When thick season with salt, pepper, then add grated sharp cheese till it taste the way you want. I usually add about 3/4 cup cheese.

recipes.title: Tuscan Chickpea Soup

ingredients.name: chopped onion
ingredients.display_text: 2 cups chopped onion ((I prefer purple onions))

ingredients.name: garlic cloves
ingredients.prep_notes: minced (I just used the canned minced)
ingredients.display_text: 8 garlic cloves (minced (I just used the canned minced))

ingredients.name: minced rosemary or 1/4 teaspoon dried rosemary
ingredients.display_text: 1 tsp minced rosemary or 1/4 teaspoon dried rosemary

ingredients.name: grated fresh Parmesan cheese
ingredients.display_text: 6 tbsp grated fresh Parmesan cheese ((this is about 1.5 ounces))

recipes.instructions:
1. Heat 2 Tb of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
   Uses: 2 tbsp olive oil

2. Add the onion brown until clear, then add the garlic and stir until both are brown. Don't burn the garlic!
   Uses: 2 cups chopped onion ((I prefer purple onions))

3. Stir in 4 c water, 1 ts rosemary, ¾ ts sea salt, ¼ pepper, 3 cans chickpeas (drained) and 1 can tomatoes (not drained).
   Uses: 4 cups water
   Uses: 1 tsp minced rosemary or 1/4 teaspoon dried rosemary
   Uses: 3/4 tsp sea salt
   Uses: 1/4 tsp black pepper
   Uses: 3 (15.5 oz) cans chickpeas (rinsed and drained)
   Uses: 1 (14.5 oz) can diced tomatoes (undrained)

4. Bring all of it to a boil, reduce heat, and then simmer for 20 minutes. Take soup off heat. Puree the soup. I love my hand held Cuisinart mixer (which I got for my birthday from Sus! Thank you) which purees everything to a creamy texture in 3 minutes!

5. You can also blend it by cupping half the soup in a blender, blending it, and then saving it in another bowl until it is all pureed.

6. Finally, bring all of the soup back into the pot.

7. Stir in balsamic vinegar and bring to a boil.
   Uses: 2 tbsp balsamic vinegar

8. Place soup in bowls and garnish each bowl with 1 tablespoon Parmesan cheese. YUM!

recipes.title: Veggie Pizza
recipes.instructions:
1. Unroll crescent rolls and cover large cookie sheet.

2. Bake 15 min. or till light brown. Cool.

3. Mix cream cheese, sour cream and dressing mix.
   Uses: 1 8 oz cream cheese
   Uses: 1/2 cup sour cream
   Uses: 1 package ranch salad dressing (dry)

4. Spread over crescent crust.

5. Cover with favorite veggies. Ideas... Shredded carrots, broccoli flowerets, shredded zucchini, red and green bell peppers, mushrooms. Or what ever sounds good to you.

recipes.title: Waffle Cookies
recipes.instructions:
1. Cream shortening and sugar, add vanilla.
   Uses: 3/4 cup shortening
   Uses: 3/4 cup sugar
   Uses: 1 tsp vanilla

2. Add eggs, salt, flour, baking powder, and jello. Mix to a soft dough.  form into small balls and place about 2" apart in waffle iron (between low and medium heat).

3. Bake a few minutes until done. Don't cook too long or they will be tough.

recipes.title: White BBQ Sauce
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix the oil, vinegar, salt, pepper, poultry seasoning, and egg.
   Uses: 1/2 cup oil
   Uses: 1 cup vinegar
   Uses: 5 tsp salt
   Uses: 1/4 tsp pepper
   Uses: 1 1/2 tsp poultry seasoning
   Uses: 1 egg

2. Marinate in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.

recipes.title: White Chili

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breast
ingredients.display_text: 2 lb boneless skinless chicken breast (cook and dice)

recipes.instructions:
1. Heat the oil and cook the onions. Stir in the garlic, cumin, red pepper, and oregano and sauté for 2 to 3 minutes.
   Uses: 1 tsp olive oil
   Uses: 2 medium onion
   Uses: 4 cloves garlic
   Uses: 2 tsp cumin
   Uses: 1/4 tsp red pepper (`)
   Uses: 1 tsp oregano

2. Add the beans, cooked chicken, green chile, and stock. Cook for 15 to 30 minutes.
   Uses: 4 cans northern white beans (drained)
   Uses: 2 lb boneless skinless chicken breast (cook and dice)
   Uses: 2 cans green chile
   Uses: 4 cups chicken stock

3. Stir in the Monterey Jack just before serving and garnish with sour cream.
   Uses: 12 oz monterey jack cheese
   Uses: sour cream - garnish

recipes.title: Whole Wheat Muffins
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix the flour, milk, eggs, brown sugar, baking powder, melted butter, and salt. For apple muffins, add 1 cup chopped apple.
   Uses: 2 cups whole wheat flour
   Uses: 1 cup milk
   Uses: 2 eggs
   Uses: 1/2 cup brown sugar
   Uses: 4 tsp baking powder
   Uses: 1/4 cup butter (melted)
   Uses: 1/2 tsp salt

2. Bake in a greased muffin tin at 350°F for 12 to 15 minutes.

3. If desired, dip the tops of the baked muffins in butter, then in cinnamon sugar.

recipes.title: Zucchini Risotto
recipes.instructions:
1. Bring the stock to a boil in a pot, then reduce to a low simmer.
   Uses: 7 cups vegetable or chicken stock

2. In a heavy pot, melt the butter over medium heat. Cook the onion for 2 minutes or until softened. Add the rice and stir constantly for another 2 minutes, until lightly toasted.
   Uses: 1 tbsp butter
   Uses: 1 medium onion
   Uses: 2 cups Arborio rice

3. Ladle in the simmering stock gradually, stirring constantly, until the rice is creamy and still firm in the center.

4. When the rice is nearly done, stir in the zucchini, sun-dried tomatoes, and thyme. Keep stirring and add stock as needed.
   Uses: 1/2 medium zucchini
   Uses: 10 sun-dried tomatoes
   Uses: 1 tsp dried thyme

5. Stir in the basil and 3 tablespoons Parmesan. Divide among six bowls and top with the remaining Parmesan and pepper.
   Uses: 1 tbsp chopped fresh basil leaves
   Uses: 3 tbsp Parmesan in the risotto
   Uses: 3 tbsp Parmesan to serve
   Uses: freshly ground black pepper (to taste)
